snaps.era2: 吴天纪四年
snaps.d:
265 年十二月司马炎受魏禅，国号晋，都洛阳。279 年冬晋六路伐吴，280 年二月王濬烧断吴军横江铁锁，顺流东下，三月楼船直抵石头城，孙皓面缚出降，吴亡，晋得吴四州、四十三郡、五十二万三千户，自黄巾起事以来近百年的分裂结束。
晋分天下为十九州。北边鲜卑诸部与匈奴、羌胡散居塞内外，东北有夫余、高句丽，西域诸国名义附晋，南方林邑屡扰日南。远西的萨珊波斯与罗马（大秦）隔幼发拉底河对峙，天竺仍有贵霜余绪。
snaps.te: Western Jin conquers Wu
snaps.de:
In the 12th month of 265 Sima Yan accepted the abdication of Wei, naming his dynasty Jin, with its capital at Luoyang. In the winter of 279 Jin attacked Wu along six routes; in the 2nd month of 280 Wang Jun (王濬) burned through the iron chains that Wu had stretched across the Yangtze and sailed downstream, and in the 3rd month his towered warships reached Shitou City. Sun Hao came out with his hands bound and surrendered, Wu fell, and Jin gained Wu's four provinces, forty-three commanderies and 523,000 households, ending nearly a century of division that had begun with the Yellow Turban rising.
Jin divided the realm into nineteen provinces. On the northern frontier the Xianbei tribes lived scattered on both sides of the frontier alongside the Xiongnu, Qiang and Hu; in the northeast lay Buyeo and Goguryeo; the states of the Western Regions nominally submitted to Jin, and in the south Linyi repeatedly raided Rinan. In the far west Sasanian Persia and Rome (Daqin) faced each other across the Euphrates, and in India remnants of the Kushans lingered.

snaps.d:
太康年间天下无事，晋武帝罢州郡兵，行占田、课田之制。285 年鲜卑慕容廆东破夫余，夫余王依虑自杀，次年晋东夷校尉何龛助其子依罗复国；289 年慕容廆归附于晋，徙居徒河之青山。十一月武帝以诸子分镇要地：秦王司马柬都督关中，楚王司马玮都督荆州，淮南王司马允都督扬、江，汝南王司马亮以大司马出镇许昌。
拓跋鲜卑据定襄盛乐，段部、宇文部分居辽西塞外，敕勒（高车）诸部游牧漠北。罗马戴克里先在位，287 年扶立梯里达底三世为亚美尼亚王。
snaps.te: Princes sent to regional posts · the Murong submit to Jin
snaps.de:
The Taikang era was a time of peace: Emperor Wu of Jin disbanded the provincial and commandery troops and introduced the zhantian and ketian land system. In 285 Murong Hui of the Xianbei crushed Buyeo in the east and its king Yilü killed himself; the next year He Kan, Jin Colonel of the Eastern Peoples, helped his son Yiluo restore the state. In 289 Murong Hui submitted to Jin and moved to Qingshan near Tuhe. In the 11th month Emperor Wu posted his sons to key regions: Sima Jian, Prince of Qin, commanded Guanzhong; Sima Wei, Prince of Chu, Jing Province; Sima Yun, Prince of Huainan, Yang and Jiang; and Sima Liang, Prince of Runan, went out as Grand Marshal to Xuchang.
The Tuoba Xianbei held Shengle in Dingxiang, the Duan and the Yuwen lived beyond the frontier of Liaoxi, and the Chile (Gaoche) tribes roamed north of the Gobi. In Rome Diocletian was on the throne, and in 287 he installed Tiridates III as King of Armenia.

snaps.d:
290 年武帝崩，惠帝即位，外戚杨骏辅政。291 年皇后贾南风先借楚王司马玮之手诛杨骏、杀汝南王司马亮，再以矫诏之罪诛司马玮，独揽朝政，八王之乱由此开端。294 年匈奴郝散起兵上党；296 年其弟郝度元联合冯翊、北地的马兰羌和卢水胡反晋，秦、雍二州氐羌推氐帅齐万年为帝，众七万，屯梁山，关中大乱。同年略阳氐人杨茂搜率部回到仇池，自号辅国将军、右贤王。
拓跋鲜卑 295 年分为三部：禄官居上谷之北，猗㐌居代郡参合陂，猗卢居定襄盛乐。慕容廆 294 年移居大棘城，教民农桑。
snaps.te: War of the Eight Princes begins · Qi Wannian rises
snaps.de:
Emperor Wu died in 290 and Emperor Hui took the throne, with Yang Jun, father of the empress dowager, as regent. In 291 Empress Jia Nanfeng first used Sima Wei, Prince of Chu, to execute Yang Jun and kill Sima Liang, Prince of Runan, then executed Sima Wei for forging an edict, taking sole control of the court — the beginning of the War of the Eight Princes. In 294 Hao San of the Xiongnu rose in Shangdang; in 296 his younger brother Hao Duyuan rebelled against Jin together with the Malan Qiang and the Lushui Hu of Pingyi and Beidi, and the Di and Qiang of Qin and Yong provinces made the Di chieftain Qi Wannian emperor; with seventy thousand men he camped at Liangshan, and Guanzhong was in turmoil. The same year Yang Maosou, a Di from Lüeyang, led his people back to Chouchi and styled himself General Who Supports the State and Worthy King of the Right.
In 295 the Tuoba Xianbei split into three: Luguan lived north of Shanggu, Yituo at Canhe Slope in Dai Commandery, and Yilu at Shengle in Dingxiang. In 294 Murong Hui moved to Daji City and taught his people farming and sericulture.

snaps.d:
297 年正月周处奉命以五千人击齐万年于六陌，力战而死；299 年正月孟观大破氐羌于中亭，生擒齐万年，关中平定。太子洗马江统作《徙戎论》，主张把关中氐羌、并州匈奴迁回故地，朝廷不能用。299 年十二月贾后诬太子司马遹谋反，废为庶人。
300 年三月贾后杀司马遹，四月赵王司马伦与孙秀矫诏废杀贾后，诛张华、裴頠，自为相国专政；八月淮南王司马允起兵讨伦，兵败被杀。冬，益州刺史赵廞据成都反，结纳流入巴蜀的略阳、天水六郡流民首领李特兄弟。
snaps.te: Sima Lun, Prince of Zhao, seizes power
snaps.de:
In the 1st month of 297 Zhou Chu was ordered to attack Qi Wannian at Liumo with five thousand men and died fighting hard; in the 1st month of 299 Meng Guan crushed the Di and Qiang at Zhongting and captured Qi Wannian alive, and Guanzhong was pacified. Jiang Tong, Librarian to the Crown Prince, wrote his Essay on Moving the Rong, urging that the Di and Qiang of Guanzhong and the Xiongnu of Bing Province be moved back to their old lands; the court could not act on it. In the 12th month of 299 Empress Jia falsely accused the crown prince Sima Yu of plotting rebellion and had him reduced to a commoner.
In the 3rd month of 300 Empress Jia killed Sima Yu; in the 4th month Sima Lun, Prince of Zhao, and Sun Xiu forged an edict, deposed and killed Empress Jia, executed Zhang Hua and Pei Wei, and Sima Lun made himself Chancellor of State and ruled alone; in the 8th month Sima Yun, Prince of Huainan, rose against him and was defeated and killed. In the winter Zhao Xin, Inspector of Yi Province, rebelled at Chengdu, winning over Li Te and his brothers, leaders of the refugees from six commanderies of Lüeyang and Tianshui who had flooded into Ba-Shu.

snaps.d:
正月赵王伦篡位，迁惠帝于金墉城。三月齐王司马冏在许昌、成都王司马颖在邺、河间王司马颙在长安起兵讨伦，常山王司马乂响应；四月伦兵败被赐死，惠帝复位，齐王冏以大司马辅政，颖、颙各还本镇，三王分据洛阳、河北、关中。
正月李特兄弟攻杀赵廞，朝廷派罗尚为益州刺史，催逼流民还乡；十月李特据绵竹起兵，流民十余万归附。同年张轨出任凉州刺史，保据河西，招抚中原流民。
snaps.te: Three princes move against Sima Lun · Li Te rises
snaps.de:
In the 1st month Sima Lun, Prince of Zhao, usurped the throne and moved Emperor Hui to Jinyong City. In the 3rd month Sima Jiong, Prince of Qi, rose at Xuchang, Sima Ying, Prince of Chengdu, at Ye, and Sima Yong, Prince of Hejian, at Chang'an against Sima Lun, and Sima Ai, Prince of Changshan, joined them; in the 4th month Sima Lun was defeated and ordered to take his own life, Emperor Hui was restored, and Sima Jiong became regent as Grand Marshal, while Sima Ying and Sima Yong returned to their own posts — the three princes divided Luoyang, Hebei and Guanzhong between them.
In the 1st month Li Te and his brothers attacked and killed Zhao Xin; the court sent Luo Shang as Inspector of Yi Province, and he pressed the refugees to go home; in the 10th month Li Te rose in arms at Mianzhu, and more than a hundred thousand refugees joined him. The same year Zhang Gui became Inspector of Liang Province, holding Hexi securely and taking in refugees from the Central Plain.

snaps.d:
齐王冏辅政后骄奢专断，大兴府第，不朝天子。河间王颙与成都王颖相约讨冏，十二月长沙王司马乂在洛阳抢先发难，率左右攻冏府，激战三日，斩冏及其党羽二千余人，乂掌朝政，颖、颙仍遥控于外。
巴蜀李特连败罗尚，攻破德阳，自称益州牧、大将军，改元建初；罗尚退保成都。
snaps.te: Sima Ai, Prince of Changsha, kills Sima Jiong, Prince of Qi
snaps.de:
As regent, Sima Jiong, Prince of Qi, grew arrogant and high-handed, building great mansions and failing to attend on the emperor. Sima Yong, Prince of Hejian, and Sima Ying, Prince of Chengdu, agreed to move against him, but in the 12th month Sima Ai, Prince of Changsha, struck first in Luoyang, leading his followers against Sima Jiong's residence; after three days of fierce fighting he beheaded Sima Jiong and more than two thousand of his partisans and took charge of the court, while Sima Ying and Sima Yong still pulled the strings from outside.
In Ba-Shu Li Te defeated Luo Shang again and again, took Deyang, styled himself Governor of Yi Province and Grand General, and proclaimed the era name Jianchu; Luo Shang fell back to hold Chengdu.

snaps.d:
正月李特攻入成都少城，三月被罗尚夜袭所杀，弟李流、子李雄继统流民，九月李流病死，李雄闰十二月攻占成都，罗尚出奔江阳。
五月义阳蛮张昌在江夏起事，立丘沈为天子，旬月之间荆、江、扬、徐、豫五州多被攻陷；荆州刺史刘弘遣陶侃大破张昌，其部将石冰仍据扬州及临淮。
八月河间王颙、成都王颖联兵讨长沙王乂，张方自关中、陆机自河北进逼洛阳；十月陆机在七里涧大败，被颖所杀，乂坚守洛阳。
snaps.te: Zhang Chang rises · Li Xiong enters Chengdu
snaps.de:
In the 1st month Li Te broke into the Lesser City of Chengdu, but in the 3rd month he was killed in a night attack by Luo Shang; his younger brother Li Liu and his son Li Xiong took over the refugees; in the 9th month Li Liu died of illness, and in the intercalary 12th month Li Xiong took Chengdu, and Luo Shang fled to Jiangyang.
In the 5th month Zhang Chang of the Yiyang tribes rose at Jiangxia and made Qiu Shen Son of Heaven; within a month much of the five provinces of Jing, Jiang, Yang, Xu and Yu had fallen. Liu Hong, Inspector of Jing Province, sent Tao Kan, who crushed Zhang Chang, but his general Shi Bing still held Yang Province and Linhuai.
In the 8th month Sima Yong, Prince of Hejian, and Sima Ying, Prince of Chengdu, joined forces against Sima Ai, Prince of Changsha, with Zhang Fang advancing on Luoyang from Guanzhong and Lu Ji from Hebei; in the 10th month Lu Ji was routed at Qilijian and killed by Sima Ying, while Sima Ai held Luoyang.

snaps.d:
正月东海王司马越执长沙王乂，乂被张方烧杀，成都王颖以丞相、皇太弟在邺遥执朝政。七月司马越挟惠帝北征，在荡阴被颖军大败，惠帝面中三箭、被俘入邺，嵇绍以身护帝而死，司马越逃回东海。八月幽州都督王浚联合段部鲜卑、乌桓突骑与并州刺史司马腾攻邺，颖挟帝逃奔洛阳；十一月张方又劫帝与颖西入长安，朝政尽归河间王颙。
十月匈奴左贤王刘渊在离石左国城称汉王（汉赵），李雄在成都称成都王（成汉），北方与巴蜀同年出现两个割据政权。陈敏击灭石冰，江东复归晋。
snaps.te: Battle of Dangyin · Han and Cheng founded side by side
snaps.de:
In the 1st month Sima Yue, Prince of Donghai, seized Sima Ai, Prince of Changsha, who was burned to death by Zhang Fang, and Sima Ying, Prince of Chengdu, as Chancellor and Imperial Younger Brother and heir, directed the court from Ye. In the 7th month Sima Yue took Emperor Hui north on campaign and was routed by Sima Ying's army at Dangyin; the emperor was struck in the face by three arrows and carried captive into Ye, Ji Shao died shielding him with his body, and Sima Yue fled back to Donghai. In the 8th month Wang Jun, Area Commander of You Province, with Duan Xianbei and Wuhuan shock cavalry, joined Sima Teng, Inspector of Bing Province, in attacking Ye, and Sima Ying fled to Luoyang with the emperor; in the 11th month Zhang Fang carried off the emperor and Sima Ying west to Chang'an, and the court passed wholly to Sima Yong, Prince of Hejian.
In the 10th month Liu Yuan, Worthy King of the Left of the Xiongnu, proclaimed himself King of Han at Zuoguo City near Lishi (Han Zhao), and Li Xiong proclaimed himself King of Chengdu at Chengdu (Cheng Han): in the same year two breakaway regimes appeared, in the north and in Ba-Shu. Chen Min destroyed Shi Bing, and Jiangdong returned to Jin.

snaps.t: 东海王越起兵·陈敏据江东
snaps.d:
七月东海王司马越传檄山东，以奉迎天子为名起兵，范阳王司马虓、幽州王浚、并州司马腾响应；河间王颙以刘乔为豫州刺史拒之，十月刘乔袭破许昌，逐走范阳王虓，虓北奔河北，据有冀州。成都王颖的旧将公师藩、汲桑、石勒起兵赵魏，以复颖为名。
十二月广陵相陈敏据历阳反，自称楚公、都督江东诸军事，逐走扬州刺史，尽有江东。汉王刘渊与司马腾争夺并州，离石大饥，刘渊南迁黎亭。
snaps.te: Sima Yue, Prince of Donghai, takes up arms · Chen Min holds Jiangdong
snaps.de:
In the 7th month Sima Yue, Prince of Donghai, sent proclamations throughout the east and rose in arms in the name of bringing back the Son of Heaven; Sima Xiao, Prince of Fanyang, Wang Jun of You Province and Sima Teng of Bing Province answered his call. Sima Yong, Prince of Hejian, made Liu Qiao Inspector of Yu Province to oppose them; in the 10th month Liu Qiao took Xuchang by surprise and drove out Sima Xiao, who fled north to Hebei and held Ji Province. Gongshi Fan, Ji Sang and Shi Le, old officers of Sima Ying, Prince of Chengdu, rose in Zhao and Wei in the name of restoring him.
In the 12th month Chen Min, Chancellor of Guangling, rebelled at Liyang, styled himself Duke of Chu and Commander of all Armies of Jiangdong, drove out the Inspector of Yang Province and held the whole of Jiangdong. Liu Yuan, King of Han, fought Sima Teng for Bing Province; Lishi suffered a great famine, and Liu Yuan moved south to Liting.

snaps.d:
正月范阳王虓、王浚击破刘乔，王浚部将祁弘率鲜卑突骑西进，五月攻入长安，大掠，杀二万余人，河间王颙逃入太白山；六月惠帝东归洛阳，东海王越执政。十月成都王颖被缢杀；十一月惠帝食饼中毒而崩，皇太弟司马炽即位（怀帝）；十二月颙应召入朝，途中被南阳王司马模所杀。八王之乱终结，八王中只有东海王越幸存。
六月李雄在成都称帝，国号大成。东燕王司马腾转镇邺城，刘琨继任并州刺史，汉军已据并州大半。
snaps.te: Emperor Hui returns east · War of the Eight Princes ends
snaps.de:
In the 1st month Sima Xiao, Prince of Fanyang, and Wang Jun crushed Liu Qiao; Wang Jun's general Qi Hong advanced west with Xianbei shock cavalry, broke into Chang'an in the 5th month and plundered it, killing more than twenty thousand people, and Sima Yong, Prince of Hejian, fled into the Taibai Mountains; in the 6th month Emperor Hui returned east to Luoyang and Sima Yue, Prince of Donghai, took charge of the government. In the 10th month Sima Ying, Prince of Chengdu, was strangled; in the 11th month Emperor Hui died after eating poisoned cakes, and the Imperial Younger Brother Sima Chi took the throne (Emperor Huai); in the 12th month Sima Yong, summoned to court, was killed on the way by Sima Mo, Prince of Nanyang. The War of the Eight Princes was over; of the eight, only Sima Yue survived.
In the 6th month Li Xiong proclaimed himself emperor at Chengdu, naming his state Great Cheng. Sima Teng, Prince of Dongyan, moved his post to Ye, Liu Kun succeeded him as Inspector of Bing Province, and the Han army already held most of Bing Province.

snaps.t: 司马睿镇建邺·汲桑石勒破邺
snaps.d:
二月陈敏部将甘卓、顾荣等倒戈，陈敏兵败被杀，江东复归晋。五月汲桑、石勒为成都王颖复仇，攻破邺城，杀司马腾，焚邺宫；兖州刺史苟晞连破之，汲桑被杀，石勒投奔汉王刘渊。七月东海王越以琅邪王司马睿都督扬州诸军事，九月司马睿渡江镇建邺，以王导为谋主，结纳江东士族。
同年王弥起兵青、徐，刘琨抵晋阳，招集流亡，北结拓跋，与刘渊相持。东海王越出镇许昌。
snaps.te: Sima Rui takes post at Jianye · Ji Sang and Shi Le sack Ye
snaps.de:
In the 2nd month Chen Min's officers Gan Zhuo, Gu Rong and others turned against him, Chen Min was defeated and killed, and Jiangdong returned to Jin. In the 5th month Ji Sang and Shi Le, avenging Sima Ying, Prince of Chengdu, took Ye, killed Sima Teng and burned the palaces of Ye; Gou Xi, Inspector of Yan Province, defeated them again and again, Ji Sang was killed, and Shi Le went over to Liu Yuan, King of Han. In the 7th month Sima Yue, Prince of Donghai, gave Sima Rui, Prince of Langya, command over the armies of Yang Province; in the 9th month Sima Rui crossed the Yangtze to take up his post at Jianye, with Wang Dao as his chief adviser, and won over the great families of Jiangdong.
The same year Wang Mi rose in Qing and Xu, and Liu Kun reached Jinyang, gathered the displaced, allied himself with the Tuoba in the north, and held out against Liu Yuan. Sima Yue went out to Xuchang.

snaps.era2: 汉永凤元年
snaps.d: 正月汉军攻陷平阳、河东诸县，刘渊据有汾水流域；石勒、王弥纵横冀、兖、豫诸州，所过残灭。五月王弥自许昌攻入洛阳近郊，焚建春门，被东海王越部将王秉击退，转投刘渊。十月刘渊在蒲子即皇帝位，改元永凤，以刘聪、刘曜、石勒、王弥分道南下。慕容廆自称鲜卑大单于。
snaps.te: Liu Yuan proclaims himself emperor · Wang Mi raids Luoyang
snaps.de: In the 1st month the Han army took Pingyang and the counties of Hedong, and Liu Yuan held the Fen valley; Shi Le and Wang Mi ranged across Ji, Yan and Yu provinces, laying waste wherever they went. In the 5th month Wang Mi pushed from Xuchang into the outskirts of Luoyang and burned the Jianchun Gate, but was driven off by Wang Bing, a general of Sima Yue, Prince of Donghai, and went over to Liu Yuan. In the 10th month Liu Yuan took the imperial throne at Puzi, proclaimed the era name Yongfeng, and sent Liu Cong, Liu Yao, Shi Le and Wang Mi south along separate routes. Murong Hui styled himself Grand Chanyu of the Xianbei.

snaps.era2: 汉河瑞元年
snaps.d: 正月刘渊迁都平阳。三月东海王越入洛阳，诛杀王延、缪播等怀帝亲信，朝政尽归东海王府。七月汉将刘聪、王弥攻破壶关，晋上党太守降汉；八月刘聪进攻洛阳，弘农太守垣延诈降夜袭，汉军败退；十月刘聪再攻洛阳，久围不下撤回。石勒连破冀州郡县，河北残破。
snaps.te: Han makes Pingyang its capital · two attacks on Luoyang
snaps.de: In the 1st month Liu Yuan moved his capital to Pingyang. In the 3rd month Sima Yue, Prince of Donghai, entered Luoyang and executed Wang Yan (王延), Miao Bo and other confidants of Emperor Huai, and the government passed wholly to his headquarters. In the 7th month the Han generals Liu Cong and Wang Mi took Huguan, and the Jin Administrator of Shangdang surrendered to Han; in the 8th month Liu Cong attacked Luoyang, but Yuan Yan, Administrator of Hongnong, feigned surrender and attacked by night, and the Han army fell back; in the 10th month Liu Cong attacked Luoyang again, besieged it for a long time without success, and withdrew. Shi Le took the commanderies and counties of Ji Province one after another, and Hebei lay in ruins.

snaps.era2: 汉光兴元年
snaps.d:
七月刘渊病死，太子刘和欲除诸弟，反为楚王刘聪所杀，刘聪即位。石勒南渡黄河，攻掠襄城、宛，转战江汉；关中流民王如在宛起兵，众至四五万，进围襄阳。
拓跋猗卢助刘琨击破铁弗匈奴刘虎与白部鲜卑，刘虎退走朔方。晋封猗卢为代公，以句注陉以北马邑、阴馆、楼烦、繁畤、崞五县之地与之。洛阳饥困，十一月东海王越率甲士四万出屯项城，朝廷空虚。
snaps.te: Liu Cong takes the throne · the Tuoba gain the lands north of the Gouzhu Defile
snaps.de:
In the 7th month Liu Yuan died of illness; the crown prince Liu He tried to do away with his brothers and was himself killed by Liu Cong, Prince of Chu, who took the throne. Shi Le crossed the Yellow River southward, raided Xiangcheng and Wan, and fought his way through the Jiang–Han region; Wang Ru, a leader of refugees from Guanzhong, rose at Wan, his following grew to forty or fifty thousand, and he advanced to besiege Xiangyang.
Tuoba Yilu helped Liu Kun crush Liu Hu of the Tiefu Xiongnu and the Bai Xianbei, and Liu Hu fled to Shuofang. Jin made Yilu Duke of Dai and gave him five counties north of the Gouzhu Defile — Mayi, Yinguan, Loufan, Fanzhi and Guo. Luoyang was starving and hard-pressed; in the 11th month Sima Yue, Prince of Donghai, went out with forty thousand armored men to garrison Xiangcheng, leaving the court empty.

snaps.era2: 汉嘉平元年
snaps.d:
三月东海王越病死项城，部众十余万由王衍率领东归，四月在苦县宁平城被石勒骑兵追及围歼，王衍等被杀。六月刘曜、王弥、石勒攻破洛阳，纵兵烧掠，杀王公士民三万余人，怀帝被俘送平阳，史称永嘉之乱。八月刘曜攻陷长安，南阳王模被杀。九月石勒在蒙城擒苟晞，十月又在己吾宴杀王弥，并其部众；王弥部将曹嶷据有青州。
司马睿击灭江州刺史华轶、扬州都督周馥，据有长江中下游。湘州流民推杜弢为主，起兵长沙。中原士民相率南渡江左，“衣冠南渡”。
snaps.te: Disaster of Yongjia
snaps.de:
In the 3rd month Sima Yue, Prince of Donghai, died of illness at Xiangcheng; his army of more than a hundred thousand was led back east by Wang Yan (王衍), and in the 4th month it was overtaken by Shi Le's cavalry at Ningping City in Ku County, surrounded and wiped out, and Wang Yan and others were killed. In the 6th month Liu Yao, Wang Mi and Shi Le took Luoyang, let their troops burn and loot, and killed more than thirty thousand princes, officials and townspeople; Emperor Huai was captured and sent to Pingyang — the Disaster of Yongjia. In the 8th month Liu Yao took Chang'an and Sima Mo, Prince of Nanyang, was killed. In the 9th month Shi Le captured Gou Xi at Mengcheng, and in the 10th month he invited Wang Mi to a banquet at Jiwu, killed him and absorbed his army; Wang Mi's general Cao Ni held Qing Province.
Sima Rui destroyed Hua Yi, Inspector of Jiang Province, and Zhou Fu, Area Commander of Yang Province, and held the middle and lower Yangtze. The refugees of Xiang Province chose Du Tao as their leader and rose at Changsha. The gentry and people of the Central Plain crossed south of the Yangtze one after another — "the flight of the caps and gowns to the south".

snaps.era2: 汉嘉平二年
snaps.d: 石勒在葛陂屯兵三月，遇连雨、饥疫，用张宾之计北还，七月据襄国，以此为根据经营河北。四月安定太守贾疋等联兵逐刘曜，收复长安；九月秦王司马邺被迎入长安，立为皇太子。汉将刘粲袭取晋阳，刘琨借拓跋猗卢之兵收复。幽州王浚在怀帝被俘后另立皇太子，名为奉晋，实则自专。王如降于王敦。
snaps.te: Shi Le holds Xiangguo · Jin retakes Chang'an
snaps.de: Shi Le camped at Gebei for three months; beset by incessant rain, famine and disease, he followed Zhang Bin's plan and went back north, and in the 7th month he occupied Xiangguo, which became his base for building up Hebei. In the 4th month Jia Ya, Administrator of Anding, and others joined forces, drove out Liu Yao and recovered Chang'an; in the 9th month Sima Ye, Prince of Qin, was welcomed into Chang'an and made crown prince. The Han general Liu Can seized Jinyang by surprise, and Liu Kun recovered it with troops borrowed from Tuoba Yilu. After Emperor Huai's capture, Wang Jun in You Province set up a crown prince of his own — serving Jin in name, acting for himself in fact. Wang Ru surrendered to Wang Dun.

snaps.era2: 汉嘉平三年
snaps.d:
正月汉主刘聪在平阳毒死怀帝，四月皇太子司马邺在长安即位（愍帝），以琅邪王司马睿为左丞相、南阳王司马保为右丞相，令分陕东西出兵，但江东、秦州皆不发兵。石虎攻破邺城三台。八月祖逖以奋威将军、豫州刺史率部曲百余家渡江北伐，中流击楫而誓“不能清中原而复济者，有如大江”。
高句丽美川王攻灭乐浪郡，汉魏晋在朝鲜半岛延续四百余年的郡县统治告终。陶侃在荆州屡破杜弢。
snaps.te: Emperor Min takes the throne · Zu Ti crosses the Yangtze
snaps.de:
In the 1st month the Han ruler Liu Cong poisoned Emperor Huai at Pingyang; in the 4th month the crown prince Sima Ye took the throne at Chang'an (Emperor Min), made Sima Rui, Prince of Langya, Chancellor of the Left and Sima Bao, Prince of Nanyang, Chancellor of the Right, and ordered them to send troops from east and west of Shan, but neither Jiangdong nor Qin Province sent any. Shi Hu took the Three Terraces of Ye. In the 8th month Zu Ti, as General of Roused Might and Inspector of Yu Province, crossed the Yangtze on a northern expedition with over a hundred households of his retainers, striking his oar in midstream and swearing: "If I cannot clear the Central Plain and cross back, may I be like this great river!"
King Micheon of Goguryeo destroyed Lelang Commandery, ending more than four hundred years of the commandery rule of the Han, Wei and Jin on the Korean peninsula. Tao Kan defeated Du Tao again and again in Jing Province.

snaps.era2: 汉嘉平四年
snaps.d: 三月石勒诈称奉戴王浚为帝，率轻骑袭入蓟城，擒王浚斩于襄国，焚其宫殿而还；石勒所置守将随即降于段部鲜卑段匹磾，段匹磾以晋幽州刺史据蓟。高句丽又取带方郡。五月凉州刺史张轨卒，子张寔继任，仍奉晋室正朔。汉主刘聪纵情游宴，以子刘粲为相国，政事日乱。
snaps.te: Shi Le captures Wang Jun
snaps.de: In the 3rd month Shi Le pretended that he wished to make Wang Jun emperor, broke into Ji City with light cavalry, captured Wang Jun and beheaded him at Xiangguo, burning his palace before returning; the commanders Shi Le left behind promptly surrendered to Duan Pidi of the Duan Xianbei, who held Ji as Jin Inspector of You Province. Goguryeo also took Daifang Commandery. In the 5th month Zhang Gui, Inspector of Liang Province, died, and his son Zhang Shi succeeded him, still following the Jin calendar. The Han ruler Liu Cong gave himself over to pleasure and banquets, made his son Liu Can Chancellor of State, and government fell into growing disorder.

snaps.era2: 汉建元元年
snaps.d: 陶侃、周访等平定杜弢，荆、湘二州复归晋；王敦以功都督江、扬、荆、湘、交、广六州，自领江州刺史，排挤陶侃出任广州刺史，自此专制长江上游。二月拓跋猗卢被晋进封为代王，置百官，以盛乐为北都、平城为南都。汉将刘曜连年攻掠关中，长安困蹙。石勒蚕食河北郡县。
snaps.te: Du Tao suppressed · the Tuoba ruler made King of Dai
snaps.de: Tao Kan, Zhou Fang and others put down Du Tao, and Jing and Xiang provinces returned to Jin; for his part Wang Dun was given command of six provinces — Jiang, Yang, Jing, Xiang, Jiao and Guang — and kept the post of Inspector of Jiang Province for himself, pushing Tao Kan out to be Inspector of Guang Province, and from then on he ruled the upper Yangtze as he pleased. In the 2nd month Jin raised Tuoba Yilu to King of Dai; he set up a bureaucracy, with Shengle as his northern capital and Pingcheng as his southern capital. The Han general Liu Yao raided Guanzhong year after year, and Chang'an was hard-pressed. Shi Le nibbled away at the commanderies and counties of Hebei.

snaps.era2: 汉麟嘉元年
snaps.d:
三月代王猗卢被其子六修所杀，代国内乱，卫雄、姬澹率晋人、乌桓三万家奔并州，刘琨实力大增却不久失之。八月刘曜围长安，城中斗米值金二两，人相食；十一月愍帝乘羊车、肉袒衔璧出降，被送往平阳，西晋灭亡。十二月石勒在乐平击败刘琨，并州归于石勒，刘琨北投幽州段匹磾。
至此长江以北奉晋正朔的只剩凉州张寔、秦州司马保、幽州段匹磾、乐陵厌次的邵续和祖逖等孤立的据点；江东司马睿集团成为晋室的唯一依托。
snaps.te: Fall of Chang'an · end of Western Jin
snaps.de:
In the 3rd month Yilu, King of Dai, was killed by his son Liuxiu, and Dai fell into civil strife; Wei Xiong and Ji Dan fled to Bing Province with thirty thousand households of Chinese and Wuhuan, greatly strengthening Liu Kun, who soon lost them again. In the 8th month Liu Yao besieged Chang'an; inside the city a peck of grain cost two taels of gold, and people ate one another; in the 11th month Emperor Min rode out in a goat cart, stripped to the waist with a jade disc in his mouth, and surrendered; he was sent to Pingyang, and the Western Jin came to an end. In the 12th month Shi Le defeated Liu Kun at Leping, Bing Province passed to Shi Le, and Liu Kun fled north to Duan Pidi in You Province.
Now the only places north of the Yangtze that still kept the Jin calendar were isolated strongholds — Zhang Shi in Liang Province, Sima Bao in Qin Province, Duan Pidi in You Province, Shao Xu at Yanci in Leling, and Zu Ti; Sima Rui's circle in Jiangdong had become the Jin house's only support.

snaps.era2: 汉光初元年
snaps.d:
317 年三月琅邪王司马睿得知长安陷落，在建康称晋王；十二月愍帝在平阳遇害，318 年三月司马睿即皇帝位（元帝），东晋建立，王导主内、王敦主外，时称“王与马，共天下”。
七月汉主刘聪病死，太子刘粲即位，八月外戚靳准发动政变，尽杀刘氏男女，自称汉天王。镇守长安的刘曜十月即帝位，石勒自襄国进军平阳，十二月靳氏内乱，平阳归于石勒，焚其宫室。刘曜封石勒为赵公，石勒名为臣属，实已自立。凉州张寔仍用愍帝建兴年号，不奉建康诏令。段匹磾杀刘琨。
snaps.te: Eastern Jin founded · Jin Zhun's coup
snaps.de:
In the 3rd month of 317 Sima Rui, Prince of Langya, learning that Chang'an had fallen, took the title King of Jin at Jiankang; in the 12th month Emperor Min was murdered at Pingyang, and in the 3rd month of 318 Sima Rui ascended the imperial throne (Emperor Yuan) and the Eastern Jin was founded, with Wang Dao in charge at court and Wang Dun in charge in the provinces — as people said then, "the Wang and the Ma share the realm".
In the 7th month the Han ruler Liu Cong died of illness and the crown prince Liu Can took the throne; in the 8th month Jin Zhun, the empress's father, staged a coup, killed every man and woman of the Liu clan, and styled himself Heavenly King of Han. Liu Yao, guarding Chang'an, took the imperial throne in the 10th month, and Shi Le marched on Pingyang from Xiangguo; in the 12th month the Jin (靳) clan fell into strife, and Pingyang passed to Shi Le, who burned its palaces. Liu Yao made Shi Le Duke of Zhao; Shi Le was nominally his subject but had in fact made himself independent. Zhang Shi in Liang Province still used Emperor Min's era name Jianxing and did not follow edicts from Jiankang. Duan Pidi killed Liu Kun.

snaps.era2: 前赵光初二年 · 后赵赵王元年
snaps.d:
六月刘曜迁都长安，改国号为赵（前赵）；十一月石勒在襄国称赵王，与刘曜决裂（后赵），以张宾为谋主，北方形成东西二赵对峙。
祖逖进屯雍丘一带，与后赵将领桃豹相持，攻取谯城。慕容廆击退平州刺史崔毖联合高句丽、宇文部、段部的进攻，尽有辽东。南方周访击斩杜曾，平定襄阳一带。秦州司马保自称晋王，与前赵、东晋皆不相统属。
snaps.era2e: Former Zhao: Guangchu 2 · Later Zhao: King of Zhao 1
snaps.te: Former Zhao and Later Zhao split
snaps.de:
In the 6th month Liu Yao moved his capital to Chang'an and renamed his state Zhao (Former Zhao); in the 11th month Shi Le proclaimed himself King of Zhao at Xiangguo and broke with Liu Yao (Later Zhao), with Zhang Bin as his chief adviser: in the north two Zhaos now faced each other, east and west.
Zu Ti advanced to the area of Yongqiu, held off the Later Zhao general Tao Bao, and took the city of Qiao. Murong Hui repelled an attack by Cui Bi, Inspector of Ping Province, together with Goguryeo, the Yuwen and the Duan, and took all of Liaodong. In the south Zhou Fang beheaded Du Zeng and pacified the area of Xiangyang. Sima Bao in Qin Province styled himself King of Jin, owing allegiance to neither the Former Zhao nor the Eastern Jin.

snaps.era2: 前赵光初三年 · 后赵赵王二年
snaps.d: 祖逖抚纳坞主、劝课农桑，以布囊盛土诈称军粮，使后赵军心动摇，黄河以南大片土地复归晋朝，后赵镇戍多来归附，石勒不敢南犯，遣使请修祖逖祖墓、互通市易。二月后赵石虎擒邵续，孔苌攻下其别营十一，段匹磾自蓟赶回，与邵续子侄据守厌次。五月秦州司马保被部将张春所杀，陇右诸郡多附前赵。六月前凉张寔被部下刺杀，弟张茂继立。
snaps.era2e: Former Zhao: Guangchu 3 · Later Zhao: King of Zhao 2
snaps.te: Zu Ti recovers the lands south of the Yellow River
snaps.de: Zu Ti won over the masters of the fortified villages and encouraged farming and sericulture; filling cloth sacks with earth and passing them off as army grain, he shook the morale of the Later Zhao army, and much of the land south of the Yellow River returned to Jin. Many Later Zhao garrisons came over to him; Shi Le dared not raid southward and sent envoys asking to repair the tombs of Zu Ti's ancestors and to open trade. In the 2nd month Shi Hu of the Later Zhao captured Shao Xu, and Kong Chang took his eleven outlying camps; Duan Pidi hurried back from Ji and held Yanci with Shao Xu's son and nephews. In the 5th month Sima Bao in Qin Province was killed by his general Zhang Chun, and most of the commanderies of Longyou went over to the Former Zhao. In the 6th month Zhang Shi of the Former Liang was assassinated by his own men, and his younger brother Zhang Mao succeeded him.

snaps.era2: 前赵光初五年 · 后赵赵王四年
snaps.d: 321 年九月祖逖忧愤病卒于雍丘，弟祖约继领其众，河南诸城渐入后赵；同年后赵石虎攻灭据守厌次的段匹磾，幽州全入后赵，代国拓跋郁律被杀。322 年正月王敦以诛刘隗、刁协为名，自武昌起兵东下，三月攻入建康，元帝屈服，王敦自为丞相，还镇武昌遥控朝政；闰十一月元帝忧愤而死，明帝即位。后赵乘机攻取襄城、城父、谯郡，祖约退守寿春。
snaps.era2e: Former Zhao: Guangchu 5 · Later Zhao: King of Zhao 4
snaps.te: Wang Dun's rebellion
snaps.de: In the 9th month of 321 Zu Ti died of grief and illness at Yongqiu; his younger brother Zu Yue took over his army, and the cities of Henan gradually passed to the Later Zhao. The same year Shi Hu of the Later Zhao destroyed Duan Pidi, who was holding Yanci, and all of You Province passed to the Later Zhao; Tuoba Yulü of Dai was killed. In the 1st month of 322 Wang Dun rose at Wuchang and went down the Yangtze, claiming he would execute Liu Wei and Diao Xie; in the 3rd month he broke into Jiankang, Emperor Yuan gave in, and Wang Dun made himself Chancellor and returned to Wuchang to control the court from afar; in the intercalary 11th month Emperor Yuan died of grief and anger, and Emperor Ming took the throne. The Later Zhao seized the chance to take Xiangcheng, Chengfu and Qiao Commandery, and Zu Yue fell back to hold Shouchun.

snaps.era2: 前赵光初七年 · 后赵赵王六年
snaps.d: 323 年后赵石虎攻破广固，杀曹嶷，青州归后赵；前赵刘曜平定陇上陈安，亲率大军临黄河，前凉张茂称藩于前赵，河南之地（枹罕一带）归前赵。324 年王敦再次谋逆，以兄王含为元帅进逼建康，明帝亲率诸军抵御，七月王敦病死，叛军瓦解。前赵、后赵在洛阳、河内一带反复争夺。
snaps.era2e: Former Zhao: Guangchu 7 · Later Zhao: King of Zhao 6
snaps.te: Wang Dun's rebellion put down
snaps.de: In 323 Shi Hu of the Later Zhao took Guanggu and killed Cao Ni, and Qing Province passed to the Later Zhao; Liu Yao of the Former Zhao put down Chen An in Longshang and led a great army to the Yellow River in person, Zhang Mao of the Former Liang submitted to the Former Zhao as a vassal, and the land south of the river (around Fuhan) passed to the Former Zhao. In 324 Wang Dun plotted rebellion again and sent his elder brother Wang Han as commander-in-chief against Jiankang; Emperor Ming led the armies in person to resist, and in the 7th month Wang Dun died of illness and the rebel army fell apart. The Former Zhao and the Later Zhao fought back and forth over the area of Luoyang and Henei.

snaps.era2: 前赵光初十一年 · 后赵太和元年
snaps.d:
325 年后赵石虎大破前赵刘岳于洛阳，司、豫、徐、兖之地尽归后赵。327 年庾亮执政，征历阳内史苏峻入朝，苏峻联合寿春祖约起兵，328 年二月攻入建康，挟持成帝，纵兵大掠；祖约失寿春于后赵。温峤、陶侃举荆、江之兵东下讨伐，九月苏峻战死，余众仍据石头城。
北方前赵刘曜大破石虎于高候，围攻洛阳金墉城；十二月石勒亲率大军渡河，刘曜醉酒出战，在洛阳城西被俘。
snaps.era2e: Former Zhao: Guangchu 11 · Later Zhao: Taihe 1
snaps.te: Su Jun's rebellion · Battle of Luoyang
snaps.de:
In 325 Shi Hu of the Later Zhao crushed Liu Yue of the Former Zhao at Luoyang, and the lands of Si, Yu, Xu and Yan provinces all passed to the Later Zhao. In 327 Yu Liang, now in charge of the government, summoned Su Jun, Administrator of Liyang, to court; Su Jun rose in arms together with Zu Yue at Shouchun, and in the 2nd month of 328 he broke into Jiankang, seized Emperor Cheng and let his troops plunder at will; Zu Yue lost Shouchun to the Later Zhao. Wen Jiao and Tao Kan brought the armies of Jing and Jiang down the Yangtze to punish him; in the 9th month Su Jun was killed in battle, but his remaining forces still held Shitou City.
In the north Liu Yao of the Former Zhao crushed Shi Hu at Gaohou and besieged Jinyong City at Luoyang; in the 12th month Shi Le crossed the Yellow River at the head of a great army, and Liu Yao, going out to fight drunk, was captured west of Luoyang.

snaps.era2: 后赵太和二年
snaps.d:
正月前赵太子刘熙放弃长安奔上邽；八月刘胤率众反攻长安，石虎大破之，九月攻克上邽，杀刘熙、刘胤等王公将校三千余人，前赵灭亡，关陇尽归后赵，次年石勒称帝。东晋二月平定苏峻余部，建康宫阙残破，王导力主不迁都；陶侃都督荆、江等八州，镇武昌，郗鉴镇京口。
前凉张骏乘前赵之亡收复河南之地，327 年已置高昌郡，西域长史仍驻楼兰海头。慕容吐谷浑之孙叶延以祖名为国号，据有洮水以西、青海以南（吐谷浑）。天竺笈多王朝在摩揭陀兴起（320）。
snaps.te: Fall of Former Zhao
snaps.de:
In the 1st month Liu Xi, crown prince of the Former Zhao, abandoned Chang'an and fled to Shanggui; in the 8th month Liu Yin led a counterattack on Chang'an and was crushed by Shi Hu, who took Shanggui in the 9th month and killed Liu Xi, Liu Yin and more than three thousand princes, ministers and officers: the Former Zhao fell, all of Guanlong passed to the Later Zhao, and the following year Shi Le proclaimed himself emperor. The Eastern Jin put down the remnants of Su Jun's forces in the 2nd month; the palaces of Jiankang lay in ruins, and Wang Dao argued strongly against moving the capital. Tao Kan commanded eight provinces including Jing and Jiang from Wuchang, and Xi Jian was stationed at Jingkou.
Zhang Jun of the Former Liang took advantage of the Former Zhao's fall to recover the lands south of the river; he had already set up Gaochang Commandery in 327, and the Chief Clerk of the Western Regions was still stationed at Haitou in Loulan. Yeyan, grandson of Murong Tuyuhun, made his grandfather's name the name of his state, holding the land west of the Tao and south of Qinghai (the Tuyuhun). In India the Gupta dynasty rose in Magadha (320).

snaps.era2: 后赵建武元年
snaps.d:
330 年石勒称帝，后赵东起辽西，西至陇右，南抵淮、汉，据北方大半；郭敬一度攻取襄阳，332 年为晋将桓宣收复。333 年七月石勒病死，次年石虎废杀石弘自立，335 年迁都于邺，大兴宫室、广征民女。
成汉李寿 333 年攻取宁州，南中尽入成汉；334 年李雄卒，宗室相残。东晋陶侃 334 年卒，庾亮代镇武昌，都督江、荆、豫等六州。慕容廆 333 年卒，子慕容皝继位，与弟慕容仁争辽东。
snaps.te: Shi Hu moves to Ye · Cheng Han takes Ning Province
snaps.de:
In 330 Shi Le proclaimed himself emperor; the Later Zhao stretched from Liaoxi in the east to Longyou in the west and to the Huai and Han in the south, holding most of the north. Guo Jing took Xiangyang for a time, but the Jin general Huan Xuan (桓宣) recovered it in 332. In the 7th month of 333 Shi Le died of illness; the next year Shi Hu deposed and killed Shi Hong and took the throne himself, and in 335 he moved the capital to Ye, building palaces on a grand scale and conscripting women from among the people.
Li Shou of Cheng Han took Ning Province in 333, and all of Nanzhong passed to Cheng Han; Li Xiong died in 334 and the imperial clan turned on itself. Tao Kan of the Eastern Jin died in 334, and Yu Liang replaced him at Wuchang, commanding six provinces including Jiang, Jing and Yu. Murong Hui died in 333 and his son Murong Huang succeeded him, contending with his younger brother Murong Ren for Liaodong.

snaps.era2: 后赵建武四年
snaps.d:
337 年慕容皝自称燕王（前燕）。338 年前燕与后赵合攻段部，段辽败走密云山，段部亡；后赵随即移兵围攻前燕都城大棘城十余日，慕容恪追击溃退的赵军，斩获三万余级，前燕尽收段部故地以北。
同年拓跋什翼犍即代王位，设置百官，建元建国，代国复振；成汉李寿杀李期自立，改国号为汉。东晋庾亮谋北伐未果。
snaps.te: Former Yan claims kingship · Dai revived
snaps.de:
In 337 Murong Huang styled himself King of Yan (Former Yan). In 338 the Former Yan and the Later Zhao attacked the Duan together; Duan Liao fled defeated to the Miyun Mountains, and the Duan came to an end. The Later Zhao then turned its army on the Former Yan and besieged its capital, Daji City, for more than ten days; Murong Ke pursued the retreating Zhao army and took more than thirty thousand heads, and the Former Yan took over all the former Duan lands to the north.
The same year Tuoba Shiyijian became King of Dai, set up a bureaucracy and proclaimed the era name Jianguo, and Dai revived; Li Shou of Cheng Han killed Li Qi, took the throne himself and renamed the state Han. Yu Liang of the Eastern Jin planned a northern expedition that came to nothing.

snaps.era2: 后赵建武十二年
snaps.d:
341 年慕容皝筑龙城，次年迁都，并亲率精兵奇袭高句丽，攻破丸都，掘美川王墓，掳王母及男女五万口而还；344 年慕容皝亲征宇文部，宇文逸豆归远走漠北而死，宇文部亡。346 年正月慕容恪等率骑兵袭夫余，俘夫余王玄及部众五万余口。
东晋庾翼 345 年卒，桓温出任荆州刺史，都督荆、司等六州，十一月率军溯江伐蜀。朝鲜半岛西南的百济在近肖古王时崛起。
snaps.te: Former Yan destroys the Yuwen · crushes Buyeo
snaps.de:
In 341 Murong Huang built Longcheng and moved his capital there the next year; he led his best troops in a surprise attack on Goguryeo, sacked Hwando, dug up the tomb of King Micheon, and returned with the king's mother and fifty thousand men and women as captives. In 344 Murong Huang campaigned in person against the Yuwen; Yuwen Yidougui fled far north of the Gobi and died, and the Yuwen came to an end. In the 1st month of 346 Murong Ke and others led cavalry in a surprise attack on Buyeo, capturing King Hyeon of Buyeo and more than fifty thousand of his people.
Yu Yi of the Eastern Jin died in 345, and Huan Wen became Inspector of Jing Province with command over six provinces including Jing and Si; in the 11th month he led his army up the Yangtze against Shu. In southwestern Korea Baekje rose to power under King Geunchogo.

snaps.era2: 后赵建武十三年
snaps.d: 三月桓温率军直趋成都，在笮桥决战，晋军前锋失利，桓温督众力战，大破汉军，李势出降，成汉灭亡，巴蜀、南中复归东晋。后赵石虎以麻秋等攻前凉，前凉谢艾在枹罕一带大破之。林邑王范文攻陷日南郡，杀太守夏侯览，此后日南北部长期为林邑所据。
snaps.te: Huan Wen conquers Cheng Han
snaps.de: In the 3rd month Huan Wen led his army straight for Chengdu and fought a decisive battle at Zuoqiao; the Jin vanguard faltered, but Huan Wen urged his men on to fight hard and crushed the Han army. Li Shi surrendered, Cheng Han fell, and Ba-Shu and Nanzhong returned to the Eastern Jin. Shi Hu of the Later Zhao sent Ma Qiu and others against the Former Liang, and Xie Ai of the Former Liang crushed them around Fuhan. Fan Wen, King of Linyi, took Rinan Commandery and killed its Administrator Xiahou Lan; thereafter the northern part of Rinan was long held by Linyi.

snaps.era2: 后赵太宁元年
snaps.d: 正月石虎即皇帝位，四月病死，诸子相残：石遵杀石世自立，冉闵又杀石遵立石鉴，后赵大乱。氐酋苻洪、羌酋姚弋仲各拥部众于枋头、滠头。东晋褚裒北伐，在代陂战败而还；后赵扬州刺史以寿春降晋。前燕慕容皝 348 年卒，子慕容儁嗣位，整军谋取中原。
snaps.te: Death of Shi Hu · Later Zhao in chaos
snaps.de: In the 1st month Shi Hu took the imperial throne, and in the 4th month he died of illness; his sons turned on one another: Shi Zun killed Shi Shi and took the throne, then Ran Min killed Shi Zun and set up Shi Jian, and the Later Zhao fell into chaos. The Di chief Fu Hong and the Qiang chief Yao Yizhong held their followers at Fangtou and Shetou. Chu Pou of the Eastern Jin marched north and was defeated at Daibei; the Later Zhao Inspector of Yang Province surrendered Shouchun to Jin. Murong Huang of the Former Yan had died in 348, and his son Murong Jun succeeded him and readied his army to take the Central Plain.

snaps.era2: 冉魏永兴元年 · 后赵永宁元年
snaps.d: 正月冉闵杀石鉴，闰二月即皇帝位，国号魏（冉魏），下令杀胡，邺城内外死者二十余万；后赵新兴王石祗在襄国称帝，与冉闵相攻。三月前燕慕容儁攻取蓟城，迁都于此。氐酋苻洪被毒死，子苻健率部众西入关中，十一月攻取长安。后赵许昌、洛阳等地守将相继降晋，段部余众段龛据广固，自称齐王。
snaps.era2e: Ran Wei: Yongxing 1 · Later Zhao: Yongning 1
snaps.te: Ran Min proclaims himself emperor · Yan armies march south
snaps.de: In the 1st month Ran Min killed Shi Jian, and in the intercalary 2nd month he took the imperial throne, naming his state Wei (Ran Wei), and ordered the killing of the Hu: more than two hundred thousand died in and around Ye. Shi Zhi, Prince of Xinxing of the Later Zhao, proclaimed himself emperor at Xiangguo and fought Ran Min. In the 3rd month Murong Jun of the Former Yan took Ji City and moved his capital there. The Di chief Fu Hong was poisoned, and his son Fu Jian (苻健) led his people west into Guanzhong and took Chang'an in the 11th month. The Later Zhao commanders at Xuchang, Luoyang and elsewhere surrendered to Jin one after another, and Duan Kan, leading the remnants of the Duan, held Guanggu and styled himself King of Qi.

snaps.era2: 前秦皇始元年 · 冉魏永兴二年
snaps.d: 正月苻健在长安称天王、大单于，国号大秦（前秦）。四月后赵石祗被部将刘显所杀，后赵灭亡；刘显旋即在襄国称帝，与冉闵相攻。冉闵东征西讨，元气大伤；前燕慕容恪南下攻取中山，慕容评取渤海。后赵并州刺史张平据并州壁垒三百余所，自成一方；徐、兖、豫诸州的后赵守将多降东晋。段龛称藩于东晋。
snaps.era2e: Former Qin: Huangshi 1 · Ran Wei: Yongxing 2
snaps.te: Former Qin founded · fall of Later Zhao
snaps.de: In the 1st month Fu Jian (苻健) took the titles Heavenly King and Grand Chanyu at Chang'an, naming his state Great Qin (Former Qin). In the 4th month Shi Zhi of the Later Zhao was killed by his general Liu Xian, and the Later Zhao fell; Liu Xian promptly proclaimed himself emperor at Xiangguo and fought Ran Min. Ran Min campaigned east and west and was gravely weakened; Murong Ke of the Former Yan marched south and took Zhongshan, and Murong Ping took Bohai. Zhang Ping, the Later Zhao Inspector of Bing Province, held more than three hundred fortified strongholds there as a power in his own right; most of the Later Zhao commanders in Xu, Yan and Yu provinces surrendered to the Eastern Jin. Duan Kan acknowledged the Eastern Jin as his overlord.

snaps.era2: 前秦皇始二年 · 前燕元玺元年
snaps.d: 四月慕容恪以连环马大破冉闵于廉台，冉闵被俘处死；八月燕军攻克邺城，冉魏灭亡。十一月慕容儁在蓟城即皇帝位（前燕）。前秦苻健称帝，击退东晋梁州刺史司马勋。东晋殷浩受命北伐，以羌帅姚襄为前锋屯驻谯城；谢尚从冉魏余部得到传国玉玺送回建康。
snaps.era2e: Former Qin: Huangshi 2 · Former Yan: Yuanxi 1
snaps.te: Fall of Ran Wei · Former Yan ruler proclaims himself emperor
snaps.de: In the 4th month Murong Ke crushed Ran Min at Liantai with chained cavalry, and Ran Min was captured and put to death; in the 8th month the Yan army took Ye, and Ran Wei fell. In the 11th month Murong Jun took the imperial throne at Ji City (Former Yan). Fu Jian (苻健) of the Former Qin proclaimed himself emperor and drove back Sima Xun, the Eastern Jin Inspector of Liang Province. Yin Hao of the Eastern Jin was ordered north, with the Qiang commander Yao Xiang as his vanguard camped at Qiao; Xie Shang obtained the imperial seal from the remnants of Ran Wei and sent it back to Jiankang.

snaps.era2: 前秦皇始四年 · 前燕元玺三年
snaps.d: 353 年殷浩北伐，前锋姚襄倒戈，殷浩在山桑大败，被废为庶人，桓温自此独揽东晋兵权。354 年二月桓温率步骑四万自江陵出发，经武关入关中，在蓝田大破秦军，进抵灞上，关中父老持牛酒迎于道，感叹“不图今日复见官军”；但苻健坚壁清野，晋军乏粮，六月白鹿原失利后撤回。前凉张祚篡位称帝，不再奉晋。
snaps.era2e: Former Qin: Huangshi 4 · Former Yan: Yuanxi 3
snaps.te: Huan Wen's northern expedition against Former Qin
snaps.de: In 353 Yin Hao marched north, but his vanguard under Yao Xiang turned against him; routed at Shansang, Yin Hao was reduced to a commoner, and from then on Huan Wen alone controlled the Eastern Jin's armies. In the 2nd month of 354 Huan Wen set out from Jiangling with forty thousand foot and horse, entered Guanzhong by the Wu Pass, crushed the Qin army at Lantian and advanced to Bashang; the elders of Guanzhong met him on the road with oxen and wine, sighing, "We never thought we would see the imperial army again." But Fu Jian (苻健) cleared the countryside and held his walls, the Jin army ran short of food, and after a setback at Bailuyuan in the 6th month it withdrew. Zhang Zuo of the Former Liang usurped the throne and proclaimed himself emperor, no longer acknowledging Jin.

snaps.era2: 前秦寿光二年 · 前燕元玺五年
snaps.d: 八月桓温第二次北伐，在伊水北岸大破姚襄，收复洛阳，修复西晋诸帝陵，奏请还都洛阳，朝廷不应；姚襄西走关中。十一月前燕慕容恪攻破广固，段龛投降，青州入燕。前秦苻生即位后残暴嗜杀。前凉张祚被杀，张玄靓继立，复奉晋朔。
snaps.era2e: Former Qin: Shouguang 2 · Former Yan: Yuanxi 5
snaps.te: Huan Wen recovers Luoyang
snaps.de: In the 8th month Huan Wen launched his second northern expedition, crushed Yao Xiang on the north bank of the Yi River and recovered Luoyang; he restored the tombs of the Western Jin emperors and petitioned for the capital to return to Luoyang, but the court did not respond. Yao Xiang fled west into Guanzhong. In the 11th month Murong Ke of the Former Yan took Guanggu, Duan Kan surrendered, and Qing Province passed to Yan. Fu Sheng, who had taken the throne of the Former Qin, was cruel and murderous. Zhang Zuo of the Former Liang was killed, and Zhang Xuanjing, who succeeded him, again acknowledged the Jin calendar.

snaps.era2: 前秦永兴元年 · 前燕光寿元年
snaps.d: 五月姚襄进攻关中，在三原被前秦苻黄眉、邓羌击杀，弟姚苌率众降秦。六月苻坚杀暴君苻生自立，称大秦天王，任用王猛整顿吏治、抑制豪强，前秦国力日盛。十一月前燕迁都于邺。朝鲜半岛东南的斯卢在奈勿王时统合辰韩诸国（新罗）。
snaps.era2e: Former Qin: Yongxing 1 · Former Yan: Guangshou 1
snaps.te: Fu Jian takes the throne · Former Yan moves to Ye
snaps.de: In the 5th month Yao Xiang attacked Guanzhong and was killed at Sanyuan by Fu Huangmei and Deng Qiang of the Former Qin; his younger brother Yao Chang led their followers in surrender to Qin. In the 6th month Fu Jian (苻坚) killed the tyrant Fu Sheng and took the throne himself as Heavenly King of Great Qin; he employed Wang Meng to reform the administration and curb the great families, and the power of the Former Qin grew day by day. In the 11th month the Former Yan moved its capital to Ye. In southeastern Korea Saro united the states of Jinhan under King Naemul (Silla).

snaps.era2: 前秦甘露二年 · 前燕建熙元年
snaps.d: 割据并州的张平先后附燕、附秦，358 年后并州大部归于前燕。359 年东晋谢万北伐，未战而溃于寿春，前燕乘势夺取许昌、颍川、谯、沛诸地，东晋在淮北仅保洛阳孤城。360 年正月慕容儁病死，子慕容暐即位，太宰慕容恪辅政。前秦王猛治秦，“兵强国富，垂及升平”。
snaps.era2e: Former Qin: Ganlu 2 · Former Yan: Jianxi 1
snaps.te: Death of Murong Jun · Yan takes the lands south of the Yellow River
snaps.de: Zhang Ping, who held Bing Province, submitted first to Yan and then to Qin, and after 358 most of Bing Province belonged to the Former Yan. In 359 Xie Wan of the Eastern Jin marched north, and his army broke up at Shouchun without fighting; the Former Yan seized the chance to take Xuchang, Yingchuan, Qiao and Pei, and north of the Huai the Eastern Jin kept only the isolated city of Luoyang. In the 1st month of 360 Murong Jun died of illness; his son Murong Wei took the throne, with the Grand Steward Murong Ke as regent. Wang Meng governed the Former Qin, and "the army was strong and the state rich, close to an age of peace".

snaps.era2: 前秦建元元年 · 前燕建熙六年
snaps.d:
362 年前燕吕护进攻洛阳，桓温遣邓遐驰救；364 年慕容恪亲率大军围攻，365 年三月攻克洛阳，守将沈劲不屈被杀，燕军进而略地崤渑。东晋哀帝信方士、服丹药致病，桓温移镇姑孰，遥制朝政。前秦平定匈奴刘卫辰、曹毂的叛乱。
远西罗马皇帝尤利安 363 年东征波斯，战死于泰西封附近，继位的约维安割让尼西比斯求和；寄多罗人取代贵霜，据有吐火罗与犍陀罗。
snaps.era2e: Former Qin: Jianyuan 1 · Former Yan: Jianxi 6
snaps.te: Former Yan takes Luoyang
snaps.de:
In 362 Lü Hu of the Former Yan attacked Luoyang, and Huan Wen sent Deng Xia hurrying to its rescue; in 364 Murong Ke besieged it in person with a great army, and in the 3rd month of 365 he took Luoyang; its commander Shen Jin refused to yield and was killed, and the Yan army went on to overrun the Xiao–Mian area. Emperor Ai of the Eastern Jin trusted alchemists and fell ill from taking elixirs, and Huan Wen moved his seat to Gushu, controlling the court from afar. The Former Qin put down the rebellion of Liu Weichen and Cao Gu of the Xiongnu.
In the far west the Roman emperor Julian marched east against Persia in 363 and was killed near Ctesiphon; his successor Jovian ceded Nisibis to make peace. The Kidarites replaced the Kushans and held Tokharistan and Gandhara.

snaps.era2: 前秦建元五年 · 前燕建熙十年
snaps.d: 四月桓温第三次北伐，率步骑五万自姑孰出发，开凿巨野泽水道引汶入济，舟师进至枋头，前燕震恐，慕容暐向前秦求救，许以虎牢以西之地。九月燕将慕容垂坚守，截断晋军粮道，桓温焚舟弃辎重陆路撤退，在襄邑被慕容垂、慕容德伏击，死者三万余人。十月豫州刺史袁真以寿春降燕。慕容垂功高遭忌，十一月投奔前秦。
snaps.era2e: Former Qin: Jianyuan 5 · Former Yan: Jianxi 10
snaps.te: Battle of Fangtou
snaps.de: In the 4th month Huan Wen launched his third northern expedition, setting out from Gushu with fifty thousand foot and horse; he cut a channel through the Juye Marsh to lead the Wen into the Ji, and his fleet reached Fangtou. The Former Yan was terrified, and Murong Wei asked the Former Qin for help, promising it the land west of Hulao. In the 9th month the Yan general Murong Chui held firm and cut the Jin supply line; Huan Wen burned his boats, abandoned his baggage and withdrew overland, and at Xiangyi he was ambushed by Murong Chui and Murong De, losing more than thirty thousand men. In the 10th month Yuan Zhen, Inspector of Yu Province, surrendered Shouchun to Yan. Murong Chui, whose merit had made him enemies, fled to the Former Qin in the 11th month.

snaps.era2: 前秦建元六年
snaps.d: 前燕拒不交割虎牢以西之地，前秦以王猛为帅伐燕，正月取洛阳；九月王猛攻取晋阳，十月在潞川大破慕容评所率三十万燕军，十一月攻克邺城，慕容暐出逃被擒，前燕灭亡，所属一百五十七郡、近千万口尽归前秦。百济近肖古王南征马韩余部，尽有半岛西南。
snaps.te: Former Qin conquers Former Yan
snaps.de: The Former Yan refused to hand over the land west of Hulao, and the Former Qin attacked Yan with Wang Meng in command, taking Luoyang in the 1st month; in the 9th month Wang Meng took Jinyang, in the 10th month he crushed the three hundred thousand Yan troops under Murong Ping at Luchuan, and in the 11th month he took Ye; Murong Wei fled and was captured, the Former Yan fell, and its 157 commanderies and nearly ten million people all passed to the Former Qin. King Geunchogo of Baekje campaigned south against the remnants of Mahan and took all of the southwest of the peninsula.

snaps.era2: 前秦建元七年
snaps.d: 正月桓温攻克寿春，诛袁瑾。四月前秦攻灭仇池杨纂，陇西鲜卑乞伏部、吐谷浑相继称臣。十一月桓温废皇帝司马奕为东海王，立司马昱（简文帝），以图禅代。百济近肖古王北攻高句丽平壤城，高句丽故国原王中流矢死。
snaps.te: Former Qin conquers Chouchi · Huan Wen deposes the emperor
snaps.de: In the 1st month Huan Wen took Shouchun and executed Yuan Jin. In the 4th month the Former Qin destroyed Yang Zuan of Chouchi, and the Qifu of the Longxi Xianbei and the Tuyuhun submitted to it in turn. In the 11th month Huan Wen deposed the emperor Sima Yi (司马奕), reducing him to Prince of Donghai, and set up Sima Yu (Emperor Jianwen), planning to take the throne himself. King Geunchogo of Baekje attacked the Goguryeo city of Pyongyang to the north, and King Gogugwon of Goguryeo was killed by a stray arrow.

snaps.era2: 前秦建元九年
snaps.d: 372 年简文帝卒，孝武帝即位。373 年七月桓温病死，篡位未成，谢安、王坦之当国；桓冲后来让出扬州，出镇荆州。九月至十一月前秦王统、杨安等攻取梁州、益州，东晋梁州刺史杨亮、益州刺史周仲孙败走，巴蜀尽入前秦，“邛、筰、夜郎皆附于秦”。
snaps.te: Former Qin takes Liang and Yi provinces
snaps.de: Emperor Jianwen died in 372 and Emperor Xiaowu took the throne. In the 7th month of 373 Huan Wen died of illness without having usurped the throne, and Xie An and Wang Tanzhi took charge of the government; Huan Chong later gave up Yang Province and went out to Jing Province. From the 9th to the 11th month Wang Tong, Yang An and other Former Qin generals took Liang and Yi provinces; the Eastern Jin Inspector of Liang Province Yang Liang and Inspector of Yi Province Zhou Zhongsun fled defeated, and all of Ba-Shu passed to the Former Qin — "Qiong, Zuo and Yelang all submitted to Qin".

snaps.era2: 前秦建元十二年
snaps.d:
五月前秦以苟苌、梁熙等率步骑十三万攻前凉，八月张天锡出降，前凉灭亡；十月苻洛等率三十万大军攻代，代王什翼犍病中败走，十二月为其子所杀，代国灭亡，前秦以匈奴刘库仁、刘卫辰分统其众。前秦统一北方，西域诸国多遣使朝贡。东晋孝武帝亲政，谢安当国，桓冲已让出扬州、出镇京口。
远西匈人自伏尔加河以东西进，击破阿兰人与东哥特人，哥特诸部渡多瑙河进入罗马境内。天竺笈多王朝沙摩陀罗笈多征服恒河流域诸国。
snaps.te: Former Qin unifies the north
snaps.de:
In the 5th month the Former Qin sent Gou Chang, Liang Xi and others with 130,000 foot and horse against the Former Liang; in the 8th month Zhang Tianxi surrendered and the Former Liang fell. In the 10th month Fu Luo and others led an army of three hundred thousand against Dai; Shiyijian, King of Dai, ill, fled defeated and in the 12th month was killed by his son, and Dai fell; the Former Qin divided his people between Liu Kuren and Liu Weichen of the Xiongnu. The Former Qin had unified the north, and many states of the Western Regions sent envoys with tribute. Emperor Xiaowu of the Eastern Jin took personal control of the government with Xie An in charge, and Huan Chong had already given up Yang Province and gone out to garrison Jingkou.
In the far west the Huns moved west from beyond the Volga and crushed the Alans and the Ostrogoths, and the Gothic tribes crossed the Danube into Roman territory. In India Samudragupta of the Gupta dynasty conquered the states of the Ganges valley.

snaps.era2: 前秦建元十五年
snaps.d: 378 年二月前秦苻丕率十七万大军围攻襄阳，东晋梁州刺史朱序坚守，其母韩氏率婢女增筑城角（“夫人城”）；379 年二月督护李伯护开门降秦，朱序被俘。前秦又攻陷魏兴、彭城、淮阴、盱眙，五月秦军围晋军于三阿；谢玄率北府兵于君川大败秦将俱难、彭超，收复淮阴、盱眙。谢玄自 377 年起在广陵招募北方流民，组建北府兵。
snaps.te: Former Qin takes Xiangyang
snaps.de: In the 2nd month of 378 Fu Pi of the Former Qin besieged Xiangyang with an army of 170,000; the Eastern Jin Inspector of Liang Province Zhu Xu held firm, and his mother, Lady Han, led her maids in building up a corner of the walls (the "Lady's Wall"); in the 2nd month of 379 the Area Protector Li Bohu opened the gates and surrendered to Qin, and Zhu Xu was captured. The Former Qin also took Weixing, Pengcheng, Huaiyin and Xuyi, and in the 5th month the Qin army surrounded the Jin army at San'e; Xie Xuan with the Northern Headquarters Army crushed the Qin generals Ju Nan and Peng Chao at Junchuan and recovered Huaiyin and Xuyi. From 377 Xie Xuan had been recruiting northern refugees at Guangling to form the Northern Headquarters Army.

snaps.era2: 前秦建元十九年
snaps.d: 正月苻坚派吕光率兵七万西征西域。八月苻坚不顾群臣劝阻，亲率步兵六十万、骑兵二十七万南下伐晋，号称“投鞭断流”；十月苻融攻克寿阳。十一月刘牢之以五千北府兵夜袭洛涧，斩秦将梁成；谢玄、谢琰、桓伊以八万之众进抵淝水东岸，请秦军稍退以便渡河决战，秦军一退不可复止，朱序在阵后大呼“秦军败矣”，苻融坠马被杀，秦军溃散，“风声鹤唳，草木皆兵”。苻坚中流矢北逃，慕容垂一军独全。
snaps.te: Battle of the Fei River
snaps.de: In the 1st month Fu Jian sent Lü Guang with seventy thousand men west against the Western Regions. In the 8th month, ignoring the objections of his ministers, Fu Jian marched south against Jin in person with six hundred thousand foot and 270,000 horse, boasting that "if we throw our whips into the Yangtze we can stop its flow"; in the 10th month Fu Rong took Shouyang. In the 11th month Liu Laozhi made a night attack on Luojian with five thousand Northern Headquarters troops and beheaded the Qin general Liang Cheng; Xie Xuan, Xie Yan and Huan Yi advanced with eighty thousand men to the east bank of the Fei River and asked the Qin army to draw back a little so that they could cross and fight a decisive battle. Once the Qin army began to retreat it could not be stopped; Zhu Xu shouted from behind its lines, "The Qin army is beaten!", Fu Rong fell from his horse and was killed, and the Qin army broke up — "every gust of wind and cry of a crane, every bush and tree, seemed an enemy soldier". Fu Jian, struck by a stray arrow, fled north; only Murong Chui's army came through intact.

snaps.era2: 前秦建元二十年 · 后燕燕元元年
snaps.d: 淝水败后前秦瓦解。正月慕容垂在荥阳自称燕王（后燕），率丁零、乌桓围攻据守邺城的苻丕；三月慕容泓在华阴、慕容冲在平阳起兵（西燕），慕容冲年底屯驻阿房，围逼长安；四月羌酋姚苌在渭北自称万年秦王（后秦）。东晋谢玄乘机北伐，收复彭城、鄄城等地，桓冲遣将收复襄阳、魏兴。吕光在西域攻破龟兹，西域三十余国降服。
snaps.era2e: Former Qin: Jianyuan 20 · Later Yan: Yanyuan 1
snaps.te: Former Qin collapses · rivals rise on every side
snaps.de: After the defeat at the Fei River the Former Qin disintegrated. In the 1st month Murong Chui proclaimed himself King of Yan at Xingyang (Later Yan) and led the Dingling and Wuhuan to besiege Fu Pi, who held Ye; in the 3rd month Murong Hong rose at Huayin and Murong Chong at Pingyang (Western Yan), and at the end of the year Murong Chong camped at Epang, closing in on Chang'an; in the 4th month the Qiang chief Yao Chang styled himself Wannian King of Qin north of the Wei River (Later Qin). Xie Xuan of the Eastern Jin seized the chance to march north and recovered Pengcheng, Juancheng and other places, and Huan Chong sent generals to recover Xiangyang and Weixing. In the Western Regions Lü Guang took Kucha, and more than thirty states submitted.

snaps.era2: 前秦太安元年 · 后燕燕元二年
snaps.d: 五月西燕慕容冲攻入长安，苻坚出奔五将山，七月被后秦姚苌所俘，八月缢杀于新平佛寺。苻丕放弃邺城，西走晋阳称帝；后燕得邺。九月陇西鲜卑乞伏国仁在苑川自称大单于（西秦）。吕光率西征军东归，九月在安弥击败前秦凉州刺史梁熙，据有姑臧（后凉）。东晋谢安八月病卒，北伐诸军收复青州、洛阳，进抵黎阳；巴蜀亦复归东晋。
snaps.era2e: Former Qin: Tai'an 1 · Later Yan: Yanyuan 2
snaps.te: Death of Fu Jian
snaps.de: In the 5th month Murong Chong of the Western Yan broke into Chang'an; Fu Jian fled to Mount Wujiang, was captured by Yao Chang of the Later Qin in the 7th month, and in the 8th month was strangled in a Buddhist temple at Xinping. Fu Pi abandoned Ye, went west to Jinyang and proclaimed himself emperor; the Later Yan gained Ye. In the 9th month Qifu Guoren of the Longxi Xianbei styled himself Grand Chanyu at Yuanchuan (Western Qin). Lü Guang led his western army back east, defeated Liang Xi, the Former Qin Inspector of Liang Province, at Anmi in the 9th month, and occupied Guzang (Later Liang). Xie An of the Eastern Jin died of illness in the 8th month; the northern expeditionary armies recovered Qing Province and Luoyang and reached Liyang, and Ba-Shu also returned to the Eastern Jin.

snaps.era2: 魏登国元年 · 后燕建兴元年
snaps.t: 北魏建国·后燕后秦称帝
snaps.d: 正月拓跋珪在牛川召集旧部即代王位，四月改称魏王（北魏）；同月慕容垂在中山称帝，后秦姚苌在长安称帝。西燕鲜卑四十余万口东归，内乱迭起，十月慕容永据长子称帝。苻丕被西燕击败、为晋军所杀，苻登在南安即位，与后秦在陇东反复交战。吕光自称凉州牧。氐人杨定回到仇池，恢复杨氏政权。
snaps.te: Northern Wei founded · Later Yan and Later Qin rulers proclaim themselves emperors
snaps.de: In the 1st month Tuoba Gui gathered the old followers of Dai at Niuchuan and became King of Dai, changing the title to King of Wei in the 4th month (Northern Wei); in the same month Murong Chui proclaimed himself emperor at Zhongshan, and Yao Chang of the Later Qin at Chang'an. More than four hundred thousand Western Yan Xianbei headed back east amid repeated internal strife, and in the 10th month Murong Yong occupied Zhangzi and proclaimed himself emperor. Fu Pi was defeated by the Western Yan and killed by the Jin army; Fu Deng took the throne at Nan'an and fought the Later Qin back and forth in eastern Long. Lü Guang styled himself Governor of Liang Province. Yang Ding, a Di, returned to Chouchi and restored the Yang regime.

snaps.era2: 魏登国四年 · 后燕建兴四年
snaps.t: 翟魏据滑台·后凉称三河王
snaps.d: 387 年拓跋珪联合后燕击破独孤部刘显，北魏据有盛乐、平城一带；388 年又北破库莫奚，契丹、库莫奚从此分为两部。388 年丁零翟辽在滑台自称魏天王（翟魏），据有黄河南北的东郡、陈留、濮阳一带。389 年吕光自称三河王；乞伏乾归继立，自称河南王。罗马与波斯 387 年瓜分亚美尼亚，罗马得其西部。
snaps.te: Zhai Wei holds Huatai · Later Liang ruler takes the title King of Sanhe
snaps.de: In 387 Tuoba Gui, allied with the Later Yan, crushed Liu Xian of the Dugu, and the Northern Wei held the area of Shengle and Pingcheng; in 388 he also crushed the Kumo Xi to the north, and from then on the Khitan and the Kumo Xi were two separate peoples. In 388 Zhai Liao of the Dingling styled himself Heavenly King of Wei at Huatai (Zhai Wei), holding Dong, Chenliu and Puyang commanderies on both banks of the Yellow River. In 389 Lü Guang styled himself King of Sanhe; Qifu Gangui succeeded to the Western Qin and styled himself King of Henan. Rome and Persia partitioned Armenia in 387, Rome taking the west.

labe.64: Later Liang (Lü Guang, King of Sanhe)

snaps.era2: 魏登国七年 · 后燕建兴七年
snaps.t: 后燕灭翟魏·北魏取河套
snaps.d: 391 年北魏拓跋珪北击柔然于南床山，又渡河袭杀铁弗刘卫辰于悦跋城，尽有河套，卫辰之子赫连勃勃投奔后秦。392 年六月后燕慕容垂亲征翟魏，渡河攻克滑台，翟钊奔西燕，翟魏灭亡。柔然在社仑之父辈时游牧漠北，役属北魏；敕勒诸部散处其北。
snaps.te: Later Yan destroys Zhai Wei · Northern Wei takes the Hetao
snaps.de: In 391 Tuoba Gui of the Northern Wei struck the Rouran at the Nanchuang Mountains in the north, then crossed the Yellow River and killed Liu Weichen of the Tiefu at Yueba City in a surprise attack, taking the whole of the Hetao; Weichen's son Helian Bobo fled to the Later Qin. In the 6th month of 392 Murong Chui of the Later Yan campaigned in person against Zhai Wei, crossed the river and took Huatai; Zhai Zhao fled to the Western Yan, and Zhai Wei fell. In the generation of Shelun's father the Rouran roamed north of the Gobi as subjects of the Northern Wei, and the Chile tribes lived scattered to their north.

labe.64: Later Liang (Lü Guang, King of Sanhe)

snaps.era2: 魏登国九年 · 后燕建兴九年 · 后秦皇初元年
snaps.d: 393 年后秦姚苌病死，子姚兴即位，394 年七月在废桥大破苻登，苻登被杀，其子苻崇奔湟中称帝，十月为西秦乞伏乾归所杀，前秦灭亡。后燕慕容垂兵分三路攻西燕，六月在台壁大败慕容永，八月攻克长子，西燕灭亡，并州归后燕。
snaps.era2e: Wei: Dengguo 9 · Later Yan: Jianxing 9 · Later Qin: Huangchu 1
snaps.te: Later Yan destroys Western Yan · end of Former Qin
snaps.de: In 393 Yao Chang of the Later Qin died of illness and his son Yao Xing took the throne; in the 7th month of 394 Yao Xing crushed Fu Deng at Feiqiao, and Fu Deng was killed; his son Fu Chong fled to Huangzhong and proclaimed himself emperor, but in the 10th month he was killed by Qifu Gangui of the Western Qin, and the Former Qin came to an end. Murong Chui of the Later Yan attacked the Western Yan along three routes, routed Murong Yong at Taibi in the 6th month and took Zhangzi in the 8th; the Western Yan fell, and Bing Province passed to the Later Yan.

labe.64: Later Liang (Lü Guang, King of Sanhe)

snaps.era2: 魏登国十年 · 后燕建兴十年
snaps.d: 五月后燕太子慕容宝率八万大军伐魏，拓跋珪坚壁清野，诱敌深入，两军隔黄河相持；十月燕军闻慕容垂病危的谣言撤退，十一月在参合陂被魏军追及，四五万燕兵被坑杀，后燕元气大伤。东晋会稽王司马道子专权，王恭镇京口、殷仲堪镇江陵，分掌上下游兵权。罗马狄奥多西一世卒，帝国由二子分治东西，此后东罗马与中国史书所称的“大秦”相接。
snaps.te: Battle of Canhe Slope
snaps.de: In the 5th month Murong Bao, crown prince of the Later Yan, invaded Wei with an army of eighty thousand; Tuoba Gui cleared the countryside, held his walls and drew the enemy deep, and the two armies faced each other across the Yellow River. In the 10th month, hearing a rumor that Murong Chui was dying, the Yan army withdrew, and in the 11th month it was overtaken by the Wei army at Canhe Slope, where forty or fifty thousand Yan soldiers were buried alive; the Later Yan never recovered its strength. In the Eastern Jin Sima Daozi, Prince of Kuaiji, monopolized power, while Wang Gong at Jingkou and Yin Zhongkan at Jiangling divided military command of the lower and upper Yangtze. The Roman emperor Theodosius I died and the empire was divided between his two sons, East and West; thereafter the Eastern Roman Empire corresponds to the "Daqin" of Chinese histories.

labe.64: Later Liang (Lü Guang, King of Sanhe)

snaps.era2: 魏皇始元年 · 后燕永康元年
snaps.d: 三月慕容垂亲征北魏，攻破平城后病死于上谷，慕容宝即位。八月拓跋珪率步骑四十余万南伐后燕，九月攻取晋阳，并州归魏，冬季分兵东出井陉，进围中山、邺、信都。后秦姚兴据有蒲坂、河东。吕光称天王，国号大凉（后凉）。九月东晋孝武帝被张贵人所弑，安帝即位。
snaps.te: Northern Wei attacks Yan · takes Bing Province
snaps.de: In the 3rd month Murong Chui campaigned against the Northern Wei in person, took Pingcheng, and died of illness at Shanggu; Murong Bao took the throne. In the 8th month Tuoba Gui marched south against the Later Yan with more than four hundred thousand foot and horse; in the 9th month he took Jinyang and Bing Province passed to Wei, and in the winter he sent columns east through Jingxing to besiege Zhongshan, Ye and Xindu. Yao Xing of the Later Qin held Puban and Hedong. Lü Guang took the title Heavenly King, naming his state Great Liang (Later Liang). In the 9th month Emperor Xiaowu of the Eastern Jin was murdered by his consort Lady Zhang, and Emperor An took the throne.

snaps.era2: 魏皇始二年 · 后燕永康二年
snaps.d: 二月魏军在柏肆夜战失利后重整，三月慕容宝弃中山北走龙城；十月魏军攻克中山，后燕主力北退辽西，河北尽归北魏，惟邺城仍由慕容德据守。正月河西鲜卑秃发乌孤自称西平王（南凉）；五月卢水胡沮渠蒙逊推后凉建康太守段业为凉州牧（北凉），后凉分裂。东晋王恭以诛王国宝为名起兵，司马道子被迫杀王国宝。
snaps.te: Northern Wei takes Zhongshan · two Liang states split off
snaps.de: In the 2nd month the Wei army, after a setback in a night battle at Baisi, regrouped, and in the 3rd month Murong Bao abandoned Zhongshan and went north to Longcheng; in the 10th month the Wei army took Zhongshan, the main Later Yan forces fell back north to Liaoxi, and all of Hebei passed to the Northern Wei, except Ye, still held by Murong De. In the 1st month Tufa Wugu of the Hexi Xianbei styled himself King of Xiping (Southern Liang); in the 5th month Juqu Mengxun of the Lushui Hu made Duan Ye, the Later Liang Administrator of Jiankang, Governor of Liang Province (Northern Liang), and the Later Liang split apart. Wang Gong of the Eastern Jin rose in arms, claiming he would execute Wang Guobao, and Sima Daozi was forced to put Wang Guobao to death.

snaps.era2: 魏天兴元年 · 后燕建平元年
snaps.t: 北魏迁都平城·南燕建立
snaps.d: 正月慕容德率四万户自邺南迁滑台，称燕王（南燕）；七月拓跋珪迁都平城，十二月称皇帝（道武帝）。后燕龙城兵变，慕容宝被兰汗所杀，慕容盛平乱即位。北凉段业攻取张掖。东晋王恭、殷仲堪、桓玄、杨佺期再次起兵，北府将刘牢之倒戈，王恭被杀；桓玄、殷仲堪、杨佺期结盟于寻阳，分据荆、江、雍三州，与朝廷对抗。
snaps.te: Northern Wei moves its capital to Pingcheng · Southern Yan founded
snaps.de: In the 1st month Murong De moved south from Ye to Huatai with forty thousand households and styled himself King of Yan (Southern Yan); in the 7th month Tuoba Gui moved his capital to Pingcheng, and in the 12th month he proclaimed himself emperor (Emperor Daowu). Troops mutinied at the Later Yan capital Longcheng; Murong Bao was killed by Lan Han, and Murong Sheng put down the revolt and took the throne. Duan Ye of the Northern Liang took Zhangye. In the Eastern Jin, Wang Gong, Yin Zhongkan, Huan Xuan and Yang Quanqi rose in arms again; the Northern Headquarters general Liu Laozhi turned against them and Wang Gong was killed; Huan Xuan, Yin Zhongkan and Yang Quanqi made an alliance at Xunyang and, dividing the three provinces of Jing, Jiang and Yong between them, defied the court.

snaps.era2: 魏天兴二年 · 后秦弘始元年
snaps.t: 孙恩起事·南燕东徙·后秦取洛阳
snaps.d: 正月南燕失滑台于北魏，慕容德东取青州，杀东晋青州刺史辟闾浑，以广固为都。十月后秦姚兴攻克洛阳，淮汉以北诸城多降后秦。十月五斗米道首领孙恩自海岛攻陷会稽，三吴八郡响应，众至数十万，十二月被刘牢之击退回海岛。十二月桓玄袭杀殷仲堪、杨佺期，尽有荆、江、雍三州。
snaps.te: Sun En rises · Southern Yan moves east · Later Qin takes Luoyang
snaps.de: In the 1st month the Southern Yan lost Huatai to the Northern Wei; Murong De took Qing Province to the east, killed Biqiu Hun, the Eastern Jin Inspector of Qing Province, and made Guanggu his capital. In the 10th month Yao Xing of the Later Qin took Luoyang, and most of the cities north of the Huai and Han surrendered to the Later Qin. In the 10th month Sun En, a leader of the Way of the Five Pecks of Rice, struck from the offshore islands and took Kuaiji; the eight commanderies of the Three Wu rose in answer and his following grew to several hundred thousand, but in the 12th month Liu Laozhi drove him back to the islands. In the 12th month Huan Xuan killed Yin Zhongkan and Yang Quanqi in surprise attacks and took all three provinces of Jing, Jiang and Yong.

snaps.era2: 魏天兴三年 · 后秦弘始二年
snaps.d: 正月南燕慕容德在广固称帝。七月后秦姚硕德大举攻西秦，乞伏乾归兵败降秦，西秦暂亡。十一月敦煌太守李暠被推为大都督、凉公，据敦煌、晋昌（西凉）。北魏在平城营建宫室、太庙，徙山东六州吏民、杂夷十余万口以充京师，计口授田。
snaps.te: Western Liang founded · Later Qin absorbs Western Qin
snaps.de: In the 1st month Murong De of the Southern Yan proclaimed himself emperor at Guanggu. In the 7th month Yao Shuode of the Later Qin attacked the Western Qin in force; Qifu Gangui was defeated and surrendered to Qin, and the Western Qin ceased to exist for a time. In the 11th month Li Gao, Administrator of Dunhuang, was acclaimed Grand Area Commander and Duke of Liang, holding Dunhuang and Jinchang (Western Liang). The Northern Wei built palaces and an ancestral temple at Pingcheng and moved more than a hundred thousand officials, commoners and assorted non-Chinese from the six provinces east of the mountains to fill the capital, allotting them land by head count.

snaps.era2: 魏天兴四年 · 后秦弘始三年
snaps.t: 沮渠蒙逊夺北凉·后凉称藩
snaps.d: 五月沮渠蒙逊杀段业，自称张掖公，北凉归沮渠氏。九月后秦姚硕德围姑臧，后凉吕隆称藩，名存实亡。六月孙恩北上攻京口，进逼建康，被刘牢之部将刘裕击败，退回海上。后燕慕容盛被杀，慕容熙即位。此时北方并存者有北魏、后燕、南燕、后秦、后凉、南凉、北凉、西凉，加上东晋、仇池、吐谷浑，北方分裂至于极点。高句丽广开土王南攻百济，夺回带方故地。天竺笈多王朝旃陀罗笈多二世征服西方的塞种诸王，法显此时正在西行求法途中。
snaps.te: Juqu Mengxun seizes Northern Liang · Later Liang becomes a vassal
snaps.de: In the 5th month Juqu Mengxun killed Duan Ye and styled himself Duke of Zhangye, and the Northern Liang passed to the Juqu clan. In the 9th month Yao Shuode of the Later Qin besieged Guzang, and Lü Long of the Later Liang submitted as a vassal; the state survived in name only. In the 6th month Sun En went north to attack Jingkou and pressed on Jiankang, but was defeated by Liu Yu, a general under Liu Laozhi, and fell back to the sea. Murong Sheng of the Later Yan was killed and Murong Xi took the throne. In the north, those standing side by side at this moment were the Northern Wei, Later Yan, Southern Yan, Later Qin, Later Liang, Southern Liang, Northern Liang and Western Liang; together with the Eastern Jin, Chouchi and the Tuyuhun, the division of the north was at its height. King Gwanggaeto of Goguryeo attacked Baekje to the south and took back the old Daifang lands. In India Chandragupta II of the Gupta dynasty conquered the Saka kings of the west; Faxian was at this time on his journey west in search of the Dharma.

snaps.era2: 魏天兴五年 · 后秦弘始四年
snaps.d: 正月司马元显下诏讨伐桓玄，桓玄顺流东下，北府刘牢之倒戈降玄，三月桓玄入建康，杀司马元显，自为太尉、扬州牧，总揽朝政，随即夺北府兵权，刘牢之自缢。三月孙恩攻临海失败，投海而死，妹夫卢循继领余众。北魏与后秦争河东，十月拓跋珪在柴壁大破姚平，后秦从此不敢东犯。柔然社仑北破敕勒，统一漠北，自称丘豆伐可汗。
snaps.te: Huan Xuan enters Jiankang · Battle of Chaibi
snaps.de: In the 1st month Sima Yuanxian issued an edict for war on Huan Xuan; Huan Xuan came down the Yangtze, the Northern Headquarters commander Liu Laozhi turned and went over to him, and in the 3rd month Huan Xuan entered Jiankang, killed Sima Yuanxian, made himself Grand Commandant and Governor of Yang Province and took over the whole government; he then stripped the Northern Headquarters of its command, and Liu Laozhi hanged himself. In the 3rd month Sun En failed in an attack on Linhai and drowned himself in the sea; his brother-in-law Lu Xun took over his remaining followers. The Northern Wei and the Later Qin fought over Hedong; in the 10th month Tuoba Gui crushed Yao Ping at Chaibi, and the Later Qin never again dared to strike east. Shelun of the Rouran crushed the Chile to the north, united the lands north of the Gobi and styled himself Qiudoufa Qaghan.

snaps.era2: 魏天兴六年 · 后秦弘始五年
snaps.d: 十二月桓玄逼安帝禅位，在建康称帝，国号楚（桓楚），迁安帝于寻阳。八月后秦迁后凉吕隆及其宗族、部众至长安，后凉灭亡，姑臧由后秦凉州刺史王尚镇守。后秦以赫连勃勃镇朔方。
snaps.te: Huan Xuan usurps the Jin throne · end of Later Liang
snaps.de: In the 12th month Huan Xuan forced Emperor An to abdicate and proclaimed himself emperor at Jiankang, naming his state Chu (Huan Chu), and moved Emperor An to Xunyang. In the 8th month the Later Qin moved Lü Long of the Later Liang, with his clan and people, to Chang'an; the Later Liang came to an end, and Guzang was held by Wang Shang, the Later Qin Inspector of Liang Province. The Later Qin stationed Helian Bobo in Shuofang.

snaps.era2: 魏天赐元年 · 后秦弘始六年
snaps.d: 二月刘裕与刘毅、何无忌等在京口、广陵起兵讨玄，三月攻入建康，桓玄挟安帝西逃江陵，五月败于峥嵘洲，被杀于枚回洲；十月桓振复据江陵。十月卢循攻占番禺，据有广州。高句丽广开土王攻取后燕辽东。
snaps.te: Liu Yu takes up arms · Huan Xuan defeated and killed
snaps.de: In the 2nd month Liu Yu, Liu Yi, He Wuji and others rose at Jingkou and Guangling against Huan Xuan, and in the 3rd month they broke into Jiankang; Huan Xuan fled west to Jiangling, taking Emperor An with him, was defeated at Zhengrong Islet in the 5th month and killed at Meihui Islet; in the 10th month Huan Zhen retook Jiangling. In the 10th month Lu Xun took Panyu and held Guang Province. King Gwanggaeto of Goguryeo took Liaodong from the Later Yan.

snaps.era2: 魏天赐二年 · 后秦弘始七年
snaps.d: 二月益州参军谯纵在涪城兵变，杀刺史毛璩，自称成都王（西蜀），称藩于后秦。三月刘毅等攻克江陵，桓氏余众平定，安帝复位，刘裕以北府将领掌握朝政。东晋授卢循广州刺史以安抚之。南燕慕容德死，慕容超即位。西凉李暠迁都酒泉。
snaps.te: Qiao Zong holds Shu
snaps.de: In the 2nd month Qiao Zong, an Adjutant of Yi Province, mutinied at Fucheng, killed the Inspector Mao Qu and styled himself King of Chengdu (Western Shu), acknowledging the Later Qin as his overlord. In the 3rd month Liu Yi and others took Jiangling, the remnants of the Huan clan were put down, and Emperor An was restored, with Liu Yu, a Northern Headquarters general, in control of the government. The Eastern Jin made Lu Xun Inspector of Guang Province to placate him. Murong De of the Southern Yan died and Murong Chao took the throne. Li Gao of the Western Liang moved his capital to Jiuquan.

snaps.era2: 魏天赐四年 · 后秦弘始九年
snaps.d: 406 年后秦以姑臧授南凉秃发傉檀，南凉迁都姑臧。407 年六月铁弗匈奴赫连勃勃叛后秦，自称大夏天王（夏），连年寇掠岭北；七月后燕禁卫将领冯跋杀暴君慕容熙，拥立慕容宝养子高云，后燕亡，史称北燕。北魏道武帝晚年服寒食散，猜忌嗜杀。
snaps.te: Xia founded · Northern Yan replaces Later Yan
snaps.de: In 406 the Later Qin gave Guzang to Tufa Rutan of the Southern Liang, and the Southern Liang moved its capital there. In the 6th month of 407 Helian Bobo of the Tiefu Xiongnu broke with the Later Qin and styled himself Heavenly King of Great Xia (Xia), raiding north of the ridges year after year; in the 7th month Feng Ba, a commander of the Later Yan palace guard, killed the tyrant Murong Xi and enthroned Gao Yun, adopted son of Murong Bao: the Later Yan was at an end, and the regime is known to history as the Northern Yan. In his later years Emperor Daowu of the Northern Wei took Cold Food Powder and grew suspicious and murderous.

snaps.era2: 魏永兴元年 · 后秦弘始十一年
snaps.d: 四月刘裕率舟师自淮入泗，越过大岘山，六月在临朐大败南燕军，进围广固，南燕郡县多降。七月乞伏乾归在苑川复国（西秦）。十月北魏道武帝被次子拓跋绍所杀，长子拓跋嗣平乱即位（明元帝）。北燕高云被宠臣离班、桃仁所杀，冯跋平乱自立。
snaps.te: Liu Yu's northern expedition against Southern Yan
snaps.de: In the 4th month Liu Yu led his fleet from the Huai into the Si, crossed the Daxian Mountains, routed the Southern Yan army at Linqu in the 6th month and laid siege to Guanggu, and most of the Southern Yan commanderies and counties surrendered. In the 7th month Qifu Gangui restored his state at Yuanchuan (Western Qin). In the 10th month Emperor Daowu of the Northern Wei was killed by his second son Tuoba Shao, and his eldest son Tuoba Si put down the revolt and took the throne (Emperor Mingyuan). Gao Yun of the Northern Yan was killed by his favorites Li Ban and Tao Ren; Feng Ba put down the revolt and made himself ruler.

snaps.era2: 魏永兴二年 · 后秦弘始十二年
snaps.d: 二月晋军攻破广固，慕容超被俘斩于建康，南燕灭亡。卢循、徐道覆乘刘裕北伐之机自广州分路北上，三月何无忌战死豫章，五月刘毅在桑落洲大败，卢循进逼建康；刘裕急速回师，坚守石头城，卢循久攻不下退走寻阳，十二月刘裕在左里大破卢循，同时派孙处、沈田子自海道袭取番禺。南凉为北凉所败，秃发傉檀退回乐都。
snaps.te: Fall of Southern Yan · Lu Xun strikes north
snaps.de: In the 2nd month the Jin army took Guanggu; Murong Chao was captured and beheaded at Jiankang, and the Southern Yan came to an end. Lu Xun and Xu Daofu took advantage of Liu Yu's northern expedition to march north from Guang Province along separate routes; in the 3rd month He Wuji was killed in battle at Yuzhang, in the 5th month Liu Yi was routed at Sangluo Islet, and Lu Xun pressed on Jiankang. Liu Yu hurried his army back and held Shitou City; unable to take it after a long attack, Lu Xun fell back to Xunyang, and in the 12th month Liu Yu crushed him at Zuoli, while sending Sun Chu and Shen Tianzi by sea to take Panyu by surprise. The Southern Liang was defeated by the Northern Liang, and Tufa Rutan fell back to Ledu.

snaps.era2: 魏永兴五年 · 后秦弘始十五年
snaps.d: 411 年卢循败亡于交州。412 年刘裕袭杀荆州刺史刘毅，以司马休之镇江陵。413 年七月朱龄石率军自外水奇袭成都，谯纵出逃自缢，西蜀灭亡，巴蜀复归东晋。412 年西秦乞伏炽磐即位，迁都枹罕；北凉沮渠蒙逊迁都姑臧，称河西王。
snaps.te: Liu Yu conquers Western Shu
snaps.de: In 411 Lu Xun was defeated and died in Jiao Province. In 412 Liu Yu killed Liu Yi, Inspector of Jing Province, in a surprise attack and installed Sima Xiuzhi at Jiangling. In the 7th month of 413 Zhu Lingshi led an army up the Outer River in a surprise attack on Chengdu; Qiao Zong fled and hanged himself, Western Shu fell, and Ba-Shu returned to the Eastern Jin. In 412 Qifu Chipan took the throne of the Western Qin and moved the capital to Fuhan; Juqu Mengxun of the Northern Liang moved his capital to Guzang and took the title King of Hexi.

snaps.era2: 魏神瑞元年 · 后秦弘始十六年
snaps.d: 六月西秦乞伏炽磐乘南凉秃发傉檀西征乙弗之机袭取乐都，傉檀投降，南凉灭亡，河湟归西秦。北凉、西秦、西凉三分河陇。
snaps.te: Western Qin destroys Southern Liang
snaps.de: In the 6th month Qifu Chipan of the Western Qin seized Ledu in a surprise attack while Tufa Rutan of the Southern Liang was away campaigning west against the Yifu; Rutan surrendered, the Southern Liang fell, and Hehuang passed to the Western Qin. The Northern Liang, the Western Qin and the Western Liang divided Hexi and Longyou among them.

snaps.era2: 魏泰常元年 · 后秦永和元年
snaps.d: 二月后秦姚兴病死，子姚泓即位，诸弟争立；夏国赫连勃勃攻取后秦安定、阴密诸地。八月刘裕兵分五路北伐，王镇恶、檀道济自淮淝向许昌、洛阳，十月攻克洛阳，修复晋室五陵。
snaps.te: Liu Yu's northern expedition · Luoyang recovered
snaps.de: In the 2nd month Yao Xing of the Later Qin died of illness and his son Yao Hong took the throne, while his brothers fought over the succession; Helian Bobo of Xia took Anding, Yinmi and other Later Qin territory. In the 8th month Liu Yu launched a northern expedition along five routes; Wang Zhen'e and Tan Daoji advanced from the Huai and the Fei toward Xuchang and Luoyang, and in the 10th month they took Luoyang and restored the five tombs of the Jin emperors.

snaps.era2: 魏泰常二年 · 夏凤翔五年
snaps.d: 正月刘裕率水军自彭城沿泗、汴入河，北魏在黄河北岸尾随骚扰，刘裕以“却月阵”大败魏骑。王镇恶率水军沿渭水而上，八月直抵长安城下，舍舟登岸大破秦军，姚泓出降，后秦灭亡。十二月刘裕留子刘义真镇长安，自返建康。
snaps.te: Eastern Jin conquers Later Qin
snaps.de: In the 1st month Liu Yu led his fleet from Pengcheng along the Si and the Bian into the Yellow River; the Northern Wei shadowed and harassed him from the north bank, and Liu Yu routed the Wei cavalry with his "Crescent Formation". Wang Zhen'e led a fleet up the Wei River and in the 8th month arrived beneath the walls of Chang'an, left his boats, went ashore and crushed the Qin army; Yao Hong surrendered, and the Later Qin fell. In the 12th month Liu Yu left his son Liu Yizhen in charge of Chang'an and returned to Jiankang himself.

snaps.era2: 魏泰常三年 · 夏昌武元年
snaps.d: 刘裕东归后，关中晋军诸将自相残杀，沈田子杀王镇恶，王修又杀沈田子。夏国赫连勃勃乘机南下，十一月刘义真弃长安东撤，在青泥被夏军追及大败，夏军攻占长安，勃勃在灞上称帝，以长安为南台，自还统万。十二月刘裕使人缢杀安帝，立恭帝。
snaps.te: Helian Bobo takes Chang'an
snaps.de: After Liu Yu went back east, the Jin generals in Guanzhong turned on one another: Shen Tianzi killed Wang Zhen'e, and Wang Xiu in turn killed Shen Tianzi. Helian Bobo of Xia seized the chance to strike south; in the 11th month Liu Yizhen abandoned Chang'an and withdrew east, was overtaken and routed by the Xia army at Qingni, and the Xia army took Chang'an; Bobo proclaimed himself emperor at Bashang, made Chang'an his southern seat of government, and went back to Tongwan himself. In the 12th month Liu Yu had Emperor An strangled and set up Emperor Gong.

snaps.era2: 魏泰常五年
snaps.d: 六月刘裕受晋恭帝禅位，在建康称帝，国号宋，东晋灭亡，南朝开始。七月北凉沮渠蒙逊佯攻西秦，诱西凉李歆出兵，在蓼泉大败西凉军，李歆战死，北凉攻占酒泉；李歆之弟李恂退守敦煌，翌年城破，西凉灭亡。
snaps.te: Liu Song replaces Jin · Northern Liang destroys Western Liang
snaps.de: In the 6th month Liu Yu accepted the abdication of Emperor Gong of Jin and proclaimed himself emperor at Jiankang, naming his dynasty Song; the Eastern Jin was at an end, and the Southern Dynasties began. In the 7th month Juqu Mengxun of the Northern Liang feigned an attack on the Western Qin to lure Li Xin of the Western Liang into the field, routed the Western Liang army at Liaoquan, and took Jiuquan; Li Xin was killed in battle. His younger brother Li Xun fell back to hold Dunhuang, which fell the following year, and the Western Liang came to an end.

snaps.era2: 魏泰常八年
snaps.d: 422 年五月宋武帝刘裕病死，北魏明元帝乘丧南侵，十一月攻克滑台；423 年正月攻占洛阳，闰四月在毛德祖坚守二百余日后攻克虎牢，宋失司、兖、豫三州黄河以南的大片土地，只保青州东阳城与淮北据点。十一月明元帝卒，太武帝拓跋焘即位。421 年北凉攻克敦煌，西凉灭亡。
snaps.te: Northern Wei seizes Song's lands south of the Yellow River
snaps.de: In the 5th month of 422 Emperor Wu of Song, Liu Yu, died of illness; Emperor Mingyuan of the Northern Wei seized the moment of mourning to invade the south and took Huatai in the 11th month; in the 1st month of 423 he took Luoyang, and in the intercalary 4th month he took Hulao after Mao Dezu had held it for more than two hundred days. Song lost much of its land south of the Yellow River in Si, Yan and Yu provinces, keeping only Dongyang City in Qing Province and its strongholds north of the Huai. In the 11th month Emperor Mingyuan died and Emperor Taiwu, Tuoba Tao, took the throne. In 421 the Northern Liang had taken Dunhuang, and the Western Liang had come to an end.

snaps.era2: 魏始光四年 · 夏承光三年
snaps.d: 425 年夏主赫连勃勃死，子赫连昌即位。426 年北魏太武帝西伐，奚斤攻取长安；427 年六月太武帝亲率轻骑奔袭统万城，诱夏军出战大破之，攻克统万，赫连昌逃往上邽。宋文帝刘义隆整顿内政，开启元嘉之治。
snaps.te: Northern Wei takes Tongwan
snaps.de: In 425 the Xia ruler Helian Bobo died and his son Helian Chang took the throne. In 426 Emperor Taiwu of the Northern Wei campaigned west, and Xi Jin took Chang'an; in the 6th month of 427 Emperor Taiwu raced to Tongwan City with light cavalry, lured the Xia army out to fight and crushed it, and took Tongwan; Helian Chang fled to Shanggui. Emperor Wen of Song, Liu Yilong, put the government in order and opened the good rule of the Yuanjia era.

snaps.era2: 魏神䴥三年 · 夏胜光三年
snaps.d:
三月宋文帝遣到彦之率五万大军北伐，魏军主动撤离，宋收复洛阳、虎牢、滑台、碻磝河南四镇；十月魏军渡河反攻，十一月再陷洛阳、虎牢，到彦之烧船弃甲南逃，惟滑台仍在宋军坚守之中。同月北魏太武帝西击夏国，攻克平凉，关中、陇东尽归北魏，赫连定退据上邽。428 年北魏擒夏主赫连昌，弟赫连定继立。
高句丽长寿王 427 年迁都平壤。宋元嘉年间，南海的诃罗单、盘盘、婆皇等国相继遣使入贡。亚美尼亚王国 428 年被萨珊废除，改设总督。
snaps.te: Yuanjia northern expedition · Wei takes Pingliang
snaps.de:
In the 3rd month Emperor Wen of Song sent Dao Yanzhi north with an army of fifty thousand; the Wei army withdrew of its own accord, and Song recovered the four garrisons south of the Yellow River — Luoyang, Hulao, Huatai and Qiao'ao. In the 10th month the Wei army crossed the river to counterattack, and in the 11th month it retook Luoyang and Hulao; Dao Yanzhi burned his boats, threw away his armor and fled south, and only Huatai was still held by the Song army. In the same month Emperor Taiwu of the Northern Wei struck west at Xia and took Pingliang, and Guanzhong and eastern Long passed wholly to the Northern Wei; Helian Ding fell back to hold Shanggui. In 428 the Northern Wei had captured the Xia ruler Helian Chang, and his younger brother Helian Ding had succeeded him.
King Jangsu of Goguryeo moved the capital to Pyongyang in 427. In the Yuanjia era of Song, Heluodan, Panpan, Pohuang and other states of the Southern Seas sent envoys with tribute one after another. The Armenian kingdom was abolished by the Sasanians in 428 and replaced by a governor.

snaps.era2: 魏神䴥四年
snaps.d: 正月赫连定攻破西秦，杀乞伏暮末，西秦灭亡；六月赫连定率部众十余万西渡黄河，欲袭北凉，半渡时被吐谷浑慕璝截击生擒，夏国灭亡，北魏随即取上邽。二月北魏攻克滑台，宋檀道济“唱筹量沙”全军而还。北凉沮渠蒙逊向北魏称臣，吐谷浑据有枹罕、西平。
snaps.te: Xia destroys Western Qin · Tuyuhun destroys Xia
snaps.de: In the 1st month Helian Ding took the Western Qin and killed Qifu Mumo, and the Western Qin fell; in the 6th month Helian Ding led more than a hundred thousand of his people west across the Yellow River intending to attack the Northern Liang, but halfway across he was intercepted and captured by Mugui of the Tuyuhun; Xia fell, and the Northern Wei promptly took Shanggui. In the 2nd month the Northern Wei took Huatai, and Tan Daoji of Song brought his whole army home by "counting sand as if it were grain". Juqu Mengxun of the Northern Liang declared himself a subject of the Northern Wei, and the Tuyuhun held Fuhan and Xiping.

snaps.era2: 魏太延二年
snaps.d: 432 年起北魏连年进攻北燕；436 年四月魏军进逼龙城，高句丽派兵数万迎冯弘，冯弘焚宫殿、驱城中居民东奔高句丽，北燕灭亡，辽西归北魏。宋文帝杀名将檀道济，北魏闻之称“道济已死，吴子辈不足复惮”。北匈奴余部悦般遣使北魏，相约共击柔然。东北的挹娄改称勿吉。
snaps.te: Northern Wei destroys Northern Yan
snaps.de: From 432 the Northern Wei attacked the Northern Yan year after year; in the 4th month of 436 the Wei army closed in on Longcheng, Goguryeo sent tens of thousands of troops to receive Feng Hong, and Feng Hong burned his palaces and drove the people of the city east with him to Goguryeo: the Northern Yan fell, and Liaoxi passed to the Northern Wei. Emperor Wen of Song killed his famous general Tan Daoji, and when the Northern Wei heard of it they said, "Daoji is dead — the men of Wu are no longer worth fearing."
