The Yueban, remnants of the Northern Xiongnu, sent envoys to the Northern Wei, agreeing to attack the Rouran together. In the northeast the Yilou came to be called Wuji.

snaps.era2: 魏太延五年
snaps.d: 六月北魏太武帝亲征北凉，九月攻克姑臧，沮渠牧犍出降，北凉灭亡，北魏统一北方，十六国时代结束，南北朝对峙局面形成。沮渠氏余众由沮渠无讳、沮渠安周率领退守敦煌，后西走鄯善、高昌。
snaps.te: Northern Wei destroys Northern Liang · the north unified
snaps.de: In the 6th month Emperor Taiwu of the Northern Wei campaigned in person against the Northern Liang, and in the 9th month he took Guzang; Juqu Mujian surrendered, the Northern Liang fell, and the Northern Wei unified the north: the era of the Sixteen Kingdoms was over, and the confrontation of the Northern and Southern Dynasties took shape. The remnants of the Juqu clan, led by Juqu Wuhui and Juqu Anzhou, fell back to hold Dunhuang and later went west to Shanshan and Gaochang.

snaps.era2: 魏太平真君三年
snaps.t: 沮渠氏据高昌·宋破仇池
snaps.d: 441 年北魏攻敦煌，沮渠无讳弃城西走鄯善，442 年九月袭取高昌，称凉王（高昌北凉），敦煌入北魏；伊吾守将唐和归附北魏。五月宋将裴方明攻破仇池，杨难当北奔北魏，仇池归宋，次年又为北魏所夺，杨氏余部退据武都。北魏太武帝崇道抑佛，寇谦之的天师道盛行。
snaps.te: The Juqu hold Gaochang · Song crushes Chouchi
snaps.de: In 441 the Northern Wei attacked Dunhuang; Juqu Wuhui abandoned the city and went west to Shanshan, and in the 9th month of 442 he took Gaochang in a surprise attack and styled himself King of Liang (the Gaochang Northern Liang), while Dunhuang passed to the Northern Wei; Tang He, the commander at Yiwu, went over to the Northern Wei. In the 5th month the Song general Pei Fangming took Chouchi, Yang Nandang fled north to the Northern Wei, and Chouchi passed to Song, only to be taken by the Northern Wei the following year; the remnants of the Yang fell back to hold Wudu. Emperor Taiwu of the Northern Wei favored Daoism and suppressed Buddhism, and Kou Qianzhi's Way of the Celestial Masters flourished.

snaps.era2: 魏正平元年
snaps.t: 元嘉北伐·魏军饮马长江
snaps.d:
450 年二月北魏太武帝率十万骑兵南侵，围攻悬瓠四十二日不克。七月宋文帝发动大规模北伐，王玄谟围攻滑台久攻不下，十月太武帝亲率大军渡河救援，王玄谟大败；魏军分五路南下，十二月太武帝抵达长江北岸瓜步，凿山为盘道，声言渡江，建康戒严，宋淮南州郡残破。同年太武帝以“国史之狱”诛崔浩。451 年正月太武帝北还，途中围攻盱眙三十日不下，掠淮南五万余家而去，宋江北州郡残破，“邑里萧条，元嘉之政衰矣”。
445 年北魏击破吐谷浑，置枹罕镇；448 年魏将万度归攻取鄯善、焉耆，进至龟兹。450 年沮渠安周攻灭车师前部，据有交河。
snaps.te: Yuanjia northern expedition · Wei army waters its horses at the Yangtze
snaps.de:
In the 2nd month of 450 Emperor Taiwu of the Northern Wei invaded the south with a hundred thousand horsemen and besieged Xuanhu for forty-two days without taking it. In the 7th month Emperor Wen of Song launched a great northern expedition; Wang Xuanmo besieged Huatai for a long time without success, and in the 10th month Emperor Taiwu crossed the river at the head of a great army to relieve it, routing Wang Xuanmo. The Wei army marched south along five routes, and in the 12th month Emperor Taiwu reached Guabu on the north bank of the Yangtze, cut a winding road up the hill and announced that he would cross the river; Jiankang was placed under martial law, and the Song provinces and commanderies of Huainan were laid waste. The same year Emperor Taiwu executed Cui Hao in the State History affair. In the 1st month of 451 Emperor Taiwu went back north, besieging Xuyi for thirty days on the way without taking it, and carried off more than fifty thousand households from Huainan; the Song provinces and commanderies north of the Yangtze lay in ruins — "towns and villages desolate, the rule of Yuanjia in decline".
In 445 the Northern Wei crushed the Tuyuhun and set up Fuhan Garrison; in 448 the Wei general Wan Dugui took Shanshan and Karasahr and advanced as far as Kucha. In 450 Juqu Anzhou destroyed Nearer Jushi and held Jiaohe.

snaps.era2: 魏和平元年
snaps.d: 451 年正月魏军攻盱眙不克，焚掠而归，所过赤地无余。452 年北魏太武帝被宦官宗爱所弑，文成帝即位，与民休息，恢复佛法，开凿云冈石窟。453 年宋太子刘劭弑父，武陵王刘骏起兵平乱即位（孝武帝）；454 年荆州刺史刘义宣举兵反，旋即败死，孝武帝分荆、湘、江、豫四州之地置郢州，以削弱上游。460 年柔然攻破高昌，杀沮渠安周，北凉余绪断绝，柔然立阚伯周为高昌王。北魏所置焉耆镇此时已经撤废。
snaps.te: Rouran destroys Northern Liang at Gaochang
snaps.de: In the 1st month of 451 the Wei army failed to take Xuyi, burned and plundered as it went home, and left scorched earth wherever it passed. In 452 Emperor Taiwu of the Northern Wei was murdered by the eunuch Zong Ai; Emperor Wencheng took the throne, gave the people respite, restored Buddhism and began the Yungang Grottoes. In 453 Liu Shao, crown prince of Song, murdered his father; Liu Jun, Prince of Wuling, rose, put down the revolt and took the throne (Emperor Xiaowu); in 454 Liu Yixuan, Inspector of Jing Province, rebelled and was soon defeated and killed, and Emperor Xiaowu carved Ying Province out of Jing, Xiang, Jiang and Yu provinces to weaken the upper Yangtze. In 460 the Rouran took Gaochang and killed Juqu Anzhou, ending the last of the Northern Liang, and set up Kan Bozhou as King of Gaochang. The Karasahr Garrison that the Northern Wei had set up had by this time been abolished.

snaps.era2: 魏天安元年
snaps.d:
465 年宋前废帝刘子业被杀，湘东王刘彧即位（明帝）；466 年正月江州刺史晋安王刘子勋在寻阳称帝，改元义嘉，四方州郡几乎全部响应，八月被明帝平定。叛军中的徐州刺史薛安都、汝南太守常珍奇、兖州刺史毕众敬惧祸，分别以彭城、悬瓠、瑕丘降魏，北魏遣尉元入彭城，宋淮北之地开始沦丧。
嚈哒（白匈奴）此时已取代寄多罗人，据有吐火罗之地。
snaps.te: Yijia rebellion · Northern Wei gains the lands north of the Huai
snaps.de:
In 465 the Former Deposed Emperor of Song, Liu Ziye, was killed, and Liu Yu (刘彧), Prince of Xiangdong, took the throne (Emperor Ming); in the 1st month of 466 Liu Zixun, Prince of Jin'an and Inspector of Jiang Province, proclaimed himself emperor at Xunyang with the era name Yijia, and nearly every province and commandery rose in answer, but in the 8th month the rising was put down by Emperor Ming. Rebels who feared for their lives — Xue Andu, Inspector of Xu Province, Chang Zhenqi, Administrator of Runan, and Bi Zhongjing, Inspector of Yan Province — surrendered Pengcheng, Xuanhu and Xiaqiu to Wei respectively; the Northern Wei sent Yu Yuan into Pengcheng, and Song's lands north of the Huai began to slip away.
The Hephthalites (White Huns) had by this time replaced the Kidarites and held the lands of Tokharistan.

snaps.era2: 魏皇兴三年
snaps.d: 467 年正月宋将张永、沈攸之欲夺回彭城，在吕梁被尉元大败，士卒冻死者大半；北魏慕容白曜进攻青、冀二州，468 年攻克历城、梁邹，469 年正月攻破东阳城，俘宋青州刺史沈文秀。宋青、冀、徐、兖四州及豫州淮西之地尽入北魏，南北边界推至淮河一线，宋只保有郁洲（今连云港云台山）一带侨置的青、冀二州。
snaps.te: Song loses the four provinces north of the Huai
snaps.de: In the 1st month of 467 the Song generals Zhang Yong and Shen Youzhi tried to retake Pengcheng but were routed by Yu Yuan at Lüliang, and more than half their men froze to death. Murong Baiyao of the Northern Wei attacked Qing and Ji provinces, took Licheng and Liangzou in 468, and in the 1st month of 469 took Dongyang City, capturing Shen Wenxiu, the Song Inspector of Qing Province. Song's provinces of Qing, Ji, Xu and Yan, and the part of Yu Province west of the Huai, all passed to the Northern Wei, and the border between north and south was pushed to the Huai; Song kept only the émigré provinces of Qing and Ji set up around Yuzhou (today's Yuntai Mountain in Lianyungang).

snaps.era2: 魏延兴五年
snaps.d: 九月高句丽长寿王亲率三万大军围攻百济王都汉城，七日城破，百济盖卤王被杀，文周王南迁熊津，汉江流域尽归高句丽。北魏献文帝 471 年禅位于五岁的太子拓跋宏（孝文帝），冯太后临朝。宋后废帝刘昱暴虐，474 年桂阳王刘休范自寻阳起兵，被萧道成击斩，萧道成由此掌握禁军。
snaps.te: Goguryeo takes Hanseong
snaps.de: In the 9th month King Jangsu of Goguryeo besieged the Baekje royal capital Hanseong at the head of thirty thousand men; the city fell in seven days, King Gaero of Baekje was killed, King Munju moved south to Ungjin, and the whole Han River basin passed to Goguryeo. In 471 Emperor Xianwen of the Northern Wei abdicated in favor of his five-year-old son Tuoba Hong (Emperor Xiaowen), and Empress Dowager Feng ruled from behind the screen. The Later Deposed Emperor of Song, Liu Yu (刘昱), was cruel; in 474 Liu Xiufan, Prince of Guiyang, rose at Xunyang and was beheaded by Xiao Daocheng, who thereby gained control of the palace army.

snaps.era2: 魏太和三年
snaps.d: 477 年七月萧道成杀宋后废帝，立顺帝刘准，独掌朝政；十二月荆州刺史沈攸之起兵江陵讨伐萧道成，478 年正月围攻郢城不下，部众溃散，自缢而死。479 年四月萧道成受禅称帝，国号齐（南齐），宋亡。北魏冯太后临朝，推行俸禄制。远西匈人帝国在阿提拉死后瓦解，黑海、里海以北草原归保加尔、萨比尔诸部。
snaps.te: Xiao Daocheng replaces Song and founds Qi
snaps.de: In the 7th month of 477 Xiao Daocheng killed the Later Deposed Emperor of Song, set up Emperor Shun, Liu Zhun, and took sole control of the government; in the 12th month Shen Youzhi, Inspector of Jing Province, rose at Jiangling against Xiao Daocheng, but in the 1st month of 478 he failed to take Yingcheng, his followers scattered, and he hanged himself. In the 4th month of 479 Xiao Daocheng accepted the abdication and proclaimed himself emperor, naming his dynasty Qi (Southern Qi), and Song came to an end. In the Northern Wei, Empress Dowager Feng, ruling from behind the screen, introduced official salaries. In the far west the Hunnic empire broke up after the death of Attila, and the steppe north of the Black Sea and the Caspian passed to the Bulgar and Sabir tribes.

snaps.era2: 魏太和十八年
snaps.d:
485 年北魏颁行均田令，486 年立三长制。490 年冯太后去世，孝文帝亲政，493 年以南伐为名率步骑三十万至洛阳，借秋雨连绵定议迁都，494 年十月正式迁都洛阳，此后禁胡服、断北语、改汉姓、定门第。齐明帝萧鸾 494 年废杀二帝自立。
487 年高车副伏罗部阿伏至罗率十余万落西迁，脱离柔然，在车师前部西北建国；高昌先后由张氏、马氏、麴氏为王。494 年夫余被勿吉所逼，王室投奔高句丽，夫余灭亡。嚈哒南下取犍陀罗，并吞寄多罗余部；吐谷浑据有鄯善、且末；雅隆河谷的悉补野部渐强。
snaps.te: Emperor Xiaowen moves the capital to Luoyang
snaps.de:
In 485 the Northern Wei issued the equal-field decree, and in 486 it set up the system of the Three Elders. Empress Dowager Feng died in 490 and Emperor Xiaowen took personal control; in 493, ostensibly marching south, he led three hundred thousand foot and horse to Luoyang and, using the ceaseless autumn rains, had the court agree to move the capital; in the 10th month of 494 the capital formally moved to Luoyang, and thereafter Xianbei dress and the northern language were banned, Chinese surnames adopted and family ranks fixed. Emperor Ming of Qi, Xiao Luan, deposed and killed two emperors in 494 and took the throne himself.
In 487 Afuzhiluo of the Fufuluo tribe of the Gaoche led more than a hundred thousand tents west, broke away from the Rouran, and founded a state northwest of Nearer Jushi; Gaochang was ruled in turn by kings of the Zhang, Ma and Qu clans. In 494 Buyeo, pressed by the Wuji, came to an end when its royal house fled to Goguryeo. The Hephthalites moved south to take Gandhara, absorbing the remnants of the Kidarites; the Tuyuhun held Shanshan and Qiemo; the Pugyal of the Yarlung valley were growing stronger.

snaps.era2: 魏太和二十二年
snaps.d: 497 年八月孝文帝亲率二十万大军南伐南齐，围攻宛城、新野；498 年正月攻克新野，二月齐南阳太守房伯玉以宛城降魏，沔北五郡尽入北魏，三月魏军在邓城大破齐军。七月齐明帝卒，东昏侯萧宝卷即位，滥杀大臣。
snaps.te: Northern Wei seizes Nanyang
snaps.de: In the 8th month of 497 Emperor Xiaowen marched south against Southern Qi in person with an army of two hundred thousand, besieging Wancheng and Xinye; in the 1st month of 498 he took Xinye, in the 2nd month Fang Boyu, the Qi Administrator of Nanyang, surrendered Wancheng to Wei, and the five commanderies north of the Mian passed wholly to the Northern Wei; in the 3rd month the Wei army routed the Qi army at Dengcheng. In the 7th month Emperor Ming of Qi died, and Xiao Baojuan, the Marquis of Donghun, took the throne and slaughtered his ministers.

snaps.era2: 魏景明元年
snaps.d: 正月齐豫州刺史裴叔业以寿阳降魏，淮南重镇入魏。499 年孝文帝卒于南征途中，宣武帝即位。500 年十月东昏侯杀尚书令萧懿，十一月萧懿之弟雍州刺史萧衍在襄阳起兵，联合荆州行事萧颖胄，奉南康王萧宝融为主，十二月顺江东下。
snaps.te: Shouyang goes over to Wei · Xiao Yan takes up arms
snaps.de: In the 1st month Pei Shuye, the Qi Inspector of Yu Province, surrendered Shouyang to Wei, and the great Huainan stronghold passed to Wei. Emperor Xiaowen had died in 499 on campaign in the south, and Emperor Xuanwu had taken the throne. In the 10th month of 500 the Marquis of Donghun killed Xiao Yi (萧懿), Director of the Department of State Affairs; in the 11th month Xiao Yi's younger brother Xiao Yan, Inspector of Yong Province, rose at Xiangyang, joined forces with Xiao Yingzhou, acting head of Jing Province, set up Xiao Baorong, Prince of Nankang, as his sovereign, and in the 12th month went down the Yangtze.

labe.101: Xiao Yan & Xiao Yingzhou (Yong and Jing)

snaps.era2: 魏景明三年
snaps.d: 501 年三月萧宝融在江陵即位（和帝），萧衍军顺流而下，七月攻克郢城，九月进围建康，十二月东昏侯被部下所杀，萧衍入城总揽大权。502 年四月萧衍受齐和帝禅让称帝，国号梁，齐亡。北魏乘机南侵，围攻钟离、义阳。
snaps.te: Xiao Yan founds Liang
snaps.de: In the 3rd month of 501 Xiao Baorong took the throne at Jiangling (Emperor He); Xiao Yan's army went down the Yangtze, took Yingcheng in the 7th month and besieged Jiankang in the 9th, and in the 12th month the Marquis of Donghun was killed by his own men and Xiao Yan entered the city and took over the government. In the 4th month of 502 Xiao Yan accepted the abdication of Emperor He of Qi and proclaimed himself emperor, naming his dynasty Liang, and Qi came to an end. The Northern Wei seized the chance to invade the south, besieging Zhongli and Yiyang.

snaps.era2: 魏正始二年
snaps.d: 504 年八月北魏元英攻克义阳，梁在淮汉之间失去三关要地。505 年正月梁梁州长史夏侯道迁以汉中降魏，魏军进占南郑，汉中归北魏；十月梁武帝以临川王萧宏为帅大举北伐，器械精新，号称百年所未有。叙利亚边地的加萨尼阿拉伯部落 502 年起成为东罗马的盟邦。
snaps.te: Northern Wei takes Yiyang and Hanzhong
snaps.de: In the 8th month of 504 Yuan Ying of the Northern Wei took Yiyang, and Liang lost the key ground of the Three Passes between the Huai and the Han. In the 1st month of 505 Xiahou Daoqian, Liang's Chief Clerk of Liang Province, surrendered Hanzhong to Wei, the Wei army occupied Nanzheng, and Hanzhong passed to the Northern Wei. In the 10th month Emperor Wu of Liang launched a great northern expedition under Xiao Hong, Prince of Linchuan, its equipment so fine and new that it was said nothing like it had been seen in a hundred years. On the Syrian frontier the Ghassanid Arab tribes became allies of the Eastern Roman Empire from 502.

snaps.era2: 魏正始四年
snaps.d: 506 年九月梁军主帅萧宏在洛口闻风溃逃，北伐失败；同年北魏攻灭武兴杨氏，置武兴镇。北魏中山王元英、杨大眼率数十万大军乘胜围攻钟离，在淮河邵阳洲架设浮桥；507 年三月梁将韦叡、曹景宗乘淮水暴涨，以火船焚毁浮桥，魏军溺死、被杀十余万，元英单骑逃回，北魏南进势头受挫。
snaps.te: Battle of Zhongli
snaps.de: In the 9th month of 506 the Liang commander-in-chief Xiao Hong fled in panic at Luokou at the first sign of the enemy, and the northern expedition failed; the same year the Northern Wei destroyed the Yang of Wuxing and set up Wuxing Garrison. Yuan Ying, Prince of Zhongshan, and Yang Dayan of the Northern Wei, flushed with victory, besieged Zhongli with several hundred thousand men and built a pontoon bridge at Shaoyang Islet in the Huai; in the 3rd month of 507 the Liang generals Wei Rui and Cao Jingzong, taking advantage of a sudden rise of the Huai, burned the bridge with fire ships; more than a hundred thousand Wei soldiers drowned or were killed, Yuan Ying fled back alone on horseback, and the Northern Wei advance south was checked.

snaps.era2: 魏正光五年
snaps.d:
514—516 年梁筑浮山堰壅淮水以灌寿阳，堰成后溃决，沿淮十余万人漂溺。北魏迁洛以后，北边六镇的鲜卑军户地位一落千丈；523 年柔然入寇，怀荒镇民杀镇将，次年三月沃野镇民破六韩拔陵起兵，各镇响应，攻陷怀朔、武川诸镇；六月秦州羌人莫折大提起兵，其子莫折念生称天子；高平胡琛、万俟丑奴起兵，关陇大乱。梁乘机北伐淮南。
梁武帝崇佛，南海诸国狼牙修、丹丹、干陁利、婆利等相继遣使；嚈哒此时极盛，东役西域诸国，南侵天竺，夺取粟特诸城。
snaps.te: Six Garrisons uprising · risings in Guanlong
snaps.de:
In 514–516 Liang built the Fushan Dam to dam the Huai and flood Shouyang; when finished the dam burst, and more than a hundred thousand people along the Huai were swept away and drowned. After the Northern Wei moved to Luoyang, the standing of the Xianbei military households of the Six Garrisons on the northern frontier collapsed; in 523 the Rouran raided, and the garrison people of Huaihuang killed their commander; in the 3rd month of the following year Poliuhan Baling of the Woye Garrison rose in arms, the other garrisons rose in answer, and Huaishuo, Wuchuan and others fell; in the 6th month Mozhe Dati, a Qiang of Qin Province, rose in arms and his son Mozhe Niansheng styled himself Son of Heaven; Hu Chen and Moqi Chounu rose at Gaoping, and Guanlong was in turmoil. Liang seized the chance to march north into Huainan.
Emperor Wu of Liang was devoted to Buddhism, and the states of the Southern Seas — Langkasuka, Dandan, Kantoli, Poli and others — sent envoys one after another; the Hephthalites were at their height, subjugating the states of the Western Regions to the east, invading India to the south, and seizing the Sogdian cities.

snaps.era2: 魏孝昌二年
snaps.t: 六镇降户起事·梁取寿阳
snaps.d: 525 年北魏借柔然阿那瓌之兵击破破六韩拔陵，二十余万降户被安置到河北定、冀、瀛三州就食。525 年八月柔玄镇人杜洛周在上谷起兵；526 年正月鲜于修礼在定州起兵，八月被部将所杀，葛荣继领其众，九月称帝，国号齐。十一月梁将夏侯亶、韦放攻克寿阳，梁收复淮南。阿克苏姆（今埃塞俄比亚）525 年渡红海攻灭希木叶尔，占据也门。
snaps.te: Surrendered Six Garrisons people rise · Liang takes Shouyang
snaps.de: In 525 the Northern Wei, with troops lent by Anagui of the Rouran, crushed Poliuhan Baling, and more than two hundred thousand who had surrendered were sent to Ding, Ji and Ying provinces in Hebei to be fed. In the 8th month of 525 Du Luozhou of the Rouxuan Garrison rose at Shanggu; in the 1st month of 526 Xianyu Xiuli rose in Ding Province, and when he was killed by his own general in the 8th month, Ge Rong took over his followers and in the 9th month proclaimed himself emperor, naming his state Qi. In the 11th month the Liang generals Xiahou Dan and Wei Fang took Shouyang, and Liang recovered Huainan. In 525 Aksum (in today's Ethiopia) crossed the Red Sea, destroyed Himyar and occupied Yemen.

snaps.era2: 魏建义元年
snaps.d: 二月胡太后鸩杀孝明帝，秀容契胡酋长尔朱荣以此为由自晋阳南下，四月拥立孝庄帝，在河阴将胡太后、幼主沉于黄河，屠杀王公朝臣二千余人，史称河阴之变。葛荣兼并杜洛周，九月率众数十万南围邺城，尔朱荣以七千精骑在滏口奇袭，生擒葛荣，河北平定。关陇万俟丑奴称帝，青州流民邢杲起兵。
snaps.te: Heyin massacre · Battle of Fukou
snaps.de: In the 2nd month Empress Dowager Hu poisoned Emperor Xiaoming; on this pretext Erzhu Rong, chieftain of the Qihu of Xiurong, marched south from Jinyang, in the 4th month set up Emperor Xiaozhuang, and at Heyin drowned the Empress Dowager Hu and the child emperor in the Yellow River and massacred more than two thousand princes and officials — the Heyin massacre. Ge Rong absorbed Du Luozhou and in the 9th month marched south with several hundred thousand men to besiege Ye; Erzhu Rong made a surprise attack at Fukou with seven thousand picked horsemen and captured Ge Rong alive, and Hebei was pacified. In Guanlong Moqi Chounu proclaimed himself emperor, and in Qing Province Xing Gao rose with the refugees.

snaps.era2: 魏永安二年
snaps.d: 梁武帝派陈庆之率七千白袍军护送投奔梁朝的北魏北海王元颢北上，自铚县至洛阳，一路攻克三十二城、四十七战全胜，五月攻入洛阳，元颢称帝，孝庄帝北逃；闰六月尔朱荣大军反攻，元颢败死，陈庆之全军覆没，削发化装为僧人逃回。四月邢杲被元天穆平定。
snaps.te: Chen Qingzhi enters Luoyang
snaps.de: Emperor Wu of Liang sent Chen Qingzhi with seven thousand white-robed troops to escort Yuan Hao, Prince of Beihai of the Northern Wei, who had fled to Liang, back north; from Zhi County to Luoyang they took thirty-two cities and won all forty-seven battles, and in the 5th month they broke into Luoyang, where Yuan Hao proclaimed himself emperor and Emperor Xiaozhuang fled north. In the intercalary 6th month Erzhu Rong's great army counterattacked, Yuan Hao was defeated and died, and Chen Qingzhi's army was wiped out; he shaved his head, disguised himself as a monk and escaped home. In the 4th month Xing Gao was put down by Yuan Tianmu.

snaps.era2: 魏永安三年
snaps.d: 四月尔朱天光、贺拔岳、侯莫陈悦西征，生擒万俟丑奴，关陇平定。九月孝庄帝在明光殿伏兵手刃尔朱荣，尔朱兆自晋阳、尔朱世隆自滑台反扑，十二月尔朱兆攻入洛阳，执孝庄帝至晋阳缢杀，另立元晔；尔朱氏子弟分据并州、关陇、徐兖与洛阳。北方六镇之地已为柔然所有。
snaps.te: Erzhu Rong killed · Guanlong pacified
snaps.de: In the 4th month Erzhu Tianguang, Heba Yue and Houmochen Yue marched west and captured Moqi Chounu alive, and Guanlong was pacified. In the 9th month Emperor Xiaozhuang laid an ambush in the Mingguang Hall and killed Erzhu Rong with his own hand; Erzhu Zhao struck back from Jinyang and Erzhu Shilong from Huatai, and in the 12th month Erzhu Zhao broke into Luoyang, carried Emperor Xiaozhuang to Jinyang and strangled him, and set up Yuan Ye in his place; the young men of the Erzhu clan divided Bing Province, Guanlong, Xu and Yan, and Luoyang among themselves. The northern lands of the Six Garrisons were already in Rouran hands.

snaps.era2: 魏普泰元年
snaps.d: 二月尔朱世隆废元晔，立元恭（节闵帝）。六月高欢率六镇降户在信都起兵讨伐尔朱氏，十月立渤海太守元朗为帝，在广阿大破尔朱兆，据有河北。
snaps.te: Gao Huan takes up arms at Xindu
snaps.de: In the 2nd month Erzhu Shilong deposed Yuan Ye and set up Yuan Gong (Emperor Jiemin). In the 6th month Gao Huan rose at Xindu against the Erzhu, leading the Six Garrisons people who had surrendered; in the 10th month he made Yuan Lang, Administrator of Bohai, emperor, crushed Erzhu Zhao at Guang'e, and held Hebei.

snaps.era2: 魏太昌元年
snaps.d: 正月高欢攻克邺城；闰三月尔朱兆、尔朱天光、尔朱度律、尔朱仲远合兵二十万进攻邺城，高欢以不足三万之众在韩陵山布圆阵决战，大破尔朱联军。四月高欢入洛阳，废节闵帝与元朗，立孝武帝元修，自为大丞相，七月进占晋阳，以此为霸府。尔朱天光被擒杀，尔朱仲远奔梁，关陇由贺拔岳统领。
snaps.te: Battle of Hanling
snaps.de: In the 1st month Gao Huan took Ye; in the intercalary 3rd month Erzhu Zhao, Erzhu Tianguang, Erzhu Dulü and Erzhu Zhongyuan attacked Ye with a combined force of two hundred thousand, and Gao Huan, with fewer than thirty thousand men drawn up in a circular formation at Mount Hanling, fought a decisive battle and crushed the Erzhu coalition. In the 4th month Gao Huan entered Luoyang, deposed Emperor Jiemin and Yuan Lang, set up Emperor Xiaowu, Yuan Xiu, and made himself Grand Chancellor; in the 7th month he occupied Jinyang and made it his headquarters. Erzhu Tianguang was captured and killed, Erzhu Zhongyuan fled to Liang, and Guanlong was under the command of Heba Yue.

snaps.era2: 东魏天平元年
snaps.d:
533 年高欢击灭尔朱兆。534 年二月高欢唆使侯莫陈悦杀关西大行台贺拔岳，宇文泰被众将推举接掌其众，四月击杀侯莫陈悦，据有关陇。孝武帝与高欢决裂，七月西奔长安投靠宇文泰；十月高欢另立元善见（孝静帝），迁都邺城，史称东魏；闰十二月宇文泰鸩杀孝武帝，次年正月立元宝炬（文帝），史称西魏。北魏梁州刺史以汉中降梁。
朝鲜半岛南部的金官伽倻 532 年降于新罗。北魏末年东北大兴安岭一带的失韦（室韦）始与中原通使。天竺各地起兵驱逐嚈哒，嚈哒退守迦湿弥罗、犍陀罗。
snaps.te: Northern Wei splits into East and West
snaps.de:
In 533 Gao Huan destroyed Erzhu Zhao. In the 2nd month of 534 Gao Huan incited Houmochen Yue to kill Heba Yue, Grand Branch Department Director of the West of the Passes; the generals chose Yuwen Tai to take over Heba Yue's army, and in the 4th month he killed Houmochen Yue and held Guanlong. Emperor Xiaowu broke with Gao Huan and in the 7th month fled west to Chang'an to take refuge with Yuwen Tai; in the 10th month Gao Huan set up Yuan Shanjian (Emperor Xiaojing) instead and moved the capital to Ye — the Eastern Wei; in the intercalary 12th month Yuwen Tai poisoned Emperor Xiaowu, and in the 1st month of the following year he set up Yuan Baoju (Emperor Wen) — the Western Wei. The Northern Wei Inspector of Liang Province surrendered Hanzhong to Liang.
In southern Korea Geumgwan Gaya submitted to Silla in 532. At the end of the Northern Wei the Shiwei (失韦) of the Greater Khingan in the northeast first exchanged envoys with the Central Plain. Across India rulers rose to drive out the Hephthalites, who fell back to hold Kashmir and Gandhara.

snaps.era2: 东魏天平四年 · 西魏大统三年
snaps.d: 正月东魏高欢三路攻西魏，窦泰在小关被宇文泰奇袭阵亡，高欢撤回。十月高欢率二十万大军渡河攻西魏，宇文泰以不足一万之众在沙苑设伏，背水列阵，大破东魏军，俘获七万。西魏乘胜东进，攻取河东蒲坂，独孤信收复洛阳，颍川、豫州诸地也相继归附西魏。
snaps.era2e: Eastern Wei: Tianping 4 · Western Wei: Datong 3
snaps.te: Battle of Shayuan
snaps.de: In the 1st month Gao Huan of the Eastern Wei attacked the Western Wei along three routes; Dou Tai was killed when Yuwen Tai surprised him at Xiaoguan, and Gao Huan withdrew. In the 10th month Gao Huan crossed the Yellow River with two hundred thousand men to attack the Western Wei; Yuwen Tai, with fewer than ten thousand, laid an ambush at Shayuan with his back to the river and crushed the Eastern Wei army, taking seventy thousand prisoners. The Western Wei followed up its victory by advancing east and taking Puban in Hedong; Dugu Xin recovered Luoyang, and Yingchuan, Yu Province and other places went over to the Western Wei.

snaps.era2: 东魏元象元年 · 西魏大统四年
snaps.d: 七月东魏侯景、高敖曹等围攻洛阳金墉城，宇文泰率军东援，八月在河桥、邙山一带激战，两军各有胜负，东魏猛将高敖曹战死，西魏军最终溃败西撤，洛阳、颍川诸地复归东魏，西魏仅保弘农与河东。侯景出任东魏河南道大行台，拥兵十万，专制河南。
snaps.era2e: Eastern Wei: Yuanxiang 1 · Western Wei: Datong 4
snaps.te: Battle of Heqiao
snaps.de: In the 7th month Hou Jing, Gao Aocao and others of the Eastern Wei besieged Jinyong City at Luoyang; Yuwen Tai led an army east to relieve it, and in the 8th month there was fierce fighting around Heqiao and Mount Mang, with victories and defeats on both sides; the Eastern Wei champion Gao Aocao was killed, but in the end the Western Wei army broke and withdrew west; Luoyang, Yingchuan and other places returned to the Eastern Wei, and the Western Wei kept only Hongnong and Hedong. Hou Jing became the Eastern Wei Grand Branch Department Director of the Henan Circuit, commanding a hundred thousand troops and ruling Henan as he pleased.

snaps.era2: 东魏武定元年 · 西魏大统九年
snaps.d: 二月东魏北豫州刺史高仲密以虎牢降西魏，宇文泰率军接应，三月在洛阳北邙山与高欢大战，首日西魏大胜，几乎擒获高欢，次日东魏反攻，西魏大败，宇文泰仅以身免，虎牢复归东魏。柔然阿那瓌 541 年攻灭高车，复统漠北；吐谷浑夸吕称可汗，定都伏俟城。
snaps.era2e: Eastern Wei: Wuding 1 · Western Wei: Datong 9
snaps.te: Battle of Mount Mang
snaps.de: In the 2nd month Gao Zhongmi, the Eastern Wei Inspector of Northern Yu Province, surrendered Hulao to the Western Wei, and Yuwen Tai led an army to receive it; in the 3rd month he fought a great battle with Gao Huan at Mount Mang north of Luoyang. On the first day the Western Wei won a great victory and nearly captured Gao Huan; the next day the Eastern Wei counterattacked and routed the Western Wei, Yuwen Tai barely escaping with his life, and Hulao returned to the Eastern Wei. In 541 Anagui of the Rouran destroyed the Gaoche and reunited the lands north of the Gobi; Kualü of the Tuyuhun took the title Qaghan and made Fuqi City his capital.

snaps.era2: 东魏武定四年 · 西魏大统十二年
snaps.d: 九月高欢倾全国之兵围攻西魏玉璧城，挖地道、筑土山、断汾水，韦孝宽随机应变、坚守不下，五十余日间东魏死伤七万，十一月高欢退兵，忧愤成疾，547 年正月病死于晋阳。
snaps.era2e: Eastern Wei: Wuding 4 · Western Wei: Datong 12
snaps.te: Battle of Yubi
snaps.de: In the 9th month Gao Huan threw the whole strength of his state against the Western Wei fortress of Yubi, digging tunnels, raising earthen mounds and cutting off the Fen River; Wei Xiaokuan met every move and held firm, and in more than fifty days the Eastern Wei lost seventy thousand killed and wounded. In the 11th month Gao Huan withdrew, fell ill from grief and anger, and in the 1st month of 547 died at Jinyang.

snaps.era2: 东魏武定五年 · 西魏大统十三年
snaps.d: 正月高欢死后，侯景以河南十三州叛东魏，先降西魏，二月又转降梁，梁武帝不顾群臣反对纳之，封为河南王；西魏王思政乘机入据颍川长社，侯景所献荆州（穰城）一带也归西魏。十一月梁军以萧渊明为帅，在彭城附近寒山堰泗水攻东魏，被慕容绍宗大败，萧渊明被俘。交州李贲 544 年称帝，547 年被梁将陈霸先击败；梁又在海南岛复置崖州（541）。
snaps.era2e: Eastern Wei: Wuding 5 · Western Wei: Datong 13
snaps.te: Hou Jing breaks with Eastern Wei · Battle of Hanshan
snaps.de: In the 1st month, after Gao Huan's death, Hou Jing rebelled against the Eastern Wei with thirteen provinces of Henan, surrendering first to the Western Wei and then, in the 2nd month, to Liang; Emperor Wu of Liang took him in against his ministers' objections and made him King of Henan. Wang Sizheng of the Western Wei took the opportunity to occupy Changshe in Yingchuan, and the area of Jing Province (Rangcheng) that Hou Jing had offered also passed to the Western Wei. In the 11th month a Liang army under Xiao Yuanming dammed the Si at Hanshan near Pengcheng to attack the Eastern Wei, but was routed by Murong Shaozong, and Xiao Yuanming was captured. Lý Bí of Jiao Province, who had proclaimed himself emperor in 544, was defeated by the Liang general Chen Baxian in 547; Liang also re-established Ya Province on Hainan Island (541).

snaps.era2: 东魏武定六年 · 西魏大统十四年
snaps.d: 正月侯景兵败涡阳，退据梁寿阳；梁武帝与东魏议和，侯景疑惧，八月在寿阳起兵反梁，十月勾结梁临贺王萧正德自采石渡江，攻入建康外城，围困台城。东魏乘机收复河南，围攻长社。
snaps.era2e: Eastern Wei: Wuding 6 · Western Wei: Datong 14
snaps.te: Hou Jing's rebellion begins
snaps.de: In the 1st month Hou Jing was defeated at Guoyang and fell back to hold the Liang city of Shouyang; when Emperor Wu of Liang negotiated peace with the Eastern Wei, Hou Jing grew suspicious and afraid, and in the 8th month he rose against Liang at Shouyang; in the 10th month, in league with Xiao Zhengde, the Liang Prince of Linhe, he crossed the Yangtze at Caishi, broke into the outer city of Jiankang and besieged Taicheng. The Eastern Wei seized the chance to recover Henan and besieged Changshe.

snaps.era2: 东魏武定七年 · 西魏大统十五年
snaps.d: 三月侯景攻破台城，梁武帝被软禁，五月饿死，侯景立太子萧纲（简文帝），纵兵掠夺三吴。各地梁宗室拥兵观望、互相攻伐：湘东王萧绎据江陵，武陵王萧纪据益州，河东王萧誉据湘州，岳阳王萧詧据襄阳、称藩西魏。东魏乘乱夺取淮南、江北诸州，六月攻克长社，俘西魏王思政。
snaps.era2e: Eastern Wei: Wuding 7 · Western Wei: Datong 15
snaps.te: Fall of Taicheng
snaps.de: In the 3rd month Hou Jing took Taicheng; Emperor Wu of Liang was held under house arrest and starved to death in the 5th month, and Hou Jing set up the crown prince Xiao Gang (Emperor Jianwen) and let his troops plunder the Three Wu. The Liang princes in the provinces held back their armies and watched, or fought one another: Xiao Yi, Prince of Xiangdong, held Jiangling, Xiao Ji, Prince of Wuling, Yi Province, Xiao Yu, Prince of Hedong, Xiang Province, and Xiao Cha, Prince of Yueyang, Xiangyang, as a vassal of the Western Wei. The Eastern Wei used the chaos to seize the provinces of Huainan and north of the Yangtze, and in the 6th month it took Changshe and captured Wang Sizheng of the Western Wei.

snaps.era2: 北齐天保元年 · 西魏大统十六年
snaps.t: 北齐代东魏·西魏取汉东
snaps.d: 五月东魏权臣高洋废孝静帝自立，国号齐（北齐）。东魏、北齐乘梁乱尽取淮南、江北，广陵、合肥、钟离相继陷落；西魏杨忠攻取梁汉东随郡、安陆、竟陵，萧绎被迫称臣，与西魏约以石城为界。四月萧绎攻杀湘州萧誉。交州赵光复收复龙编，自称越王。
snaps.era2e: Northern Qi: Tianbao 1 · Western Wei: Datong 16
snaps.te: Northern Qi replaces Eastern Wei · Western Wei takes Handong
snaps.de: In the 5th month Gao Yang, the powerful minister of the Eastern Wei, deposed Emperor Xiaojing and took the throne himself, naming his dynasty Qi (Northern Qi). Taking advantage of the chaos in Liang, the Eastern Wei and Northern Qi took all of Huainan and the land north of the Yangtze, and Guangling, Hefei and Zhongli fell one after another; Yang Zhong of the Western Wei took the Liang commanderies of Sui, Anlu and Jingling in Handong, and Xiao Yi was forced to declare himself a subject and agree with the Western Wei on Shicheng as the border. In the 4th month Xiao Yi attacked and killed Xiao Yu in Xiang Province. Triệu Quang Phục of Jiao Province recovered Longbian and styled himself King of Yue.

snaps.era2: 北齐天保二年 · 西魏大统十七年
snaps.d: 侯景率军西上，攻陷郢州，围攻巴陵，被王僧辩坚守挫败，退还建康；八月废简文帝，十月杀之，十一月自立为帝，国号汉。萧绎派王僧辩、陈霸先率军东下讨伐。
snaps.era2e: Northern Qi: Tianbao 2 · Western Wei: Datong 17
snaps.te: Hou Jing proclaims himself emperor
snaps.de: Hou Jing led his army west up the Yangtze, took Ying Province and besieged Baling, but was thwarted by Wang Sengbian's stubborn defense and fell back to Jiankang; in the 8th month he deposed Emperor Jianwen, killed him in the 10th month, and in the 11th month made himself emperor, naming his state Han. Xiao Yi sent Wang Sengbian and Chen Baxian down the Yangtze with an army to punish him.

snaps.era2: 北齐天保三年 · 西魏废帝元年
snaps.d: 三月王僧辩、陈霸先攻入建康，侯景东逃，四月在海上被部下所杀，梁收复建康；十一月萧绎在江陵即位（元帝），不还都建康，以王僧辩镇建康、陈霸先镇京口。四月萧纪在成都称帝，率军东下；西魏达奚武攻取汉中。北齐乘乱占据历阳等江北要地。正月突厥土门可汗大破柔然，阿那瓌自杀，土门自称伊利可汗，突厥汗国建立。
snaps.era2e: Northern Qi: Tianbao 3 · Western Wei: Deposed Emperor 1
snaps.te: Hou Jing defeated and killed · Turks destroy the Rouran
snaps.de: In the 3rd month Wang Sengbian and Chen Baxian broke into Jiankang; Hou Jing fled east and in the 4th month was killed at sea by his own men, and Liang recovered Jiankang. In the 11th month Xiao Yi took the throne at Jiangling (Emperor Yuan) without returning the capital to Jiankang, stationing Wang Sengbian at Jiankang and Chen Baxian at Jingkou. In the 4th month Xiao Ji proclaimed himself emperor at Chengdu and led his army down the Yangtze; Daxi Wu of the Western Wei took Hanzhong. Northern Qi used the chaos to occupy Liyang and other key points north of the Yangtze. In the 1st month Tumen Qaghan of the Turks crushed the Rouran, Anagui killed himself, and Tumen styled himself Il Qaghan: the Turkic Qaghanate was founded.

snaps.era2: 北齐天保四年 · 西魏废帝二年
snaps.d: 萧纪率军东下攻萧绎，萧绎求救于西魏，宇文泰派尉迟迥率军经剑阁南下，七月萧纪在硖口兵败被杀，八月尉迟迥攻克成都，巴蜀尽入西魏，南中诸爨、洱海诸部从此脱离南朝。新罗真兴王在 551 年与百济合攻高句丽、收复汉江流域后，553 年又夺取百济所得的汉江下游。天竺笈多王朝已经瓦解，诸国并立；扶南为其属国真腊所侵逼，堕罗钵底在湄南河下游兴起。
snaps.era2e: Northern Qi: Tianbao 4 · Western Wei: Deposed Emperor 2
snaps.te: Western Wei takes Shu
snaps.de: Xiao Ji led his army down the Yangtze against Xiao Yi; Xiao Yi asked the Western Wei for help, and Yuwen Tai sent Yuchi Jiong south with an army by way of Jiange. In the 7th month Xiao Ji was defeated and killed at Xiakou, and in the 8th month Yuchi Jiong took Chengdu: all of Ba-Shu passed to the Western Wei, and from then on the Cuan clans of Nanzhong and the Erhai tribes were lost to the Southern Dynasties. After King Jinheung of Silla had joined Baekje in attacking Goguryeo and recovering the Han River basin in 551, in 553 he also seized the lower Han River that Baekje had gained. In India the Gupta dynasty had disintegrated and its states stood side by side; Funan was pressed by its vassal Chenla, and Dvaravati was rising on the lower Chao Phraya.

snaps.era2: 北齐天保五年 · 西魏恭帝元年
snaps.d: 九月西魏于谨、杨忠、宇文护率五万大军南下，与萧詧会合，十一月攻破江陵，梁元帝萧绎焚古今图书十四万卷后出降，十二月被杀；西魏掳江陵官民男女十余万口北归为奴婢；峡口以西的巴东诸郡也归西魏。王僧辩、陈霸先据建康，梁室无主。百济圣王在管山城战死。
snaps.era2e: Northern Qi: Tianbao 5 · Western Wei: Emperor Gong 1
snaps.te: Fall of Jiangling
snaps.de: In the 9th month Yu Jin, Yang Zhong and Yuwen Hu of the Western Wei marched south with fifty thousand men, joined forces with Xiao Cha, and in the 11th month took Jiangling; Emperor Yuan of Liang, Xiao Yi, burned 140,000 scrolls of books old and new and surrendered, and was killed in the 12th month. The Western Wei carried off more than a hundred thousand officials and townspeople of Jiangling, men and women, to the north as slaves; the commanderies of Badong west of the gorges also passed to the Western Wei. Wang Sengbian and Chen Baxian held Jiankang, and the house of Liang had no ruler. King Seong of Baekje was killed in battle at Gwansanseong.

snaps.era2: 北齐天保六年 · 西魏恭帝二年
snaps.t: 后梁建立·陈霸先杀王僧辩
snaps.d: 正月萧詧在西魏扶植下于江陵称帝（后梁），仅有江陵附近三百里之地，襄阳归西魏。北齐送被俘的萧渊明南归，五月王僧辩迫于形势迎立萧渊明为帝；九月陈霸先自京口袭杀王僧辩，废萧渊明，十月立萧方智（敬帝）。北齐趁势出兵江南，与陈霸先相持于建康。王琳据湘州，拥兵自重。
snaps.era2e: Northern Qi: Tianbao 6 · Western Wei: Emperor Gong 2
snaps.te: Later Liang founded · Chen Baxian kills Wang Sengbian
snaps.de: In the 1st month Xiao Cha proclaimed himself emperor at Jiangling with Western Wei backing (Later Liang), holding only the land within three hundred li of Jiangling, while Xiangyang passed to the Western Wei. Northern Qi sent the captive Xiao Yuanming back south, and in the 5th month Wang Sengbian, bowing to circumstances, accepted Xiao Yuanming as emperor; in the 9th month Chen Baxian struck from Jingkou and killed Wang Sengbian, deposed Xiao Yuanming, and in the 10th month set up Xiao Fangzhi (Emperor Jing). Northern Qi seized the chance to send armies south of the Yangtze, which faced Chen Baxian at Jiankang. Wang Lin held Xiang Province, keeping his army for himself.

snaps.era2: 北齐天保八年 · 北周孝闵帝元年
snaps.t: 北周代西魏·陈霸先建陈
snaps.d:
556 年六月陈霸先在建康城北大破北齐军，十月宇文泰病死，侄宇文护辅政。557 年正月宇文觉受西魏恭帝禅位，称周天王（北周）；十月陈霸先受梁敬帝禅位，国号陈。王琳拥兵湘、郢，拒不奉陈，次年在郢州奉萧庄为梁帝，联结北齐。
吐谷浑以南的白兰、党项与川西的附国诸羌，此时始见于北朝史籍；东北勿吉改称靺鞨。
snaps.era2e: Northern Qi: Tianbao 8 · Northern Zhou: Emperor Xiaomin 1
snaps.te: Northern Zhou replaces Western Wei · Chen Baxian founds Chen
snaps.de:
In the 6th month of 556 Chen Baxian crushed the Northern Qi army north of Jiankang; in the 10th month Yuwen Tai died of illness, and his nephew Yuwen Hu became regent. In the 1st month of 557 Yuwen Jue accepted the abdication of Emperor Gong of Western Wei and took the title Heavenly King of Zhou (Northern Zhou); in the 10th month Chen Baxian accepted the abdication of Emperor Jing of Liang, naming his dynasty Chen. Wang Lin, with his army in Xiang and Ying provinces, refused to serve Chen, and the following year at Ying Province he set up Xiao Zhuang as emperor of Liang, allying himself with Northern Qi.
The Bailan and the Tanguts south of the Tuyuhun and the Qiang of Fuguo in western Sichuan first appear in Northern Dynasties histories at this time; in the northeast the Wuji came to be called Mohe.

snaps.era2: 北齐乾明元年 · 北周武成二年
snaps.d: 二月陈将侯瑱在芜湖大破王琳，王琳与萧庄投奔北齐，郢州以西诸郡归陈。北周乘机南下，贺若敦攻入湘州，与陈军相持，翌年撤回。北齐文宣帝 559 年死后宫廷屡变；北周宇文护先后弑孝闵帝、毒杀明帝，立武帝宇文邕（560）。黑海以北草原上出现自东方而来的阿瓦尔人。
snaps.era2e: Northern Qi: Qianming 1 · Northern Zhou: Wucheng 2
snaps.te: Fall of Wang Lin · Northern Zhou enters Xiang Province
snaps.de: In the 2nd month the Chen general Hou Tian crushed Wang Lin at Wuhu; Wang Lin and Xiao Zhuang fled to Northern Qi, and the commanderies west of Ying Province passed to Chen. The Northern Zhou seized the chance to march south; Heruo Dun broke into Xiang Province and held off the Chen army until he withdrew the following year. After Emperor Wenxuan of Northern Qi died in 559 the court went through repeated upheavals; Yuwen Hu of the Northern Zhou murdered Emperor Xiaomin and then poisoned Emperor Ming, and set up Emperor Wu, Yuwen Yong (560). On the steppe north of the Black Sea the Avars appeared, coming from the east.

snaps.era2: 北齐河清三年 · 北周保定四年
snaps.d:
563 年九月北周与突厥联兵，杨忠率步骑一万出塞，与突厥木杆可汗十万骑会合，564 年正月在晋阳城下与北齐决战，周军大败而还；十月宇文护又倾全国二十万兵攻洛阳，十二月北齐兰陵王高长恭以五百骑突入金墉城下解围，段韶、斛律光在邙山大破周军。陈朝平定留异、陈宝应等地方割据，湘州亦归陈。
突厥西部室点密可汗与萨珊波斯夹击嚈哒（约 560），嚈哒灭亡，突厥据有乌浒水以北，吐火罗诸国附于突厥。新罗 562 年攻灭大加耶，伽倻诸国尽入新罗。
snaps.era2e: Northern Qi: Heqing 3 · Northern Zhou: Baoding 4
snaps.te: Battles of Jinyang and Mount Mang
snaps.de:
In the 9th month of 563 the Northern Zhou joined forces with the Turks: Yang Zhong led ten thousand foot and horse beyond the frontier to meet the hundred thousand horsemen of Muqan Qaghan, and in the 1st month of 564 they fought a decisive battle with Northern Qi beneath the walls of Jinyang, from which the Zhou army returned badly beaten. In the 10th month Yuwen Hu threw the whole strength of the state, two hundred thousand men, against Luoyang; in the 12th month Gao Changgong, Prince of Lanling of Northern Qi, broke through to the foot of Jinyong City with five hundred horsemen and raised the siege, and Duan Shao and Hulü Guang crushed the Zhou army at Mount Mang. Chen put down the regional strongmen Liu Yi, Chen Baoying and others, and Xiang Province also passed to Chen.
Istämi Qaghan of the western Turks and Sasanian Persia caught the Hephthalites between them (c. 560); the Hephthalites were destroyed, the Turks held the land north of the Oxus, and the states of Tokharistan submitted to the Turks. Silla destroyed Daegaya in 562, and all the Gaya states passed to Silla.

snaps.era2: 北齐武平四年 · 北周建德二年
snaps.d: 572 年北周武帝诛杀专权十五年的宇文护，亲掌朝政；北齐后主听信谗言杀害名将斛律光。573 年三月陈宣帝命吴明彻率十万大军北伐北齐，连克秦郡、历阳、合肥，十月攻克寿阳，俘王琳斩之，淮南、江北之地尽归陈。571 年交州李佛子继赵光复之后据有龙编。远西萨珊 570 年出兵也门，逐走阿克苏姆人；突厥西部（西突厥）势力已达伏尔加河。
snaps.era2e: Northern Qi: Wuping 4 · Northern Zhou: Jiande 2
snaps.te: Taijian northern expedition · Chen recovers Huainan
snaps.de: In 572 Emperor Wu of the Northern Zhou executed Yuwen Hu, who had held power for fifteen years, and took personal control of the government; the Last Ruler of Northern Qi listened to slanderers and killed the famous general Hulü Guang. In the 3rd month of 573 Emperor Xuan of Chen ordered Wu Mingche north against Northern Qi with an army of a hundred thousand; he took Qin Commandery, Liyang and Hefei in succession, and in the 10th month took Shouyang, capturing and beheading Wang Lin; all the land of Huainan north of the Yangtze passed to Chen. In 571 Lý Phật Tử of Jiao Province had succeeded Triệu Quang Phục in holding Longbian. In the far west the Sasanians sent an army to Yemen in 570 and drove out the Aksumites; the power of the western wing of the Turks (the Western Turks) had already reached the Volga.

snaps.era2: 北周建德六年
snaps.d: 576 年十月北周武帝亲征北齐，攻克平阳（晋州），十二月在平阳城下大破北齐后主所率援军，乘胜攻取晋阳。577 年正月周军攻克邺城，北齐后主禅位于幼子后东逃，被追获，北齐灭亡，北方重归统一。北齐营州刺史高宝宁据营州不降，联结突厥；北齐宗室高绍义投奔突厥佗钵可汗，被立为齐帝。576 年突厥攻取黑海北岸的博斯普鲁斯（刻赤）。
snaps.te: Northern Zhou conquers Northern Qi
snaps.de: In the 10th month of 576 Emperor Wu of the Northern Zhou campaigned in person against Northern Qi and took Pingyang (Jinzhou); in the 12th month he crushed the relief army led by the Last Ruler of Northern Qi beneath the walls of Pingyang and went on to take Jinyang. In the 1st month of 577 the Zhou army took Ye; the Last Ruler of Northern Qi abdicated in favor of his young son and fled east, was overtaken and captured, and Northern Qi fell: the north was reunited. Gao Baoning, the Northern Qi Inspector of Ying Province, held Ying Province and refused to surrender, allying himself with the Turks; Gao Shaoyi of the Northern Qi imperial clan fled to Taspar Qaghan of the Turks and was set up as emperor of Qi. In 576 the Turks took Bosporus (Kerch) on the north shore of the Black Sea.

snaps.era2: 北周宣政元年
snaps.d: 陈宣帝乘北齐灭亡之机争夺淮北，吴明彻围攻彭城；578 年二月北周王轨在吕梁截断清水，以铁锁车轮阻断陈军退路，吴明彻全军覆没被俘。六月周武帝北伐突厥途中病死，宣帝宇文赟即位，荒淫无度。
snaps.te: Battle of Lüliang · death of Emperor Wu of Zhou
snaps.de: Emperor Xuan of Chen took advantage of the fall of Northern Qi to contend for the land north of the Huai, and Wu Mingche besieged Pengcheng; in the 2nd month of 578 Wang Gui of the Northern Zhou cut the Qing River at Lüliang and blocked the Chen army's retreat with cart wheels joined by iron chains, and Wu Mingche's whole army was wiped out and he was captured. In the 6th month Emperor Wu of Zhou died of illness on a northern campaign against the Turks, and Emperor Xuan, Yuwen Yun, took the throne and lived in boundless dissipation.

snaps.era2: 北周大象元年
snaps.d: 二月周宣帝传位于七岁的太子宇文阐（静帝），自称天元皇帝。九月北周韦孝宽、梁士彦等进攻淮南，十一月攻克寿阳，陈朝江北之地尽失，南北以长江为界。
snaps.te: Northern Zhou seizes Huainan
snaps.de: In the 2nd month Emperor Xuan of Zhou handed the throne to his seven-year-old son Yuwen Chan (Emperor Jing) and styled himself Emperor Tianyuan. In the 9th month Wei Xiaokuan, Liang Shiyan and others of the Northern Zhou attacked Huainan, and in the 11th month they took Shouyang; Chen lost all its land north of the Yangtze, and the river became the border between north and south.

snaps.era2: 北周大象二年
snaps.d: 五月周宣帝病死，外戚杨坚矫诏以丞相辅政。六月相州总管尉迟迥在邺城起兵讨伐杨坚，郧州总管司马消难、益州总管王谦相继响应，杨坚派韦孝宽讨伐，八月邺城陷落，尉迟迥自杀，杨坚下令焚毁邺城，迁其居民于安阳；司马消难南奔陈朝，十月王谦败死，杨坚总揽北周大权。
snaps.te: Yuchi Jiong rises · Yang Jian takes the regency
snaps.de: In the 5th month Emperor Xuan of Zhou died of illness, and the empress's father Yang Jian, by a forged edict, became regent as Chancellor. In the 6th month Yuchi Jiong, Superior Area Commander of Xiang Province, rose at Ye against Yang Jian, and Sima Xiaonan, Superior Area Commander of Yun Province, and Wang Qian, Superior Area Commander of Yi Province, rose in answer one after another; Yang Jian sent Wei Xiaokuan against them, and in the 8th month Ye fell and Yuchi Jiong killed himself; Yang Jian ordered Ye burned and its people moved to Anyang. Sima Xiaonan fled south to Chen, and in the 10th month Wang Qian was defeated and died; Yang Jian took control of the whole Northern Zhou state.

snaps.era2: 陈太建十三年
snaps.d:
581 年二月北周静帝禅位于丞相杨坚，隋朝建立，年号开皇。隋承北周之地，据有黄河、长江以北及巴蜀；南朝陈以长江为界据江南、岭南；江陵的后梁是隋的附庸，交州李佛子割据自立，营州尚有北齐旧将高宝宁。
北方突厥沙钵略可汗控弦数十万，东自辽海、西至西海，是隋最大的外患；西陲吐谷浑据青海，高昌、焉耆、龟兹、于阗诸国附于突厥；东北高句丽、百济、新罗三国鼎立。
snaps.te: Yang Jian supplants the Zhou · Sui founded
snaps.de:
In the 2nd month of 581 Emperor Jing of Northern Zhou abdicated in favor of his chancellor Yang Jian; the Sui dynasty was founded, with the era name Kaihuang. Sui inherited the Northern Zhou lands, holding the country north of the Yellow River and the Yangtze as well as Ba and Shu; Chen of the Southern Dynasties held Jiangnan and Lingnan, with the Yangtze as the border; the Later Liang at Jiangling was a Sui vassal; Lý Phật Tử had set himself up independently in Jiaozhou; and Yingzhou was still held by Gao Baoning, a former Northern Qi general.
To the north the Turks under Ishbara Qaghan had several hundred thousand archers and ranged from the Liao Sea in the east to the Western Sea in the west: the greatest external threat to Sui. On the western frontier the Tuyuhun held Qinghai, and Gaochang, Karasahr, Kucha, Khotan and other states were subject to the Turks; in the northeast the three kingdoms of Goguryeo, Baekje and Silla stood in rivalry.

units.note:
西晋（265—316）：司马炎 265 年受魏禅，都洛阳，280 年灭吴统一全国，分十九州。武帝死后贾后专权，291—306 年八王之乱，311 年洛阳陷落（永嘉之乱），316 年长安陷落，愍帝出降。
东晋（317—420）：琅邪王司马睿 317 年在建康称晋王，次年称帝，依靠王导等北来士族与江东豪族立国，前后有王敦、苏峻、桓温、桓玄等权臣、方镇凌驾朝廷。祖逖、庾亮、桓温、谢玄、刘裕先后北伐，347 年灭成汉，383 年淝水大破前秦，417 年一度收复长安。420 年刘裕代晋。
units.notee:
Western Jin (265–316): Sima Yan accepted the abdication of Wei in 265 and made Luoyang his capital; in 280 he conquered Wu, reunified the realm and divided it into nineteen provinces. After Emperor Wu's death Empress Jia monopolized power; the War of the Eight Princes raged from 291 to 306, Luoyang fell in 311 (the Disaster of Yongjia), and in 316 Chang'an fell and Emperor Min surrendered.
Eastern Jin (317–420): Sima Rui, Prince of Langya, took the title King of Jin at Jiankang in 317 and became emperor the following year. The state rested on émigré northern clans led by Wang Dao and on the great families of Jiangdong, and was repeatedly overshadowed by powerful ministers and regional commanders: Wang Dun, Su Jun, Huan Wen and Huan Xuan. Zu Ti, Yu Liang, Huan Wen, Xie Xuan and Liu Yu led successive northern expeditions; Jin destroyed Cheng Han in 347, crushed the Former Qin at the Fei River in 383, and briefly recovered Chang'an in 417. In 420 Liu Yu replaced Jin.

units.note:
刘裕 420 年代晋所建，都建康，南朝第一个王朝，疆域最大时北至黄河。
宋文帝元嘉年间（424—453）号称小康，但 430、450 年两次北伐失败，450 年北魏太武帝饮马长江。此后宗室屡相残杀：453 年太子刘劭弑父，466 年义嘉之难；469 年淮北青、冀、徐、兖四州尽失于北魏。479 年萧道成代宋。
units.notee:
Founded by Liu Yu when he replaced Jin in 420, with its capital at Jiankang; the first of the Southern Dynasties, at its greatest extent reaching the Yellow River in the north.
The Yuanjia era of Emperor Wen (424–453) was remembered as a time of modest prosperity, but the northern expeditions of 430 and 450 both failed, and in 450 Emperor Taiwu of Northern Wei watered his horses at the Yangtze. Thereafter the imperial clan repeatedly turned on itself: in 453 the crown prince Liu Shao murdered his father, and in 466 came the Yijia rebellion; in 469 the four provinces north of the Huai — Qing, Ji, Xu and Yan — were all lost to Northern Wei. In 479 Xiao Daocheng replaced Song.

units.note:
萧道成 479 年代宋所建，都建康，是南朝最短的王朝（479—502）。武帝永明年间较安定，竟陵王萧子良开西邸，文学兴盛（“永明体”）。
明帝萧鸾篡位后大杀宗室，东昏侯萧宝卷荒淫滥杀；498 年失沔北五郡，500 年寿阳降魏。500 年雍州刺史萧衍起兵，502 年代齐建梁。
units.notee:
Founded by Xiao Daocheng when he replaced Song in 479, with its capital at Jiankang; the shortest-lived of the Southern Dynasties (479–502). The Yongming era of Emperor Wu was relatively stable, and literature flourished at the Western Residence of Xiao Ziliang, Prince of Jingling (the "Yongming style").
After usurping the throne Emperor Ming (Xiao Luan) slaughtered the imperial clan, and Xiao Baojuan, the Marquis of Donghun, was dissolute and murderous; in 498 the five commanderies north of the Mian were lost, and in 500 Shouyang went over to Wei. In 500 Xiao Yan, Inspector of Yong Province, rose in arms, and in 502 he replaced Qi and founded Liang.

units.note:
萧衍 502 年代齐所建，都建康。梁武帝在位四十八年，前期勤政，507 年钟离大捷，526 年收复寿阳；晚年崇佛，四次舍身同泰寺，宽纵宗室。
547 年纳东魏叛将侯景，548 年侯景作乱，549 年台城陷落、武帝饿死，宗室互相攻伐，北齐取淮南，西魏取汉东、巴蜀，554 年江陵陷落，梁元帝被杀。557 年陈霸先代梁。
units.notee:
Founded by Xiao Yan when he replaced Qi in 502, with its capital at Jiankang. Emperor Wu of Liang reigned for forty-eight years: diligent in his early years, he won the great victory at Zhongli in 507 and recovered Shouyang in 526; in old age he became devoted to Buddhism, gave himself to Tongtai Temple four times, and indulged the imperial clan.
In 547 he took in Hou Jing, a renegade general of Eastern Wei; in 548 Hou Jing rebelled, and in 549 Taicheng fell and Emperor Wu starved to death. The princes of the clan fought one another, Northern Qi took Huainan, Western Wei took Handong and Ba-Shu, and in 554 Jiangling fell and Emperor Yuan of Liang was killed. In 557 Chen Baxian replaced Liang.

units.note:
陈霸先 557 年代梁所建，都建康。579 年失淮南于北周，此后以长江为界与北朝对峙；后主陈叔宝（582—589 在位）荒于酒色。
589 年正月隋军贺若弼、韩擒虎渡江，攻入建康，后主被俘，陈亡；岭南冼夫人随后率众归隋。
units.notee:
Founded in 557 by Chen Baxian, who supplanted Liang, with its capital at Jiankang. In 579 it lost Huainan to Northern Zhou, and thereafter it faced the Northern Dynasties across the Yangtze; the Last Ruler, Chen Shubao (r. 582–589), indulged in wine and women.
In the 1st month of 589 the Sui forces of Heruo Bi and Han Qinhu crossed the Yangtze and stormed Jiankang; the Last Ruler was captured and Chen fell. Lady Xian of Lingnan then led her people in submitting to Sui.

units.note: 桓温之子桓玄 399 年并吞荆、江、雍三州，402 年攻入建康执政，403 年十二月逼晋安帝禅位，在建康称帝，国号楚。404 年二月刘裕等起兵于京口，桓玄西逃，五月被杀；侄桓振等据江陵抵抗至 405 年三月。
units.notee: In 399 Huan Xuan, son of Huan Wen, swallowed the three provinces of Jing, Jiang and Yong; in 402 he fought his way into Jiankang and took control of the government, and in the 12th month of 403 he forced Emperor An of Jin to abdicate and proclaimed himself emperor at Jiankang, naming his state Chu. In the 2nd month of 404 Liu Yu and others rose at Jingkou; Huan Xuan fled west and was killed in the 5th month, while his nephew Huan Zhen and others held out at Jiangling until the 3rd month of 405.

units.note: 八王之一。301 年在许昌首倡讨伐篡位的赵王伦，以功为大司马辅政，专权骄奢，302 年十二月被长沙王乂攻杀。
units.notee: One of the Eight Princes. In 301 he was the first, at Xuchang, to call for war on Sima Lun, Prince of Zhao, who had usurped the throne; rewarded as Grand Marshal and regent, he ruled high-handedly and extravagantly, and in the 12th month of 302 he was attacked and killed by Sima Ai, Prince of Changsha.

units.note: 八王之一。302 年攻杀齐王冏掌朝政，303 年在洛阳抵御颖、颙联军，304 年正月被东海王越所执，交张方烧杀。
units.notee: One of the Eight Princes. In 302 he attacked and killed Sima Jiong, Prince of Qi, and took charge of the court; in 303 he held Luoyang against the combined armies of Sima Ying and Sima Yong, and in the 1st month of 304 he was seized by Sima Yue, Prince of Donghai, and handed over to Zhang Fang, who burned him to death.

units.note: 八王之一，镇邺城，都督河北。301 年起兵讨伦，304 年为皇太弟遥执朝政，荡阴之战败司马越；同年被王浚、司马腾逐出邺城，306 年被缢杀。
units.notee: One of the Eight Princes, stationed at Ye with command over Hebei. He rose against Sima Lun in 301; in 304, as Imperial Younger Brother and heir, he directed the court from afar and defeated Sima Yue at Dangyin. The same year Wang Jun and Sima Teng drove him from Ye, and in 306 he was strangled.

units.note: 八王之一，297 年起镇关中。部将张方 304 年劫惠帝西入长安，一度独揽朝政；306 年关中被东海王越一方攻破，十二月被南阳王模所杀。
units.notee: One of the Eight Princes, stationed in Guanzhong from 297. In 304 his general Zhang Fang carried Emperor Hui off west to Chang'an, and for a time Sima Yong held sole control of the court. In 306 Guanzhong was overrun by the side of Sima Yue, Prince of Donghai, and in the 12th month Sima Yong was killed by Sima Mo, Prince of Nanyang.

units.note: 八王中最后的胜者。304 年挟惠帝北征败于荡阴，305 年自东海起兵，306 年迎惠帝还洛阳执政，310 年出屯项城，311 年三月病死，其部众随即在宁平城被石勒歼灭。
units.notee: The last victor among the Eight Princes. In 304 he took Emperor Hui north on campaign and was defeated at Dangyin; in 305 he rose from Donghai, in 306 he brought Emperor Hui back to Luoyang and took charge of the government, in 310 he moved out to garrison Xiangcheng, and in the 3rd month of 311 he died of illness, after which his army was wiped out by Shi Le at Ningping City.

units.note: 305 年镇许昌，响应东海王越，被刘乔逐走后据冀州；306 年击破刘乔，迎回惠帝，同年暴卒。
units.notee: Stationed at Xuchang in 305, he answered the call of Sima Yue, Prince of Donghai; driven out by Liu Qiao, he held Ji Province. In 306 he defeated Liu Qiao and brought Emperor Hui back, and died suddenly the same year.

units.note: 东海王越之弟。304 年为并州刺史，与王浚合攻邺城；306 年移镇邺城，307 年被汲桑、石勒攻杀。
units.notee: Younger brother of Sima Yue, Prince of Donghai. Inspector of Bing Province in 304, he joined Wang Jun in attacking Ye; in 306 he moved his post to Ye, and in 307 he was attacked and killed by Ji Sang and Shi Le.

units.note: 东海王越之弟，306 年起镇关中，杀河间王颙。311 年刘曜攻陷长安，被杀。
units.notee: Younger brother of Sima Yue, Prince of Donghai; stationed in Guanzhong from 306, he killed Sima Yong, Prince of Hejian. In 311 Liu Yao took Chang'an and Sima Mo was killed.

units.note: 西晋幽州都督，与段部鲜卑结姻，以鲜卑、乌桓突骑助东海王越。怀帝被俘后在幽州另立皇太子，“名为奉晋，实则自专”。314 年被石勒诈降袭杀。
units.notee: Western Jin Area Commander of You Province. He was allied by marriage with the Duan Xianbei and lent Xianbei and Wuhuan shock cavalry to Sima Yue, Prince of Donghai. After Emperor Huai was captured he set up a crown prince of his own in You Province — "serving Jin in name, acting for himself in fact". In 314 Shi Le feigned surrender and killed him in a surprise attack.

units.note: 306 年出任并州刺史，次年抵晋阳，北结拓跋猗卢，与刘渊、石勒相持近十年；316 年失并州，投奔段匹磾，318 年被杀。
units.notee: Appointed Inspector of Bing Province in 306, he reached Jinyang the next year, allied himself with Tuoba Yilu in the north, and held out against Liu Yuan and Shi Le for nearly ten years; in 316 he lost Bing Province and took refuge with Duan Pidi, and in 318 he was killed.

units.note: 西晋名将，307 年击破汲桑，都督青、兖诸军事，与东海王越不和。311 年在蒙城被石勒俘杀。
units.notee: A famous Western Jin general. In 307 he crushed Ji Sang and was given command over Qing and Yan provinces, but he was at odds with Sima Yue, Prince of Donghai. In 311 he was captured and killed by Shi Le at Mengcheng.

units.note: 307 年以安东将军镇建邺，依靠王导结纳江东士族，311 年后兼并江州、扬州诸镇，316 年西晋亡后在建康称晋王，318 年即帝位，是为东晋元帝。
units.notee: In 307 he took up his post at Jianye as General Who Pacifies the East; relying on Wang Dao to win over the great families of Jiangdong, he absorbed the commands of Jiang and Yang provinces after 311. After the fall of the Western Jin in 316 he took the title King of Jin at Jiankang, and in 318 he ascended the throne as Emperor Yuan of Eastern Jin.

units.note: 张轨 301 年出任凉州刺史，保境安民，中原士人多往依之；314 年张轨卒，子张寔继任，奉愍帝建兴年号。318 年以后自成一国，即前凉。
units.notee: Zhang Gui became Inspector of Liang Province in 301; he kept the province secure and its people at peace, and many gentry from the Central Plain took refuge with him. When Zhang Gui died in 314 his son Zhang Shi succeeded him and kept to Emperor Min's era name Jianxing. From 318 the province became a state of its own — the Former Liang.

units.note: 南阳王模之子，据秦州上邽。313 年为晋右丞相，不救长安；319 年自称晋王，320 年被部将张春所杀。
units.ne: Sima Bao, Prince of Nanyang (Qin Province)
units.notee: Son of Sima Mo, Prince of Nanyang, he held Shanggui in Qin Province. In 313 he was made Jin Chancellor of the Right but did not come to the rescue of Chang'an; in 319 he proclaimed himself King of Jin, and in 320 he was killed by his general Zhang Chun.

units.note: 琅邪王氏，王导从兄。315 年都督江、扬、荆、湘、交、广六州，坐镇武昌，专制上游。322 年起兵攻入建康，自为丞相；324 年再反，病死军中。
units.notee: Of the Wang clan of Langya, an elder cousin of Wang Dao. From 315 he commanded six provinces — Jiang, Yang, Jing, Xiang, Jiao and Guang — from his seat at Wuchang, ruling the middle Yangtze as he pleased. In 322 he rose in arms, broke into Jiankang and made himself Chancellor; in 324 he rebelled again and died of illness with his army.

units.note: 祖逖 313 年渡江北伐，中流击楫，收复黄河以南大片土地，321 年病卒。弟祖约继领其众，退守寿春，328 年与苏峻作乱，兵败投降后赵。
units.notee: In 313 Zu Ti crossed the Yangtze on a northern expedition, striking his oar in midstream, and recovered much of the land south of the Yellow River; he died of illness in 321. His younger brother Zu Yue took over his army and fell back to hold Shouchun; in 328 he joined Su Jun's rebellion, and after its defeat he surrendered to the Later Zhao.

units.note: 以讨王敦之功为历阳内史，拥兵万余。327 年庾亮征其入朝，遂与祖约起兵，328 年二月攻入建康，九月战死；余众据石头城至次年二月。
units.notee: Rewarded for his part in putting down Wang Dun with the post of Administrator of Liyang, he commanded more than ten thousand troops. When Yu Liang summoned him to court in 327 he rose in arms with Zu Yue; in the 2nd month of 328 he broke into Jiankang, and in the 9th month he was killed in battle. His remaining forces held Shitou City until the 2nd month of the following year.

units.note: 寒门出身，平定杜弢、苏峻，328 年起任荆州刺史，都督荆、江等八州，坐镇武昌，334 年卒。
units.notee: Of humble birth, he put down Du Tao and Su Jun. From 328 he was Inspector of Jing Province, commanding eight provinces including Jing and Jiang from his seat at Wuchang; he died in 334.

units.note: 东晋重臣，329 年起以徐州刺史镇京口，招集北来流民，是北府兵的前身。
units.notee: A leading minister of the Eastern Jin. From 329, as Inspector of Xu Province, he was stationed at Jingkou, where he gathered refugees from the north — the forerunners of the Northern Headquarters Army.

units.note: 外戚颍川庾氏。334 年庾亮继陶侃镇武昌，都督江、荆、豫等六州，340 年卒，弟庾翼继镇，谋北伐未成，345 年卒。
units.notee: The Yu clan of Yingchuan, relatives of the empress. In 334 Yu Liang succeeded Tao Kan at Wuchang, commanding six provinces including Jiang, Jing and Yu; he died in 340 and was succeeded by his younger brother Yu Yi, who planned a northern expedition without success and died in 345.

units.note: 谯国桓氏。桓温 345 年任荆州刺史，347 年灭成汉，354、356、369 年三次北伐，356 年收复洛阳；后移镇姑孰，废立皇帝，373 年卒。弟桓豁、桓冲继镇荆州，至 384 年。
units.notee: The Huan clan of Qiao. Huan Wen became Inspector of Jing Province in 345, destroyed Cheng Han in 347, and led three northern expeditions, in 354, 356 and 369, recovering Luoyang in 356; he later moved his seat to Gushu, deposed one emperor and set up another, and died in 373. His younger brothers Huan Huo and Huan Chong held Jing Province after him until 384.

units.note: 377 年谢玄在广陵招募南渡的北方流民组成的精兵，因京口、广陵称“北府”而得名。383 年淝水之战主力；后由王恭、刘牢之统领，404 年刘裕以北府将领起兵灭桓玄，由此掌握东晋政权。
units.notee: An elite force recruited by Xie Xuan at Guangling in 377 from northern refugees who had fled south, named after Jingkou and Guangling, which were called the "Northern Headquarters". It was the main force at the Battle of the Fei River in 383, and was later led by Wang Gong and Liu Laozhi; in 404 Liu Yu, a Northern Headquarters general, rose with it to destroy Huan Xuan, and so gained control of the Eastern Jin government.

units.note: 391 年起任荆州刺史，397、398 年两次随王恭起兵，399 年十二月被桓玄袭杀。
units.notee: Inspector of Jing Province from 391, he joined Wang Gong's risings in 397 and 398, and in the 12th month of 399 he was killed in a surprise attack by Huan Xuan.

units.note: 弘农杨氏，398 年任雍州刺史镇襄阳，与殷仲堪、桓玄结盟；399 年被桓玄攻杀。
units.notee: Of the Yang clan of Hongnong, he became Inspector of Yong Province in 398, stationed at Xiangyang, and allied himself with Yin Zhongkan and Huan Xuan; in 399 he was attacked and killed by Huan Xuan.

units.note: 桓温之子，398 年任江州刺史，399 年袭杀殷仲堪、杨佺期，尽有荆、江、雍三州，402 年攻入建康执政，403 年称帝建楚。
units.notee: Son of Huan Wen. He became Inspector of Jiang Province in 398; in 399 he killed Yin Zhongkan and Yang Quanqi in surprise attacks and took all three provinces of Jing, Jiang and Yong; in 402 he fought his way into Jiankang and took control of the government, and in 403 he proclaimed himself emperor and founded Chu.

units.note: 孙恩妹夫，五斗米道首领。402 年孙恩死后继领其众，404 年攻占番禺，东晋授以广州刺史；410 年北上进逼建康，被刘裕击败，411 年在交州败死。
units.notee: Brother-in-law of Sun En and a leader of the Way of the Five Pecks of Rice. After Sun En died in 402 he took over his followers; in 404 he seized Panyu and the Eastern Jin made him Inspector of Guang Province. In 410 he marched north and pressed on Jiankang but was defeated by Liu Yu, and in 411 he was defeated and died in Jiao Province.

units.note: 296 年秦、雍二州氐羌推氐帅齐万年为帝，众七万，屯梁山，297 年在六陌击杀晋将周处；299 年正月被孟观擒获。
units.notee: In 296 the Di and Qiang of Qin and Yong provinces made the Di chieftain Qi Wannian their emperor; with seventy thousand men he camped at Liangshan, and in 297 he killed the Jin general Zhou Chu at Liumo. In the 1st month of 299 he was captured by Meng Guan.

units.note: 西晋益州刺史，300 年据成都反，引六郡流民为助；301 年正月被李特兄弟攻杀。
units.notee: Western Jin Inspector of Yi Province. In 300 he rebelled at Chengdu with the help of refugees from six commanderies; in the 1st month of 301 he was attacked and killed by Li Te and his brothers.

units.note: 张昌部将。303 年张昌在江夏起事后，石冰东下攻陷扬州、江州，据有临淮、建邺一带；304 年被陈敏击灭。
units.ne: Shi Bing (remnants of Zhang Chang's rising)
units.notee: A general of Zhang Chang. After Zhang Chang rose at Jiangxia in 303, Shi Bing went down the Yangtze and took Yang and Jiang provinces, holding the area from Linhuai to Jianye; in 304 he was destroyed by Chen Min.

units.note: 西晋广陵相。305 年十二月据历阳起兵，自称楚公、都督江东诸军事，尽有江东；307 年二月部将甘卓、顾荣倒戈，兵败被杀。
units.notee: Western Jin Chancellor of Guangling. In the 12th month of 305 he rose in arms at Liyang, styled himself Duke of Chu and Commander of all Armies of Jiangdong, and held the whole of Jiangdong; in the 2nd month of 307 his officers Gan Zhuo and Gu Rong turned against him, and he was defeated and killed.

units.note: 关中流民首领，310 年在宛起兵，众至四五万，进围襄阳；312 年降于王敦。
units.notee: A leader of refugees from Guanzhong. He rose at Wan in 310, his following grew to forty or fifty thousand, and he advanced to besiege Xiangyang; in 312 he surrendered to Wang Dun.

units.note: 蜀地流民首领，311 年被湘州流民推为首领，据长沙，与陶侃、周访等转战四年，315 年败死。
units.notee: A leader of refugees from Shu. In 311 the refugees of Xiang Province chose him as their leader; he held Changsha and fought Tao Kan, Zhou Fang and others for four years before he was defeated and died in 315.

units.note: 匈奴屠各刘渊 304 年在离石左国城称汉王，308 年称帝，309 年迁都平阳；其子刘聪 311 年攻破洛阳、俘晋怀帝，316 年攻破长安、灭西晋。318 年靳准之乱后刘曜即位，319 年迁都长安，改国号赵，史称前赵。328 年刘曜在洛阳被石勒所擒，329 年前赵亡。
units.notee: In 304 Liu Yuan of the Xiongnu Chuge proclaimed himself King of Han at Zuoguo City near Lishi; he took the title of emperor in 308 and moved his capital to Pingyang in 309. His son Liu Cong took Luoyang in 311, capturing Emperor Huai of Jin, and took Chang'an in 316, ending the Western Jin. After Jin Zhun's coup of 318 Liu Yao took the throne; in 319 he moved the capital to Chang'an and renamed the state Zhao, known to history as the Former Zhao. In 328 Liu Yao was captured by Shi Le at Luoyang, and in 329 the Former Zhao fell.

units.note: 略阳氐人李特率六郡流民入蜀，301 年起兵；其子李雄 303 年攻占成都，304 年称成都王，306 年称帝，国号成。333 年李寿取宁州。338 年李寿篡位，改国号汉，史称成汉。347 年东晋桓温攻破成都，李势出降。
units.notee: Li Te, a Di from Lüeyang, led the refugees of six commanderies into Shu and rose in arms in 301; his son Li Xiong took Chengdu in 303, proclaimed himself King of Chengdu in 304 and emperor in 306, naming his state Cheng. In 333 Li Shou took Ning Province. In 338 Li Shou usurped the throne and renamed the state Han, known to history as Cheng Han. In 347 Huan Wen of the Eastern Jin took Chengdu, and Li Shi surrendered.

units.note: 羯人石勒原为汉赵部将，312 年据襄国经营河北，319 年称赵王自立，328 年擒刘曜，329 年灭前赵，330 年称帝，据北方大部。石虎 334 年篡位，335 年迁都邺，役使无度。349 年石虎死后诸子相残，冉闵篡权，351 年后赵亡。
units.notee: Shi Le, a Jie, was originally a general of Han Zhao. In 312 he occupied Xiangguo and built up Hebei; in 319 he made himself King of Zhao, in 328 he captured Liu Yao, in 329 he destroyed the Former Zhao, and in 330 he proclaimed himself emperor, holding most of the north. Shi Hu usurped the throne in 334 and moved the capital to Ye in 335, exacting labor without limit. After Shi Hu died in 349 his sons killed one another, Ran Min seized power, and in 351 the Later Zhao fell.

units.note: 石勒 307 年投奔刘渊，以汉赵将领身份纵横冀、豫，311 年歼晋军于宁平城、杀王弥，312 年据襄国，314 年擒王浚，316 年夺并州；名为汉臣，实已自成一方，319 年自立为赵王。
units.notee: Shi Le joined Liu Yuan in 307 and ranged across Ji and Yu provinces as a Han Zhao general. In 311 he wiped out the Jin army at Ningping City and killed Wang Mi; in 312 he occupied Xiangguo, in 314 he captured Wang Jun, and in 316 he seized Bing Province. A Han subject in name, he was already a power in his own right, and in 319 he made himself King of Zhao.

units.note: 王弥部将，311 年起据青州，筑广固城，先后名义上臣属汉赵、东晋、后赵；323 年被石虎攻杀。
units.notee: A general of Wang Mi. From 311 he held Qing Province and built Guanggu City, nominally serving Han Zhao, the Eastern Jin and the Later Zhao in turn; in 323 he was attacked and killed by Shi Hu.

units.note: 安定张氏所建，都姑臧。张轨 301 年出任凉州刺史，其子孙长期奉晋正朔，沿用愍帝建兴年号；张骏时置高昌郡、经营西域，最盛时据有河西、陇西与西域东部。354 年张祚称帝，旋即被杀。376 年前秦攻姑臧，张天锡出降，前凉亡。
units.notee: Founded by the Zhang clan of Anding, with its capital at Guzang. Zhang Gui became Inspector of Liang Province in 301, and his descendants long acknowledged the Jin calendar, keeping Emperor Min's era name Jianxing. Under Zhang Jun the state set up Gaochang Commandery and extended its rule into the Western Regions; at its height it held Hexi, Longxi and the eastern Western Regions. In 354 Zhang Zuo proclaimed himself emperor and was soon killed. In 376 the Former Qin attacked Guzang, Zhang Tianxi surrendered, and the Former Liang came to an end.

units.note: 后赵石虎养孙冉闵 350 年杀石鉴称帝，国号魏，下杀胡令；352 年四月在廉台被前燕慕容恪所擒，八月邺城陷落。
units.notee: In 350 Ran Min, adopted grandson of Shi Hu of the Later Zhao, killed Shi Jian and proclaimed himself emperor, naming his state Wei, and issued the order to kill the Hu; in the 4th month of 352 he was captured by Murong Ke of the Former Yan at Liantai, and in the 8th month Ye fell.

units.note: 段部鲜卑余众首领，350 年据青州广固，自称齐王，后称藩于东晋；356 年被前燕慕容恪攻破广固出降。
units.notee: Leader of the remnants of the Duan Xianbei. In 350 he occupied Guanggu in Qing Province and styled himself King of Qi, later acknowledging the Eastern Jin as his overlord; in 356 Murong Ke of the Former Yan broke into Guanggu and Duan Kan surrendered.

units.note: 后赵并州刺史，后赵亡后据并州壁垒三百余所，先后附燕、附秦，358 年以后并州归前燕。
units.notee: Later Zhao Inspector of Bing Province. After the fall of the Later Zhao he held more than three hundred fortified strongholds in Bing Province, submitting first to Yan and then to Qin; from 358 Bing Province belonged to the Former Yan.

units.note: 鲜卑慕容部所建。慕容廆 289 年附晋，以大棘城为中心经营辽西，319 年尽有辽东；其子慕容皝 337 年称燕王，342 年迁都龙城，破高句丽、灭宇文部。慕容儁 350 年南下取蓟，352 年灭冉魏称帝，357 年迁都邺。慕容恪死后朝政废弛，370 年被前秦攻灭。
units.notee: Founded by the Murong Xianbei. Murong Hui submitted to Jin in 289 and built up Liaoxi around Daji City, and by 319 he held all of Liaodong; his son Murong Huang took the title King of Yan in 337, moved the capital to Longcheng in 342, defeated Goguryeo and destroyed the Yuwen. Murong Jun marched south and took Ji in 350, destroyed Ran Wei and proclaimed himself emperor in 352, and moved the capital to Ye in 357. After the death of Murong Ke the government decayed, and in 370 the state was destroyed by the Former Qin.

units.note: 氐人苻洪、苻健所建。苻健 350 年入关中，351 年称天王，352 年称帝，都长安。苻坚 357 年即位，重用王猛，370 年灭前燕，371 年灭仇池，373 年取梁益，376 年灭前凉、代，统一北方。383 年淝水之战大败，政权瓦解，385 年苻坚被姚苌所杀，394 年亡。
units.notee: Founded by Fu Hong and Fu Jian (苻健) of the Di. Fu Jian entered Guanzhong in 350, took the title Heavenly King in 351 and that of emperor in 352, with his capital at Chang'an. Fu Jian (苻坚) took the throne in 357 and relied on Wang Meng; he destroyed the Former Yan in 370, Chouchi in 371, took Liang and Yi provinces in 373, and destroyed the Former Liang and Dai in 376, unifying the north. Routed at the Battle of the Fei River in 383, the state disintegrated; in 385 Fu Jian was killed by Yao Chang, and the state ended in 394.

units.note: 鲜卑拓跋部所建。猗卢 310 年助晋得陉北五县，封代公，315 年进封代王，以盛乐为北都、平城为南都。338 年什翼犍即代王位，建元建国，设置百官。376 年被前秦攻灭，386 年什翼犍之孙拓跋珪复国，即北魏。
units.notee: Founded by the Tuoba Xianbei. In 310 Yilu helped Jin and was given five counties north of the passes and the title Duke of Dai; in 315 he was raised to King of Dai, with Shengle as his northern capital and Pingcheng as his southern capital. Shiyijian became King of Dai in 338, proclaimed the era name Jianguo and set up a bureaucracy. Dai was destroyed by the Former Qin in 376; in 386 Shiyijian's grandson Tuoba Gui restored the state — the Northern Wei.

units.note: 鲜卑拓跋部原居大兴安岭北段，东汉末南迁匈奴故地。258 年力微迁居定襄盛乐，295 年分为三部。310 年猗卢受晋封为代公，315 年称代王。
units.notee: The Tuoba Xianbei originally lived in the northern Greater Khingan; at the end of the Eastern Han they moved south into the former Xiongnu lands. In 258 Liwei moved to Shengle in Dingxiang, and in 295 the tribe split into three. In 310 Yilu was made Duke of Dai by Jin, and in 315 he took the title King of Dai.

units.note: 鲜卑慕容部，居辽西。慕容廆 285 年破夫余，289 年附晋，294 年移居大棘城，教民农桑，招徕中原流民；337 年其子慕容皝称燕王，即前燕。
units.notee: The Murong Xianbei, living in Liaoxi. Murong Hui crushed Buyeo in 285, submitted to Jin in 289, moved to Daji City in 294, taught his people farming and sericulture, and drew in refugees from the Central Plain; in 337 his son Murong Huang took the title King of Yan — the Former Yan.

units.note: 鲜卑宇文部，居辽西塞外的紫蒙川一带，与慕容部世仇。344 年被慕容皝攻灭，部众被迁徙；北周宇文氏自称其后。
units.notee: The Yuwen Xianbei, living around the Zimeng River beyond the frontier of Liaoxi, hereditary enemies of the Murong. In 344 they were destroyed by Murong Huang and their people deported; the Yuwen of the Northern Zhou claimed descent from them.

units.note: 鲜卑段部，居辽西令支一带，与王浚结姻，助晋讨伐成都王颖、石勒；段匹磾 314—321 年据幽州，后为石虎所灭。338 年段辽被后赵、前燕夹击而亡。
units.notee: The Duan Xianbei, living around Lingzhi in Liaoxi. Allied by marriage with Wang Jun, they helped Jin against Sima Ying, Prince of Chengdu, and against Shi Le; Duan Pidi held You Province from 314 to 321 before he was destroyed by Shi Hu. In 338 Duan Liao was crushed between the Later Zhao and the Former Yan, and the Duan came to an end.

units.note: 匈奴父、鲜卑母所生的后裔称铁弗，刘虎、刘卫辰相继统领，居河套与朔方，391 年被北魏击灭，刘卫辰之子赫连勃勃 407 年建立夏国。
units.notee: Descendants of Xiongnu fathers and Xianbei mothers were called Tiefu. Led in turn by Liu Hu and Liu Weichen, they lived in the Hetao and Shuofang; in 391 they were destroyed by the Northern Wei, and Helian Bobo, son of Liu Weichen, founded Xia in 407.

units.note: 匈奴独孤部首领。376 年前秦灭代，以刘库仁统领黄河以东的代国旧部，刘卫辰统领河西；384 年刘库仁被杀，弟刘头眷、子刘显相继统其众。
units.notee: Chief of the Dugu tribe of the Xiongnu. When the Former Qin destroyed Dai in 376, it put Liu Kuren in charge of the old Dai tribes east of the Yellow River and Liu Weichen of those to the west; in 384 Liu Kuren was killed, and his younger brother Liu Toujuan and then his son Liu Xian led his people.

units.note: 刘库仁之子刘显据马邑，拒拓跋珪复国，387 年被北魏、后燕联军击破。
units.notee: Liu Xian, son of Liu Kuren, held Mayi and opposed Tuoba Gui's restoration of the state; in 387 he was crushed by the combined armies of the Northern Wei and the Later Yan.

units.note: 丁零翟辽 388 年在滑台自称魏天王，据有黄河南北的东郡、陈留、濮阳一带；392 年被后燕慕容垂攻灭。
units.notee: In 388 Zhai Liao of the Dingling styled himself Heavenly King of Wei at Huatai, holding Dong, Chenliu and Puyang commanderies on both banks of the Yellow River; in 392 the state was destroyed by Murong Chui of the Later Yan.

units.note: 慕容垂所建。慕容垂 369 年因功高遭忌投奔前秦，淝水战后于 384 年在荥阳称燕王，386 年在中山称帝，392 年灭翟魏，394 年灭西燕，复有关东之地。395 年参合陂大败于北魏，397 年失中山，退守辽西龙城；407 年慕容熙被冯跋所杀，后燕亡。
units.notee: Founded by Murong Chui. In 369 Murong Chui, whose merit had made him enemies, fled to the Former Qin; after the Fei River he proclaimed himself King of Yan at Xingyang in 384 and emperor at Zhongshan in 386, destroyed Zhai Wei in 392 and the Western Yan in 394, and regained the lands east of the passes. In 395 the Later Yan was routed by the Northern Wei at Canhe Slope; in 397 the state lost Zhongshan and fell back to Longcheng in Liaoxi; in 407 Murong Xi was killed by Feng Ba and the Later Yan came to an end.

units.note: 淝水战后慕容泓、慕容冲 384 年起兵关中，385 年攻入长安；386 年鲜卑四十余万口东归，慕容永在长子称帝，据有并州与河东。394 年被后燕所灭。
units.notee: After the Fei River, Murong Hong and Murong Chong rose in Guanzhong in 384 and broke into Chang'an in 385; in 386 more than four hundred thousand Xianbei headed back east, and Murong Yong proclaimed himself emperor at Zhangzi, holding Bing Province and Hedong. The state was destroyed by the Later Yan in 394.

units.note: 后燕慕容德 398 年自邺南迁滑台称燕王，399 年失滑台，东取青州，以广固为都，400 年称帝。410 年刘裕攻破广固，慕容超被俘，南燕亡。
units.notee: In 398 Murong De of the Later Yan moved south from Ye to Huatai and proclaimed himself King of Yan; in 399 he lost Huatai, took Qing Province to the east, made Guanggu his capital, and in 400 proclaimed himself emperor. In 410 Liu Yu broke into Guanggu, Murong Chao was captured, and the Southern Yan came to an end.

units.note: 407 年冯跋杀后燕慕容熙，立慕容宝养子高云（慕容云），409 年高云被杀，冯跋自立，都龙城。436 年被北魏攻灭，冯弘奔高句丽。
units.notee: In 407 Feng Ba killed Murong Xi of the Later Yan and enthroned Gao Yun (Murong Yun), adopted son of Murong Bao; in 409 Gao Yun was killed and Feng Ba made himself ruler, with his capital at Longcheng. The state was destroyed by the Northern Wei in 436, and Feng Hong fled to Goguryeo.

units.note: 羌人姚苌所建。姚苌原为前秦将领，384 年在渭北自称秦王，385 年缢杀苻坚，386 年在长安称帝。姚兴 394 年灭前秦，399 年取洛阳，400 年降西秦，401 年使后凉称藩，盛极一时，崇信佛法，迎鸠摩罗什至长安译经。402 年柴壁大败于北魏，407 年赫连勃勃叛去。417 年被东晋刘裕所灭。
units.notee: Founded by Yao Chang of the Qiang. Originally a Former Qin general, Yao Chang styled himself King of Qin north of the Wei River in 384, strangled Fu Jian in 385, and proclaimed himself emperor at Chang'an in 386. Yao Xing destroyed the Former Qin in 394, took Luoyang in 399, received the submission of the Western Qin in 400 and made the Later Liang a vassal in 401, bringing the state to its height; a devout Buddhist, he brought Kumarajiva to Chang'an to translate scriptures. In 402 he was routed by the Northern Wei at Chaibi, and in 407 Helian Bobo broke away. The state was destroyed by Liu Yu of the Eastern Jin in 417.

units.note: 陇西鲜卑乞伏国仁 385 年在苑川自称大单于，乞伏乾归 388 年继立，称河南王；400 年降后秦，409 年复国，412 年迁都枹罕，414 年灭南凉。431 年被夏所灭。
units.notee: In 385 Qifu Guoren of the Longxi Xianbei styled himself Grand Chanyu at Yuanchuan; Qifu Gangui succeeded him in 388 and took the title King of Henan. The state submitted to the Later Qin in 400, was restored in 409, moved its capital to Fuhan in 412, and destroyed the Southern Liang in 414. It was destroyed by Xia in 431.

units.note: 氐人吕光 383 年奉苻坚之命西征，攻破龟兹，385 年东归据姑臧，386 年称凉州牧，389 年称三河王，396 年称天王，国号大凉。397 年南凉、北凉相继分立，401 年向后秦称藩，403 年吕隆率众东迁长安，后凉亡。
units.notee: In 383 Lü Guang, a Di, marched west on Fu Jian's orders and took Kucha; in 385 he returned east and occupied Guzang, in 386 he styled himself Governor of Liang Province, in 389 King of Sanhe, and in 396 Heavenly King, naming his state Great Liang. In 397 the Southern Liang and the Northern Liang broke away one after the other; in 401 the state became a vassal of the Later Qin, and in 403 Lü Long led his people east to Chang'an and the Later Liang came to an end.

units.note: 河西鲜卑秃发乌孤 397 年自称西平王，都乐都；秃发傉檀 406 年得姑臧，410 年败于北凉退回乐都。414 年被西秦袭灭。
units.notee: In 397 Tufa Wugu of the Hexi Xianbei styled himself King of Xiping, with his capital at Ledu; Tufa Rutan gained Guzang in 406, but after his defeat by the Northern Liang in 410 he fell back to Ledu. The state was destroyed in a surprise attack by the Western Qin in 414.

units.note: 397 年卢水胡沮渠蒙逊推后凉建康太守段业为凉州牧，401 年蒙逊杀段业自立，412 年迁都姑臧，称河西王，420 年灭西凉，奄有河西。439 年被北魏攻灭。沮渠无讳、沮渠安周率余众西走，442 年据高昌（高昌北凉），460 年被柔然所灭。
units.notee: In 397 Juqu Mengxun of the Lushui Hu made Duan Ye, the Later Liang Administrator of Jiankang, Governor of Liang Province; in 401 Mengxun killed Duan Ye and took power himself. He moved the capital to Guzang in 412 and took the title King of Hexi, and in 420 he destroyed the Western Liang and held the whole of Hexi. The state was destroyed by the Northern Wei in 439. Juqu Wuhui and Juqu Anzhou led the remnants west and seized Gaochang in 442 (the Gaochang Northern Liang), which was destroyed by the Rouran in 460.

units.note: 陇西李暠 400 年被推为凉公，据敦煌，405 年迁都酒泉，奉东晋正朔。420 年李歆败死，421 年敦煌陷落，被北凉所灭。唐朝李氏自称其后。
units.notee: In 400 Li Gao of Longxi was acclaimed Duke of Liang and held Dunhuang; in 405 he moved his capital to Jiuquan, acknowledging the Eastern Jin calendar. In 420 Li Xin was defeated and died, and in 421 Dunhuang fell and the state was destroyed by the Northern Liang. The Li of the Tang claimed descent from Li Gao.

units.note: 铁弗匈奴赫连勃勃 407 年叛后秦，自称大夏天王，413 年筑统万城为都，418 年夺取长安后称帝。427 年北魏攻克统万，428 年赫连昌被擒，弟赫连定 431 年灭西秦后被吐谷浑所擒，夏亡。
units.notee: In 407 Helian Bobo of the Tiefu Xiongnu broke with the Later Qin and styled himself Heavenly King of Great Xia; in 413 he built Tongwan City as his capital, and after taking Chang'an in 418 he proclaimed himself emperor. In 427 the Northern Wei took Tongwan, and in 428 Helian Chang was captured; his younger brother Helian Ding destroyed the Western Qin in 431 but was then captured by the Tuyuhun, and Xia came to an end.

units.note: 405 年益州参军谯纵在涪城兵变，自称成都王，称藩后秦；413 年东晋朱龄石攻入成都，谯纵自杀。
units.notee: In 405 Qiao Zong, an Adjutant of Yi Province, mutinied at Fucheng and styled himself King of Chengdu, acknowledging the Later Qin as his overlord; in 413 Zhu Lingshi of the Eastern Jin broke into Chengdu and Qiao Zong killed himself.

units.note: 略阳氐人杨茂搜 296 年回到仇池山，据武都、阴平一带，其后时附晋、时附诸胡。371 年被前秦所灭，385 年杨定复国（后仇池），442 年宋破仇池，443 年仇池入北魏。杨氏余部先后据武都、武兴（477—506）与阴平，阴平杨氏延续至北周。
units.notee: In 296 Yang Maosou, a Di from Lüeyang, returned to Mount Chouchi and held the area of Wudu and Yinping; thereafter the Yang submitted now to Jin, now to the non-Chinese states. Chouchi was destroyed by the Former Qin in 371 and restored by Yang Ding in 385 (the Later Chouchi); in 442 Song crushed Chouchi, and in 443 Chouchi passed to the Northern Wei. Branches of the Yang went on to hold Wudu, Wuxing (477–506) and Yinping, and the Yang of Yinping lasted into the Northern Zhou.

units.note: 羌人梁氏所建，据今甘肃宕昌、迭部一带，臣属南北两朝；564 年被北周攻灭，置宕州。
units.notee: Founded by the Liang clan of the Qiang, around today's Dangchang and Tewo in Gansu, it submitted to both the Northern and Southern Dynasties; in 564 it was destroyed by the Northern Zhou, which set up Dangzhou there.

units.note: 白水羌像舒治所建，居今川甘交界的白水上游，臣属南北两朝，6 世纪中叶并入西魏。
units.notee: Founded by Xiang Shuzhi of the Baishui Qiang, on the upper Baishui on today's Sichuan–Gansu border; it submitted to both the Northern and Southern Dynasties and was absorbed by the Western Wei in the mid-6th century.

units.note: 拓跋珪 386 年复国称代王，旋改称魏王，398 年迁都平城称帝（道武帝）。太武帝拓跋焘 427 年破夏统万，436 年灭北燕，439 年灭北凉，统一北方；450 年南下饮马长江。孝文帝 494 年迁都洛阳，推行汉化。524 年六镇起义，528 年河阴之变，尔朱荣、高欢相继专权，534 年分裂为东魏、西魏。
units.notee: Tuoba Gui restored the state in 386 as King of Dai, soon changing the title to King of Wei; in 398 he moved the capital to Pingcheng and proclaimed himself emperor (Emperor Daowu). Emperor Taiwu, Tuoba Tao, took the Xia capital Tongwan in 427, destroyed the Northern Yan in 436 and the Northern Liang in 439, unifying the north; in 450 he marched south and watered his horses at the Yangtze. Emperor Xiaowen moved the capital to Luoyang in 494 and pressed sinicization. After the Six Garrisons uprising of 524 and the Heyin massacre of 528, Erzhu Rong and then Gao Huan monopolized power, and in 534 the state split into the Eastern and Western Wei.

units.note: 534 年高欢立孝静帝元善见，迁都邺城，实权在高欢晋阳霸府；与西魏连年交战，537 年沙苑大败，538 年河桥、543 年邙山获胜。547 年高欢死，侯景叛归梁。550 年高洋代东魏建北齐。
units.notee: In 534 Gao Huan enthroned Emperor Xiaojing, Yuan Shanjian, and moved the capital to Ye, while real power lay with Gao Huan's headquarters at Jinyang. The state fought the Western Wei year after year: routed at Shayuan in 537, it won at Heqiao in 538 and at Mount Mang in 543. Gao Huan died in 547 and Hou Jing defected to Liang. In 550 Gao Yang replaced the Eastern Wei and founded the Northern Qi.

units.note: 534 年孝武帝西奔宇文泰，次年宇文泰立文帝元宝炬，都长安。宇文泰创府兵制，537 年沙苑大胜东魏；553 年取巴蜀，554 年破江陵，557 年宇文觉代西魏建北周。
units.notee: In 534 Emperor Xiaowu fled west to Yuwen Tai, who the following year enthroned Emperor Wen, Yuan Baoju, with the capital at Chang'an. Yuwen Tai created the garrison militia system and won a great victory over the Eastern Wei at Shayuan in 537; the state took Ba-Shu in 553 and sacked Jiangling in 554, and in 557 Yuwen Jue replaced the Western Wei and founded the Northern Zhou.

units.note: 高欢之子高洋 550 年代东魏所建，都邺，以晋阳为别都。文宣帝初年强盛，北击柔然、契丹，南取淮南江北；后继诸帝荒淫，573 年失淮南于陈。577 年被北周所灭。
units.notee: Founded in 550 by Gao Yang, son of Gao Huan, when he replaced the Eastern Wei; its capital was Ye, with Jinyang as a secondary capital. Strong in the early years of Emperor Wenxuan, it struck north against the Rouran and the Khitan and took Huainan and the land north of the Yangtze in the south; the later emperors were dissolute, and in 573 Huainan was lost to Chen. The state was destroyed by the Northern Zhou in 577.

units.note: 宇文觉 557 年代西魏所建，都长安，宇文护专权十五年。572 年武帝宇文邕亲政，574 年禁断佛道，577 年灭北齐，统一北方；579 年取陈淮南。580 年宣帝死，外戚杨坚辅政，581 年代周建隋。
units.notee: Founded in 557 by Yuwen Jue when he replaced the Western Wei, with its capital at Chang'an; Yuwen Hu held power for fifteen years. Emperor Wu, Yuwen Yong, took personal control in 572, banned Buddhism and Daoism in 574, destroyed the Northern Qi in 577 and unified the north, and in 579 the state took Huainan from Chen. When Emperor Xuan died in 580, Yang Jian, the empress's father, became regent, and in 581 he replaced Zhou and founded Sui.

units.note:
杨坚 581 年二月受北周静帝禅位，国号隋，年号开皇；都大兴城（582 年于汉长安城东南新建，583 年迁入），炀帝 605 年起营建东都洛阳。
文帝：开皇律令、三省六部、均田与租调、大索貌阅与输籍法；587 年废后梁，589 年灭陈，结束近三百年南北分裂。
units.notee:
In the 2nd month of 581 Yang Jian accepted the abdication of Emperor Jing of Northern Zhou, naming his dynasty Sui with the era name Kaihuang; the capital was Daxing City (built new southeast of Han Chang'an in 582 and occupied in 583), and from 605 Emperor Yang built Luoyang as the Eastern Capital.
